n-m-h2-explog-07.title: Idan mun san ƙimar logarithm guda ɗaya, za mu iya nemo log₆12?
n-m-h2-explog-07.goal: Binciki bayanin da ake buƙata domin nemo logarithm ɗin, sannan ka nemo magana da kanka ta amfani da ƙima guda p.
n-m-h2-explog-07.material: Eunseo tana son nemo log_6 12 ba tare da kalkuleta ba. Idan aka gaya mata ɗaya daga ƙimomin da ke ƙasa, tana son duba ko za ta iya bayyana log_6 12 ta wannan ƙimar, dokokin logarithm da ayyukan lissafi huɗu kawai. (log_6 12 logarithm ne na 12 mai tushe 6.)
n-m-h2-explog-07.thinking.1: Ragewa zuwa ƙima ɗaya ta canza tushe
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk ƙimomin da sanin ƙima guda ɗaya kaɗai zai ba ka damar bayyana log_6 12 ta amfani da ita, dokokin logarithm da ayyukan lissafi huɗu.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.hint.0: Gwada canza tushe na log_6 12 zuwa 2 ko 3, ko rubuta 12 da 6 a matsayin ninkin 2 da 3, domin ganin wane logarithm guda ɗaya zai iya bayyana shi.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.hint.1: Duba ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko kowane zaɓi yana ɗauke da bayani iri ɗaya da wancan logarithm (ko ana iya canza shi zuwa gare shi ta dabara).
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.a: Idan log_10 2 kaɗai aka sani, ba za ka san log_10 3 ba, don haka ba za ka iya bayyana 12 da 6 duka ba.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.b: Ka rasa bayanin da ke canzawa zuwa logarithm guda, kamar log_2 6=1+log_2 3.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.c: Ka manta amfani da log_6 3=1−log_6 2 yana ba ka damar bayyana log_6 12.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.d: Ba shi da alaƙa da 2 da 3, don haka ba ya taimakawa.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.e: Ka manta log_3 2 reciprocal ne na log_2 3.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.f: Ka manta canza tushen log_6 12 zuwa 2 yana barin log_2 3 kawai.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.explain: log_6 12=log_2 12/log_2 6=(2+log_2 3)/(1+log_2 3), don haka p=log_2 3 kaɗai ya isa. log_2 6=1+p, log_3 2=1/p, da log_6 2=1/(1+p) duk ana iya canza su zuwa p ko daga p. log_10 2 ba ya isa sai an san log_10 3, log_5 7 kuma ba shi da alaƙa da 2 da 3.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.prompt: A sa p=log_2 3. Bayyana log_6 12 ta amfani da p.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.hint.0: Canza tushe zuwa 2, ka rubuta sama da ƙasa kowannensu a matsayin ƙimar log_2.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta log_2 12 da log_2 6 a matsayin products na 2 da 3, sannan ka yi amfani da dokokin logarithm don bayyana su ta p.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: A maganarka ta p, ka sanya sama da ƙasa a daidai wurinsu?
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka saka p=1.585 ka duba cewa log_6 12≈1.387?
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.model.1: Canza tushe zuwa 2 yana ba da log_2 12/log_2 6=(2+p)/(1+p).

n-m-h2-explog-09.title: Tantance daidaiton jadawalin exponential da logarithm
n-m-h2-explog-09.goal: Gwada iƙirarin daidaito tsakanin wasu jadawalai ta dabara, tantance waɗanne ne gaskiya ko ƙarya, sannan ka nuna dalilin iƙirari guda da dabara ɗaya.
n-m-h2-explog-09.material: Seungwoo ya taƙaita alaƙar daidaito tsakanin jadawalin exponential da logarithm mai tushe 2 da 1/2. Ana rubuta logarithm mai tushe 1/2 a matsayin log_{1/2}x.
n-m-h2-explog-09.thinking.1: Mayar da alaƙar jadawali zuwa dabaru
n-m-h2-explog-09.thinking.2: Nemo daidaiton da ya dace ga iƙirari marar daidai
n-m-h2-explog-09.prereq.1: Ayyukan juna da daidaito game da layin y=x
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk bayanan taƙaitaccen Seungwoo da suke daidai.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane jadawali biyu, ɗauki batu ɗaya ka nemo coordinates, sannan ka duba yadda za a matsar da shi ya faɗa kan jadawalin ɗaya.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.hint.1: Da farko rubuta yadda daidaito game da y-axis da game da layin y=x ke canza coordinates na batu.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.a: Jadawalin y=2^x da y=(1/2)^x suna daidaito game da y-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.a: Tun da (1/2)^x=2^(−x), wannan jadawali ne da aka sauya alamar x. Ka rasa bayani daidai ne.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.b: Jadawalin y=log_2 x da y=log_{1/2} x suna daidaito game da y-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.b: Ayyukan log an ayyana su ne kawai ga x>0, don haka ba za su iya zama daidaito game da y-axis ba.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.c: Jadawalin y=2^x da y=log_2 x suna daidaito game da layin y=x.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.c: Ayyukan juna ne, saboda haka suna daidaito game da y=x. Ka rasa magana daidai.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.d: Jadawalin y=2^x da y=log_{1/2} x suna daidaito game da layin y=x.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.d: Aikin juna na 2^x shi ne log_2 x, ba log_{1/2}x ba.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.explain: Tun da (1/2)^x=2^(−x), y=2^x da y=(1/2)^x suna daidaito game da y-axis. y=2^x da y=log_2 x ayyukan juna ne, don haka daidaito game da y=x suke. log_{1/2}x yana da yankin x>0, don haka ba zai zama daidaito game da y-axis ba, kuma ba aikin juna na 2^x ba ne.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta layin da jadawalin y=log_2 x da y=log_{1/2}x suke daidaito game da shi, ka nuna dalili da dabara.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.hint.0: Sake rubuta log_{1/2}x a matsayin logarithm mai tushe 2. Kwatanta ƙimomin y na dabarun biyu a x ɗaya.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.hint.1: Duba alaƙar ƙimomin y, ka bayyana ta wace hanya wannan alaƙar ke matsar da batu.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka samu log_{1/2}x=−log_2 x ta canza tushe?
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ta amfani da coordinates, ka ce a x ɗaya ƙimomin y alamominsu ne kawai suka bambanta?
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana yadda daidaito game da x-axis ke matsar da batu?
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.model.0: log_{1/2}x=log_2 x/log_2(1/2)=−log_2 x. A x ɗaya ƙimomin y alamominsu kawai suka bambanta, don haka jadawalin suna daidaito game da x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.model.1: Daidaito game da x-axis ne. Canza tushe yana mayar da log_{1/2}x zuwa −log_2x, wato batu (x,y) ya koma (x,−y).
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.model.2: Suna daidaito game da x-axis. y=log_{1/2}x daidai yake da y=−log_2x, don haka ƙimomin y suna da alamomi kishiyoyi.

n-m-h2-explog-05.title: Bayyana wa aboki dalilin da ya sa muka watsar da t=−1
n-m-h2-explog-05.goal: Idan kana warware ma’aunin exponential ta maye gurbi, yi amfani da kewayon harafin da aka maye gurbin domin bayyana dalilin watsar da mafita da kalmomi masu sauƙi.
n-m-h2-explog-05.material: Ga bayanan Jiho yayin warware 4^x−3·2^x−4=0: “A sa 2^x=t. Sai t²−3t−4=0, (t−4)(t+1)=0, don haka t=4 ko t=−1. t=−1 bai dace ba, sai mu watsar da shi; daga 2^x=4, x=2.” Sora ta ga bayanan ta tambaya, “Me ya sa kake watsar da t=−1 kawai? Ina ganin akwai yiwuwar x ya cika 2^x=−1.”
n-m-h2-explog-05.thinking.0: Sanin kewayon ƙimar harafin da aka maye gurbin
n-m-h2-explog-05.thinking.1: Mayar da jimlar warwarewa mai kauri zuwa kalmomi masu sauƙi
n-m-h2-explog-05.thinking.2: Aiwatar da shi a irin wannan yanayi
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.prompt: Idan ka sa 2^x=t, zaɓi madaidaicin kewayon ƙimomin da t zai iya ɗauka.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.hint.0: Saka lambobin cikakku, lambobi marasa kyau da 0 a matsayin x, sannan ka rubuta wasu ƙimomin 2^x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.hint.1: Duba kewayon da ƙimomin da ka rubuta suke, ka yi tunanin ko akwai x da ke ba da 0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi tunanin cewa 0 ma yana yiwuwa. Akwai x da 2^x=0?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.b: Ka san 2^x yana ɗaukar ƙimomi mafi girma da 0 kawai.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.c: Ka manta yanayin da 2^x ya yi ƙasa da 1 idan x mara kyau ne.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.d: Ka manta aikin exponential ba zai iya ɗaukar ƙima mara kyau ba.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.explain: Ga kowace lambar ainihi x, 2^x yana ɗaukar ƙimomi mafi girma da 0 kawai. Idan x ya yi ƙanƙanta sosai, 2^x yana kusantar 0 amma ba ya zama 0. Saboda haka kewayon t=2^x shi ne t>0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta wa Sora amsa. Sake faɗin “t=−1 bai dace ba, sai mu watsar da shi” domin Sora ta fahimta, sannan bayyana dalilin da ya sa babu x da 2^x=−1. (Kimanin jimloli 3)
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.hint.0: Fara da kalmomin da Sora ta sani. Ka ba da misalan ƙimomin da ake samu idan aka saka wasu ƙimomin x cikin 2^x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.hint.1: Maimakon “bai dace ba,” saka kewayon ƙimomin da 2^x zai iya ɗauka a jimlarka.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka yi amfani da kalmomin da Sora ta sani, misali ƙimomin da ake samu ta saka x cikin 2^x?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka ba da takamaiman dalili maimakon “bai dace ba”?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka nuna dalilin da ya sa za a iya amfani da t=4?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.model.0: Sora, idan kika saka x=1, 0, −3 cikin 2^x, za ki samu 2, 1, 1/8, dukkansu sun fi 0. Ko ta yaya kika canza x, 2^x ba ya zama mara kyau, saboda haka babu x da 2^x=−1. Muna watsar da t=−1 mu yi amfani da t=4 kawai.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.model.1: Ko sau nawa ka ninka ko raba 2, kana samun lamba tabbatacciya. 2^x yana ɗaukar ƙimomi mafi girma da 0 kawai, don haka 2^x=−1 ba zai yiwu ba. t=4 tabbatacce ne, yana ba da x=2.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.model.2: t=2^x koyaushe tabbatacce ne. Idan ka samu lamba mara kyau kamar t=−1, babu x da zai samar da ita. Wannan ba kuskure ba ne wajen warwarewa; haka yanayin 2^x yake.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.prompt: Zaɓi adadin mafita na ainihi na 9^x−2·3^x−3=0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.hint.0: A sa 3^x=t, warware ma’aunin ta amfani da t, sannan nemo duk ƙimomin t.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.hint.1: Ga kowace ƙimar t da ka samu, duba ko akwai x da 3^x=t.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.a: Ka haɗa ƙimomin t biyun da x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.b: Ka manta yanayin t tabbatacce ne. Duba ƙimomin t da ka samu ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.c: Ka lura t=−1 ba shi da mafita kuma t=3 kaɗai ake amfani da shi.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.d: Sake ƙirga alaƙar adadin mafitar t da adadin mafitar x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.explain: Idan muka sa 3^x=t, to t²−2t−3=(t−3)(t+1)=0. t=3 yana ba da x=1 daga 3^x=3; t=−1 ba shi da mafita domin 3^x>0. Saboda haka mafita ta ainihi ɗaya ce, x=1.

n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.prompt: Informasi dibuka saeutik-saeutik. Dina unggal léngkah, pilih pamadegan dumasar kana hal anu geus dipikanyaho.
n-m-h2-diff-04.title: Ta yaya ake ƙayyade yawan tushen ainihi?
n-m-h2-diff-04.topic: Siffar jadawalin aikin cubic da tushen ainihi na lissafi.
n-m-h2-diff-04.goal: Duk lokacin da aka ƙara bayani, sake duba hukuncinka kan yawan tushen ainihi dabam na lissafin cubic, sannan bayyana iyakar da alamomi da yawan ƙimomin tsattsauran suka canza.
n-m-h2-diff-04.material: Yi la'akari da yawan tushen ainihi dabam na lissafin cubic x³−3x²+k=0 (k madaidaiciya ce). Bari f(x)=x³−3x²+k, sannan yanke hukunci duk lokacin da aka bayyana wani bayani.
n-m-h2-diff-04.thinking.0: Jinkirta hukunci idan bayanin bai isa ba.
n-m-h2-diff-04.thinking.1: Karanta yawan tushen ainihi daga siffar jadawali.
n-m-h2-diff-04.thinking.2: Duba ƙimar iyaka inda adadin ke sauyawa, kowannensu dabam.
n-m-h2-diff-04.prereq.0: Mafi girma da mafi ƙaranci na gida na aikin cubic da siffar jadawalinsa.
n-m-h2-diff-04.prereq.1: Tushen ainihi na lissafi da wuraren da jadawali ke haɗuwa da axis x.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.hint.0: Duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya fito, yi la'akari ko hukuncinka yana buƙatar sauyawa.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ka hango sau nawa jadawali ke ketare axis x bisa alamomin mafi girman gida da mafi ƙarancin gida.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.info: f(x)=x³−3x²+k aikin cubic ne mai babban ma'auni tabbatacce, kuma har yanzu ba a san ƙimar k ba.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Lambobin tushen ainihi dabam nawa ne lissafin f(x)=0 yake da su?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ɓangarorin biyu na jadawalin cubic an kayyade su, ɗaya yana hawa ɗaya yana sauka, saboda haka ya haɗu da axis x aƙalla sau ɗaya. Amma yawan haɗuwar ya danganta da inda ƙimomin mafi girman gida da mafi ƙarancin gida suke.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kullum 3 ne, ko wace ƙima ce k.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ya rikita gaskiyar algebra cewa lissafin cubic yana da tushen 3 da yawan tushen ainihi dabam.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Yana iya zama 1, 2, ko 3, ya danganta da k.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ya lura cewa yawan lokutan da jadawali ke haɗuwa da axis x na iya bambanta bisa k.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ya yi iƙirarin cewa jadawalin yana yanke axis na x sau ɗaya kawai.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ba za mu iya cewa komai ba domin ba mu san k ba.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ba ma ya faɗi kewayon yiwuwar adadin ba. Siffar aikin cubic tana ba da wasu bayanai.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.info: f'(x)=3x(x−2), saboda haka akwai mafi girman ƙima ta gida a x=0 da mafi ƙarancin ƙima ta gida a x=2. Ƙimar mafi girma ita ce f(0)=k, ta mafi ƙanƙanta kuma f(2)=k−4.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Idan k=1, tushen ainihi nawa ne daban-daban?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Idan k=1, mafi girman ƙimar gida ita ce 1 (tabbatacciya), mafi ƙaranci kuma −3 (marar kyau). Jadawalin yana tashi daga hagu, ya yanke axis na x, ya kai mafi girman ƙimar gida, ya sauko ya sake yanke axis, ya kai mafi ƙaranci, sannan ya sake tashi ya yanke axis. Don haka akwai tushen ainihi 3 daban-daban.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ya lura kawai cewa mafi girman ƙimar gida 1 tabbatacciya ce, sai ya yi tunanin jadawalin ya haɗu da axis sau ɗaya.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Yana tunanin yanayin da jadawalin ya taɓa axis na x. Hakan yana faruwa ne kawai idan ƙimar tsattsauran ta zama 0 daidai.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ya lura cewa mafi girman ƙimar gida tabbatacciya ce, mafi ƙaranci kuma marar kyau, saboda haka jadawalin yana yanke axis na x sau uku.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ana buƙatar ƙarin bayani domin sani.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Idan k=1, an ƙayyade duka mafi girman ƙimar gida da mafi ƙarancinta.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Canza k yana matsar da jadawalin sama ko ƙasa; saboda haka alamun mafi girman ƙimar gida k da mafi ƙaranci k−4 sun dogara da k, kuma akwai lokutan da ɗayansu ya zama 0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Wace ƙimar k ce za ta ba da tushen ainihi 2 daban-daban daidai?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Idan k=0, f(x)=x²(x−3), don haka tushen su ne x=0 (wurin taɓawa) da x=3. Idan k=4, f(x)=(x+1)(x−2)², tushen su ne x=−1 da x=2 (wurin taɓawa). A duka yanayin akwai tushen ainihi 2 daban-daban. Jadawalin yana taɓa axis na x daidai lokacin da ƙimar tsattsauran ta zama 0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ya duba yanayin da mafi girman ƙimar gida ta zama 0 kawai. Akwai kuma yanayin da mafi ƙarancin ƙimar gida ta zama 0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ya duba yanayin da mafi ƙarancin ƙimar gida ta zama 0 kawai. Akwai kuma yanayin da mafi girman ƙimar gida ta zama 0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan kewayon yana nuna ƙimomin tsattsauran suna da alamomi kishiyoyi, saboda haka akwai tushen ainihi 3.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.reflect: Da farko, domin ba mu san k ba, abin da muka sani kawai shi ne adadin tushen ainihi na iya bambanta. Bayan mun nemo ƙimomin tsattsauran, mun iya tantance adadin idan k=1; mun kuma ga iyakar da adadin ke sauyawa daga 3 zuwa 2 a lokacin da ƙimar tsattsauran ta zama 0. Ana iya tantance adadin tushen ainihi na ma’auni ta jadawali da alamun ƙimomin tsattsauran.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta kewayon k da zai ba da tushen ainihi 3 daban-daban, ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ba a haɗa ƙimomin iyaka k=0 da k=4 ba.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta alamun da mafi girman ƙimar gida da mafi ƙarancin ƙimar gida dole su kasance da su domin jadawalin ya yanke axis na x sau uku.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.hint.1: Raba f(x) zuwa abubuwa idan k=0 da idan k=4, sannan ka nemo tushen kai tsaye.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta sharadin alamar mafi girman ƙimar gida da mafi ƙarancinta?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka bincika kai tsaye adadin tushen da ake samu a ƙimomin iyaka?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.model.0: Mafi girman ƙimar gida k dole ta zama tabbatacciya, mafi ƙarancin ƙimar gida k−4 kuma marar kyau; saboda haka 0<k<4. Idan k=0 ko k=4, wata ƙimar tsattsauran tana zama 0, jadawalin ya taɓa axis na x, kuma tushen ainihi 2 daban-daban ne kawai.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.model.1: 0<k<4. Mafi girman ƙimar gida dole ta kasance sama da axis na x, mafi ƙaranci kuma ƙasa da shi, domin jadawalin ya yanke shi sau uku. A ƙimomin iyaka 0 da 4, tushen ninki biyu yana bayyana, don haka tushen daban-daban 2 ne kawai; saboda haka ba a haɗa iyakokin.

n-m-h2-limit-03.title: Alaƙar alamun ƙimomin iyaka da tushen cikin kewayo
n-m-h2-limit-03.topic: Limits da continuity na ayyuka: akasin Intermediate Value Theorem
n-m-h2-limit-03.goal: Bambanta abin da Intermediate Value Theorem ke tabbatarwa (sharadi isasshe) da abin da ba ya tabbatarwa; ƙirƙiri ka gwada misali inda akasin theorem bai tabbata ba.
n-m-h2-limit-03.material: Ga aiki continuous f, Intermediate Value Theorem ya ce, “Idan f(0)f(4)<0, to akwai x a (0, 4) da f(x)=0.” Doyun ya yi iƙirarin, “To idan f(0)f(4)>0, babu tushe a (0, 4).”
n-m-h2-limit-03.thinking.1: Gina misalai da dama da suka cika sharuddan
n-m-h2-limit-03.prereq.0: Intermediate Value Theorem ga ayyukan continuous
n-m-h2-limit-03.prereq.1: Jadawalin ayyukan quadratic da wuraren tushen
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.prompt: Domin nuna iƙirarin Doyun ƙarya ne, wane irin aiki continuous ya kamata ka nema?
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.hint.1: Yi tunanin abin da zato da ƙarshe dole su zama domin iƙirarin ya zama ƙarya.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.o.a: Aiki continuous mai f(0)f(4)<0, amma ba shi da tushe a (0, 4).
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.r.a: Saboda Intermediate Value Theorem, irin wannan aiki ba zai wanzu ba. Idan theorem daidai ne, ba za ka iya samunsa ba.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.o.b: Aiki continuous mai f(0)f(4)>0, amma ba shi da tushe a (0, 4).
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.r.b: Wannan misali ya dace da iƙirarin Doyun, don haka ba ya karya shi.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.o.c: Aiki continuous mai f(0)f(4)<0 kuma yana da tushe a (0, 4).
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.r.c: Wannan yanayi theorem ya tabbatar, don haka ba shi da alaƙa da iƙirarin.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.o.d: Aiki continuous mai f(0)f(4)>0 kuma yana da tushe a (0, 4).
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.explain: Domin nuna iƙirarin “idan ..., to ...” ƙarya ne, kana buƙatar misali da ya cika zato amma ya gaza ƙarshe: wato yana da tushe a (0, 4) duk da f(0)f(4)>0.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.prompt: A sa f(x)=(x−a)(x−b). Shigar da nau’i-nau’i biyu daban-daban (a,b) da f(0)f(4)>0 kuma f(x)=0 yana da tushen ainihi biyu daban-daban cikin (0, 4). (a<b)
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta f(0) da f(4) ta a,b, ka nemo inda tushen dole su kasance domin ƙimomin biyu su sami alama iri ɗaya.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi tushen ɗaya cikin (0, 4), integer ko decimal, sannan zaɓi ɗayan tushen tsakanin na farko da gefen kewayo, ka tabbatar da lissafi kai tsaye.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.explain: f(0)=ab, f(4)=(4−a)(4−b); idan tushen biyun suna tsakanin 0 da 4, dukkansu tabbatattu ne. Don haka ko f(0)f(4)>0 ne, akwai tushen biyu cikin (0, 4). Jadawalin yana nutsewa ƙasa da axis na x sannan ya dawo sama.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Ko da irin wannan misali, Intermediate Value Theorem ba kuskure ba ne. Bayyana dalili a jimla ɗaya ko biyu.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sake faɗi alkiblar theorem: wane abu ke tabbatar da wanne?
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Yi tunanin ko jimla da aka juya alkiblarta tana da ma’ana iri ɗaya.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana alkiblar theorem da kalmomi daidai?
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka nuna misalin ba ya saɓa wa theorem?
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Intermediate Value Theorem yana cewa idan alamomi sun bambanta, akwai tushe. Ba ya cewa babu tushe idan alamomi iri ɗaya ne; saboda haka jadawali da ya yanke axis na x sau biyu ba ya saɓa wa theorem.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Akasin theorem ba tabbatacce ba ne. Ko ƙimomin iyaka suna da alama iri ɗaya, jadawali na iya ketare axis na x a tsakiya ya dawo, saboda haka tushe na iya wanzuwa.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.model.2: Theorem yana cewa kawai “idan alamomi sun bambanta, akwai tushe.” Ba ya cewa “idan akwai tushe, alamomi sun bambanta.”
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.model.3: Abin da theorem ke faɗa ya tsaya ga “idan alamomi sun bambanta, akwai tushe.” Ba yana nufin wannan ne kaɗai yanayin tushen ba.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.prompt: Zaɓi duk ayyukan da Intermediate Value Theorem kaɗai ke ba ka damar tabbatar akwai x a (0, 4) da f(x)=0.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.hint.0: Ga kowane aiki, binciki alamun f(0) da f(4), da ko akwai tazara a [0, 4].
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta sharuɗɗa biyu da theorem ke buƙata domin tabbatar da tushe, kwatanta kowane zaɓi da su.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.r.a: f(0)=4 da f(4)=4 suna da alama iri ɗaya, zato na theorem bai cika ba. Ko x=2 tushe ne, theorem bai tabbatar da shi ba.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.r.c: Alamun f(0) da f(4) sun bambanta, amma f ba continuous ba ne a x=2, don haka ba za a yi amfani da theorem ba. A zahiri tushe ma babu.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.explain: Ga b, f(0)=−1, f(4)=3, kuma aikin polynomial ne, saboda haka continuous ne kuma theorem ya tabbatar da tushe. Haka ma d: f(0)=−3, f(4)=5 kuma continuous ne. Ga a, f(0)=4 da f(4)=4 suna da alama ɗaya, don haka theorem ba ya aiki (tushen x=2 yana wanzu amma theorem bai tabbatar ba). Ga c, alamomi sun bambanta amma f yana da tazara a x=2 kuma ba continuous ba ne, don haka theorem ba ya aiki.

n-m-h2-trig-10.title: Girman kusurwa da ƙimar rabon trigonometrik a cikin alwatika
n-m-h2-trig-10.goal: A ƙarƙashin sharadin cewa A, B, C kusurwoyin cikin alwatika ne, tantance ko kwatanta girman kusurwoyi yana ba da kwatanta sin, cos, tan a wace alkibla, sannan ka ba da dalilai ta amfani da ka’idar sinayini da kusurwoyi marasa kaifi.
n-m-h2-trig-10.material: Ɗalibai huɗu sun yi waɗannan iƙirari game da kusurwoyin cikin alwatika ABC, wato A, B, C. Ka yi la’akari da yanayin da ƙimomin rabon trigonometrik suke da ma’ana kawai.
n-m-h2-trig-10.thinking.0: Tantance ko magana gaskiya ce ko ƙarya a ƙarƙashin sharuɗɗanta
n-m-h2-trig-10.thinking.1: Haɗa kusurwoyi da gefuna ta amfani da ka’idar sinayini
n-m-h2-trig-10.prereq.1: Ka’idar cewa gefen da ke gaban kusurwa mafi girma shi ne mafi tsawo
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk iƙirarin da suke daidai koyaushe a cikin alwatika ABC.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.hint.0: Saka takamaiman kusurwoyi (30°, 100° da sauransu) a maimakon A da B a kowane iƙirari.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.hint.1: Yi amfani da ka’idar sinayini don mayar da sinA da sinB zuwa tsawon gefuna, sannan ka rubuta yadda kwatancin ya kasance.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.a: Wannan yana cewa kusurwa mafi girma tana da ƙimar sin mafi girma. Za ka iya bincika ta wajen kwatanta tsawon gefunan da ke gaban waɗannan kusurwoyi ta ka’idar sinayini.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.b: Wannan yana cewa ƙimar cos mafi girma tana nufin kusurwa mafi girma. Duba yadda ƙimar cos ke sauyawa yayin da kusurwa ke ƙaruwa daga 0° zuwa 180°.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.c: Ka mayar da kwatancin ƙimomin sin zuwa tsawon gefuna domin kwatanta su, sannan ka yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa gefen mafi tsawo yana gaban kusurwa mafi girma.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.d: Ka yi watsi da gaskiyar cewa kusurwar alwatika na iya zama maras kaifi. Kwatanta ƙimomin tan idan A=30° kuma B=100°.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.explain: Ta ka’idar sinayini, a=2R·sinA kuma b=2R·sinB, don haka sinA>sinB daidai yake da a>b; kuma tun da gefen mafi tsawo yana gaban kusurwa mafi girma, wannan ma daidai yake da A>B. Saboda haka a da c dukansu daidai ne. Idan cosA>cosB, to A<B, saboda haka b ya juya baya. Tan yana da ƙima mara kyau ga kusurwa maras kaifi; don haka idan A=30° kuma B=100°, tanA>tanB amma A<B, wanda ya sa d ƙarya ne.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.prompt: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa “idan sinA>sinB, to A>B” yake aiki a alwatika (c), sannan ka ba da misalin da ya karyata (d).
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.hint.0: Sake rubuta sinA da sinB a matsayin tsawon gefuna ta amfani da ka’idar sinayini.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.hint.1: Ka ɗauka ɗaya daga cikin A da B kusurwa maras kaifi ce, sannan ka yi la’akari da alamar ƙimar tan.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: ta ka’idar sinayini ... Misalin da ya karyata: A=..., B=...
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka mayar da kwatancin ƙimomin sin zuwa kwatancin tsawon gefuna?
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Da gaske ka kwatanta ƙimomin tan A da tan B?
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: A cikin misalinka da ya karyata, ka nuna cewa A<B amma tanA>tanB?
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.model.0: Ta ka’idar sinayini, a=2R sinA kuma b=2R sinB, don haka idan sinA>sinB, to a>b. Gefen mafi tsawo yana gaban kusurwa mafi girma, saboda haka A>B. Misali na ƙaryata magana: A=30°, B=100°. Tan30° yana da ƙima mai kyau, amma tan100° yana da ƙima mara kyau; saboda haka tanA>tanB duk da cewa A<B.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.model.1: Idan sinA>sinB, to bisa ka’idar sinayini gefe a ya fi tsawon gefe b, sannan A ya fi B girma. Tan yana da ƙima mara kyau ga kusurwa maras kaifi; misali, idan A=45° kuma B=120°, to tanA=1>tanB=−√3 amma A<B.

n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin farko a mafitar Jiho da ba daidai ba.
n-m-h2-diff-01.title: Duba mafitar da ke nemo layin tangent da yake tsaye daidai da wani layi.
n-m-h2-diff-01.topic: Lissafin layin tangent: gangaren layin da yake tsaye daidai.
n-m-h2-diff-01.goal: A mafitar da ke nemo tangent ga lanƙwasa da yake tsaye daidai da layin da aka bayar, nemo layin farko da ya yi kuskure, gyara shi, sannan ka duba ta amfani da samfurin gangaren layukan.
n-m-h2-diff-01.material: Wannan ita ce mafitar Jiho wajen nemo, cikin layukan tangent da aka zana a wuraren lanƙwasa y=x²−4x+5, wanda yake tsaye daidai da layin y=x/2+1. (x² na nufin x a murabba'i, kuma x/2 na nufin x bisa 2.)
n-m-h2-diff-01.thinking.0: Bi layukan mafitar ɗaya bayan ɗaya domin nemo layin farko da bai dace ba.
n-m-h2-diff-01.thinking.1: Mayar da sharadin layukan da suke tsaye daidai zuwa alaƙar gangarensu.
n-m-h2-diff-01.thinking.2: Duba layin tangent da aka gyara.
n-m-h2-diff-01.prereq.0: Cewa ƙimar derivative ita ce gangaren layin tangent.
n-m-h2-diff-01.prereq.1: Alaƙar gangare idan layuka biyu suna tsaye daidai.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.hint.0: Duba ɗaya bayan ɗaya yadda aka samo kowane layi daga layin da ke gabansa.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo yadda aka mayar da kalmar "tsaye daidai" zuwa alaƙa a cikin lissafi.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.line.0: Da yake f(x)=x²−4x+5, f'(x)=2x−4. (Ana karanta f' da "f prime.")
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.line.1: Da yake yana tsaye daidai da layin y=x/2+1, gangaren layin tangent shi ne −1/2.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.line.3: Wurin taɓawa shi ne (7/4, 17/16), kuma layin tangent y=−(1/2)(x−7/4)+17/16 ne.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 2 ne na farko da bai dace ba. Idan layuka biyu suna tsaye daidai, samfurin gangarensu −1 ne. Gangaren layin da yake tsaye daidai da layin mai gangare 1/2 ba −1/2 ba ne, domin hakan yana sauya alama kawai; ana buƙatar lambar da samfurinta da 1/2 zai zama −1. Lissafin layuka 3 da 4 sun bi layi na 2, saboda haka lissafin kansa daidai ne amma sakamakon ya sauya.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.prompt: Gyara layin da bai dace ba, nemo ƙimar x ta wurin taɓawa da lissafin layin tangent.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.hint.0: Zana layin da yake tsaye daidai da layi mai gangare 1/2, sannan zaɓi wasu lambobin da za su iya zama gangaren kuma gwada su ta hanyar ninka da 1/2.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.hint.1: Daidaita sabon gangare da f'(x) ka nemo x, sannan nemo ƙimar y ta wannan wuri daga f(x).
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta sharadin tsayuwa daidai a matsayin samfurin gangare?
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka nemo ƙimar y ta wurin taɓawa daga lissafin lanƙwasa?
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka rubuta lissafin layin tangent da siffar y=…?
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.model.0: Idan layuka suna tsaye daidai, samfurin gangarensu −1 ne, don haka (1/2)×m=−1 kuma m=−2. Daga 2x−4=−2, x=1, kuma f(1)=2, saboda haka wurin taɓawa (1, 2) ne, layin tangent kuma y=−2x+4 ne.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.model.1: Layin da yake tsaye daidai da mai gangare 1/2 yana da gangare −2. x da f'(x)=−2 ke da shi shi ne 1, wurin taɓawa kuma (1,2) ne. Sauƙaƙa y−2=−2(x−1) yana ba da y=−2x+4.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.prompt: A mafitar Jiho, wane dubawa ne zai fi sauri gano wannan kuskuren?
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko tuna lissafin da ke tsakanin gangaren layuka biyu masu tsaye daidai.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.hint.1: Saka kowane zaɓi kai tsaye cikin gangaren Jiho biyu, 1/2 da −1/2.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.o.a: Haɗa gangaren biyu ka duba ko jimillarsu 0 ce.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.r.a: Jimilla 0 alaƙa ce inda gangaren ke da alamomi akasin juna kawai. Ta fi kama da nuna juyi a axis x fiye da tsayuwa daidai.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.o.b: Duba kawai ko gangaren biyu suna da alamomi akasin juna.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.r.b: Alamomi akasin juna sharadi dole ne amma ba su wadatar ba. Girman gangaren ma dole ya dace domin layukan su tsaya daidai.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.o.c: Ninka gangaren biyu ka duba ko samfurinsu −1 ne.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.r.c: Wannan yana gwada ma'anar tsayuwa daidai kai tsaye ta hanyar ninkawa.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.o.d: Duba ko ƙimar y ta wurin taɓawa tana kan lanƙwasa.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.r.d: Ko da wurin taɓawa yana kan lanƙwasa, wannan dubawa ba zai gaya maka ko gangaren ya cika sharadin tsayuwa daidai ba.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.explain: (1/2)×(−1/2)=−1/4, wanda ba −1 ba ne. Duba ko samfurin −1 ne yana bayyana kuskuren layi na 2 nan take.

n-m-h2-diff-02.title: Idan matsakaicin ƙimar canji tabbatacciya ce, shin aikin yana ci gaba da ƙaruwa a dukkan zangon?
n-m-h2-diff-02.topic: Matsakaicin ƙimar canji da ayyuka masu ƙaruwa/raguwa.
n-m-h2-diff-02.goal: Tabbatar da aikin quadratic da ka ƙirƙira da kanka cewa ko da matsakaicin ƙimar canji a zango tabbatacciya ce, wani ɓangaren aikin cikin zangon na iya raguwa.
n-m-h2-diff-02.material: Youngwoo ya ce, "Idan matsakaicin ƙimar canjin aiki f a zangon [0, 4] tabbatacciya ce, to f yana ƙaruwa a wannan zango." Kana son gwada wannan da ayyukan siffar f(x)=x²−bx (b madaidaiciya ce).
n-m-h2-diff-02.thinking.0: Raba da'awar zuwa zato da ƙarshe.
n-m-h2-diff-02.thinking.1: Rubuta sharuɗɗan misalin ƙarya a matsayin lissafi.
n-m-h2-diff-02.thinking.2: Bambanta kwatanta ƙarshen zangon biyu da canjin da ke cikin zangon.
n-m-h2-diff-02.prereq.0: Ma'ana da lissafin matsakaicin ƙimar canji.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.prompt: Domin nuna cewa da'awar Youngwoo ƙarya ce, wane irin aiki ya kamata mu nema?
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.hint.0: Raba da'awar Youngwoo da siffar "idan zato, to ƙarshe" sannan rubuta ta.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.hint.1: Yi tunanin abin da zato da ƙarshe kowannensu dole ya kasance domin da'awar ta zama ƙarya.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.o.a: Aiki mai matsakaicin ƙimar canji mara kyau wanda ke ƙaruwa a dukkan zangon.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.r.a: Irin wannan aiki ba zai wanzu ba. Haka kuma ba shi da alaƙa da da'awar.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.o.b: Aiki mai matsakaicin ƙimar canji tabbatacciya wanda yake da wani ɓangaren raguwa a cikin zangon.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.o.c: Aiki mai matsakaicin ƙimar canji tabbatacciya wanda yake ƙaruwa a dukkan zangon.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.r.c: Wannan misali ya dace da da'awar, saboda haka ba zai iya karya ta ba.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.o.d: Aiki mai matsakaicin ƙimar canji 0 wanda yake tsayayye a dukkan zangon.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.r.d: Matsakaicin ƙimar canji ba tabbatacciya ba ce, saboda haka bai cika zato na da'awar ba.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.explain: Domin nuna ƙarya ga da'awar siffar "idan ~, to ~", kana buƙatar misali da ya cika zato (matsakaicin ƙimar canji tabbatacciya ce) amma ya karya ƙarshe (aikin yana ƙaruwa a zangon).
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.prompt: Ga f(x)=x²−bx, shigar da b da p ta yadda matsakaicin ƙimar canji a [0, 4] tabbatacciya ce, amma a wani wuri p cikin (0, 4), f'(p)<0 ne (aikin yana raguwa kusa da wannan wuri). Yi misalai 3 masu ƙimomin b dabam.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko bayyana f(0) da f(4) ta amfani da b, sannan nemo zangon b da matsakaicin ƙimar canji yake tabbatacce.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi ƙimar b guda ɗaya, ka nemo inda cikin zangon f'(x)=2x−b yake zama mara kyau.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Matsakaicin ƙimar canji (f(4)−f(0))/4 ba tabbatacciya ba ce.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.fail.c2: p dole ya fi 0 kuma ya kasa 4.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.ok.c3: f'(p)=2p−b mara kyau ne, saboda haka f yana raguwa kusa da p.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.fail.c3: f'(p)=2p−b ba mara kyau ba ne.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.explain: f(4)−f(0)=16−4b, saboda haka matsakaicin ƙimar canji 4−b ne. Domin ta zama tabbatacciya, b<4 ake buƙata; domin f'(x)=2x−b ta zama mara kyau a wani wuri cikin zangon, ana buƙatar b>0. Don haka kowane b mai 0<b<4 yana ba da misalin ƙarya. Misali, idan b=2, f(x)=x²−2x yana raguwa a [0, 1] kuma yana ƙaruwa a [1, 4].
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Ko da irin waɗannan misalai suna wanzuwa, cewa matsakaicin ƙimar canji tabbatacciya ce ba bayanin ƙarya ba ne. Bayyana a jimloli 1 ko 2 abin da za ka iya sani da abin da ba za ka iya sani ba daga matsakaicin ƙimar canji tabbatacciya.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sake duba waɗanne ƙimomin zangon ake amfani da su wajen lissafa matsakaicin ƙimar canji.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Kwatanta ƙimomin f(1), f(0), da f(4), sannan ka zana yadda jadawalin ya motsa.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka ce ƙimomi biyu kaɗai na ƙarshen zangon ake amfani da su wajen matsakaicin ƙimar canji?
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka bambanta canjin cikin zangon da kwatanta ƙarshen zangon?
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Matsakaicin ƙimar canji yana samuwa ne ta kwatanta ƙimomin ƙarshen zangon biyu kawai, saboda haka yana gaya mana kawai cewa f(4)>f(0). Ko da jadawali ya sauka a wani wuri a tsakiya, matsakaicin yana tabbatacce idan ya ƙaru sosai kafin ƙarshen.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Idan matsakaicin ƙimar canji tabbatacciya ce, za ka iya sanin cewa ƙimar ƙarshen zangon ta fi ta farkon, amma ba za ka iya sanin ko ta ɗan ragu a tsakiyar zangon ba.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.prompt: Idan abin da ka sani kawai shi ne matsakaicin ƙimar canjin f a [0, 4] tabbatacciya ce, wane abu ne dole ya zama gaskiya?
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta tsarin lissafin matsakaicin ƙimar canji, ka yi la'akari da alamar mai ƙididdigewa.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.hint.1: Gwada gaskiya ko ƙarya ta kowane zaɓi ta saka shi cikin misalan da ka ƙirƙira a s2.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.o.a: f'(x)>0 ga kowane x a cikin zangon.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.r.a: Ko da matsakaicin ƙimar canji tabbatacciya ce, f' na iya zama mara kyau a wani wuri a cikin zangon.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.o.b: f ba shi da ɓangaren raguwa a [0, 4].
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.r.b: Akwai yiwuwar ɓangaren raguwa, kamar misalin da ka ƙirƙira a s2.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.o.c: f(x)>0 ga kowane x a cikin zangon.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.r.c: Matsakaicin ƙimar canji tana nuna yawan canji, ba alamar ƙimomin aikin ba.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.explain: Idan matsakaicin ƙimar canji (f(4)−f(0))/(4−0) tabbatacciya ce, mai ƙididdigewa tabbatacce ne, saboda haka f(4)−f(0) ma tabbatacce ne. Abin da kawai za ka sani shi ne kwatancen ƙarshen zangon.

n-m-h2-diff-03.title: Ma'anar lanƙwasa biyu da suke tangent a wuri guda.
n-m-h2-diff-03.topic: Sharadin lanƙwasa biyu su zama tangent.
n-m-h2-diff-03.goal: Nemo yawan lissafe-lissafen da sharadin "lanƙwasa biyu suna tangent a wuri guda" yake bayarwa, sannan bambanta lokacin da sharuɗɗan ba su wadatar da lokacin da suka wadatar.
n-m-h2-diff-03.material: Lanƙwasa y=f(x)=x³ da y=g(x)=x²+ax+b (a da b madaidaita ne) suna tangent a wurin (1, 1). (Wannan yana nufin lanƙwasa biyun sun wuce wuri guda kuma suna da layin tangent iri ɗaya a wurin.) Kana son nemo a da b.
n-m-h2-diff-03.thinking.0: Mayar da sharuɗɗan da aka bayar zuwa lissafe-lissafi.
n-m-h2-diff-03.thinking.1: Bambanta sharuɗɗan dole da waɗanda ba su wadatar ba.
n-m-h2-diff-03.thinking.2: Kwatanta yawan abubuwan da ba a sani ba da yawan lissafe-lissafe.
n-m-h2-diff-03.prereq.0: Ƙimar derivative da gangaren layin tangent.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.prompt: Waɗanne lissafe-lissafe na g ya kamata ka kafa domin ƙayyade a da b?
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta a matsayin lissafe-lissafe abubuwa biyu (wuri, gangare) da ake buƙata domin lanƙwasa biyu su zama tangent a wuri guda.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.hint.1: Saka x=1 cikin f(x)=x³ domin nemo ƙimar y ta wurin da gangaren layin tangent.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.r.a: Sharadin wucewa ta wurin (1, 1) daidai ne, amma g(0)=0 sharadi ne da ba ya cikin matsalar.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.r.b: Sharadin wucewa ta (1, 1) daidai ne, amma dole a duba gangare a wurin tangent x=1, ba x=0 ba.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.r.d: Ya musanya ƙimomin f(1) da f'(1). Dole ne ka bambanta ƙimar y ta wurin da gangaren layin tangent.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.explain: Lanƙwasa g dole ta wuce wurin (1, 1), don haka g(1)=1; domin layukan tangent su zama iri ɗaya, gangaren a x=1 ma dole su yi daidai, don haka g'(1)=f'(1)=3.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.prompt: Nemo ƙimomin a da b, sannan rubuta a layi guda yadda ka duba cewa ƙimomin da ka samo sun cika lissafe-lissafe biyun da aka kafa a s1.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko nemo g'(x), sannan daidaita ƙimarta a x=1 da 3.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.hint.1: Saka a da ka samo a cikin lissafin wucewa ta wurin domin nemo b.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta sharadin gangare da sharadin wuri kowannensu a matsayin lissafi?
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka saka a da b da ka samo a cikin lissafe-lissafen biyun?
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.model.0: g'(x)=2x+a, saboda haka g'(1)=2+a=3 yana ba da a=1. Saka a=1 cikin g(1)=1+a+b=1 yana ba da b=−1. Dubawa: g(1)=1 kuma g'(1)=3, don haka daidai ne.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.model.1: Daga sharadin gangare 2+a=3, ana samun a=1; daga sharadin wucewa ta wurin, 1+1+b=1, don haka b=−1. Na duba ta mayar da ƙimomin cikin lissafe-lissafen biyun.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.prompt: A wannan karon ba ka san wurin tangent ba, kuma abin da kawai ka sani shi ne lanƙwasa y=x³ da y=x²+ax+b ‘suna tangent a wani wuri.’ A wannan yanayin, ana iya ƙayyade a da b?
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.hint.0: Bari t ya zama ƙimar x ta wurin tangent, sannan ka rubuta lissafe-lissafe biyu na tangent.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.hint.1: Ƙirga yawan abubuwan da ba a sani ba da yawan lissafe-lissafe, ka kwatanta su.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.o.a: Ba a ƙayyade ba. Ƙimar x t ta wurin tangent ma ba a sani ba, saboda haka akwai abubuwa 3 da ba a sani ba amma lissafe-lissafe 2 kawai.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.o.b: An ƙayyade. Sharadin tangent yana bayar da lissafe-lissafe 2, saboda haka ana iya nemo a da b.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.r.b: Ka rasa cewa da yake ba a san wurin tangent ba, ƙimar x ɗinsa ma ta zama sabon abin da ba a sani ba.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.o.c: Ba a ƙayyade ba. Sharadin tangent yana bayar da lissafi guda ɗaya kawai.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.r.c: Sharadin tangent yana bayar da wuri da gangare, wato lissafe-lissafe biyu. Ba ka ƙirga lissafe-lissafen daidai ba.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.o.d: An ƙayyade. Domin tangent, dole b=0 ne, sannan a ma yana da ƙima guda ɗaya.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.r.d: Babu tushen cewa dole b ya zama 0 a cikin matsalar. Idan ba a san wurin tangent ba, b ma yana iya sauyawa.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.explain: Idan ƙimar x ta wurin tangent t ce, to t³=t²+at+b kuma 3t²=2t+a, saboda haka akwai lissafe-lissafe biyu da abubuwa uku da ba a sani ba: a,b,t. Misali, t=1 yana ba da (a,b)=(1,−1), kuma t=2 yana ba da (a,b)=(8,−12); duk lokacin da t ya canza, (a,b) dabam yake fitowa.

n-m-h2-diff-05.title: Shin layin tangent yana haɗuwa da lanƙwasa ne kawai a wurin taɓawa?
n-m-h2-diff-05.topic: Matsakaitan haɗuwar layin tangent da lanƙwasa
n-m-h2-diff-05.goal: Gwada iƙirarin “layin tangent yana haɗuwa da lanƙwasa ne kawai a wurin taɓawa” da lanƙwasar y=x³, sannan ka gyara ma’anar layin tangent a matsayin layin da gangarowarsa ita ce ƙimar derivative.
n-m-h2-diff-05.material: Hajun ya ce, “Layin tangent layi ne da ke haɗuwa da lanƙwasa a wurin taɓawa kawai. Idan ka zana tangent ya sake haɗuwa da lanƙwasa a wani wuri, ka yi tangent ɗin ba daidai ba.” Kana son gwada wannan iƙirari da lanƙwasar y=x³. (x³ na nufin x a matakin uku.)
n-m-h2-diff-05.thinking.0: Zaɓar misalai da za su iya gwada iƙirarin
n-m-h2-diff-05.thinking.1: Nemo wuraren haɗuwar layin tangent da lanƙwasa a wuraren taɓawa da dama
n-m-h2-diff-05.thinking.2: Gyara ma’anar layin tangent da kalmomi
n-m-h2-diff-05.prereq.0: Ƙimar derivative da ma’aunin layin tangent
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.prompt: Wace hanya ce ta fi dacewa don gwada iƙirarin Hajun?
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.hint.0: Bayyana da kalmomi yadda misalin da zai karya iƙirarin zai kasance.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.hint.1: Idan ka ɗauki wurin taɓawa a matsayin (a, a³), za ka iya rubuta ma’aunin layin tangent ta amfani da a.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.o.a: Zana layin tangent a asalin (0, 0) kawai, ka duba inda ya haɗu da lanƙwasar.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.r.a: Duba batu ɗaya kawai na iya nuna misalan da suka dace da iƙirarin kawai. Gwaji dole ne ya duba misalan da iƙirarin zai iya karyewa.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.o.b: Binciki layin tangent a wurin da gangarowarsa 0 kawai.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.r.b: Wurin da gangarowarsa 0 wani batu na musamman ne, don haka ba ya wakiltar wuraren taɓawa gaba ɗaya.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.o.c: Zana hoto, ka duba da ido ko layin tangent da lanƙwasar suna kama da haɗe.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.r.c: Siffar da ido kaɗai ya gani ba za ta nuna ko sun sake haɗuwa a nesa ba.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.o.d: Nemo layukan tangent a wuraren taɓawa (a, a³) da dama, ka binciki sauran wuraren haɗuwa.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.explain: Idan iƙirarin ba daidai ba ne, akwai layin tangent da ke haɗuwa da lanƙwasa a wani wuri ban da wurin taɓawa. Domin nemo shi, sai ka rubuta ma’aunin tangent a wuraren taɓawa da dama, ba ɗaya ko biyu kawai ba, sannan ka warware tare da ma’aunin lanƙwasar.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.prompt: Nemo ka shigar da nau’i-nau’i 3 na lambobin cikakku (a, b), masu a daban-daban, ta yadda layin tangent a wurin taɓawa (a, a³) zai sake haɗuwa da y=x³ a batu (b, b³) wanda ba wurin taɓawa ba. (a yana tsakanin −5 da 5.)
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta gangarowa da ma’aunin tangent a wurin (a, a³) ta amfani da a.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta ma’aunin da b dole ya cika domin batu (b, b³) ya kasance a kan layin tangent.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.hint.2: Saka ƙimar a ta lambar cikakkiya ɗaya bayan ɗaya, nemo b, za ka ga tsarin b.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.var.a: a shi ne haɗin x na wurin taɓawa.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.var.b: b shi ne haɗin x na sauran wurin haɗuwa.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.ok.c1: a da b lambobi cikakku ne cikin kewayon.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.fail.c1: a dole ya zama lambar cikakkiya daga −5 zuwa 5, b ma lambar cikakkiya ce.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.ok.c2: b ya bambanta da wurin taɓawa.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Idan b=a, wannan shi ne wurin taɓawa da kansa.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Batu (b, b³) yana kan layin tangent.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Batu (b, b³) ba ya kan layin tangent y=3a²x−2a³.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.explain: Layin tangent a wurin (a, a³) shi ne y=3a²x−2a³. Warware shi tare da lanƙwasar yana ba da x³−3a²x+2a³=(x−a)²(x+2a)=0, saboda haka x=a (wurin taɓawa, tushen ninki biyu) da x=−2a. Idan a≠0, −2a ya bambanta da a, don haka tangent ɗin yana sake haɗuwa da lanƙwasar a wani batu ban da wurin taɓawa.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.prompt: Amsa wa Hajun. Iƙirarinsa daidai ne? Ka yi bayani da misalin sama a matsayin shaida, sannan ka bayyana ma’anar tangent daidai.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.hint.0: Zaɓi misali ɗaya da ka ƙirƙira a s2, ka rubuta duk wuraren da layin tangent ya haɗu da lanƙwasar.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.hint.1: Bayyana “tangent” ta gangarowa, ba ta adadin wuraren haɗuwa ba.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka ba da takamaiman misali (wurin taɓawa da wani wurin haɗuwa daban)?
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana layin tangent ta gangarowa?
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka guji fahimtar cewa wannan yana faruwa ne ga wannan lanƙwasa kawai?
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.model.0: Ba daidai ba ne. Misali, ga y=x³, layin tangent y=3x−2 a (1, 1) yana sake haɗuwa da lanƙwasar a x=−2. Layin tangent layi ne wanda gangarowarsa a wurin taɓawa take daidai da ƙimar derivative a wurin. Har yanzu tangent ne ko da ya sake haɗuwa da lanƙwasar a wani batu.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.model.1: A’a. Layin tangent layin da ya taɓa lanƙwasar kusa da wurin taɓawa ne (gangarowarsa derivative ne a wurin), saboda haka yana iya sake ketare lanƙwasar a wani wuri mai nisa. Misali, tangent a (1, 1) yana kuma wucewa ta (−2, −8).

n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.ok.c1: a da b lambobi cikakku ne cikin kewayon.
n-m-h2-diff-06.title: Gina aikin cubic da matsakaicin ƙimominsa biyu suke faruwa a x>0
n-m-h2-diff-06.topic: Ƙimomin tsattsauran aikin cubic da tushen derivative ɗinsa
n-m-h2-diff-06.goal: Mayar da sharadin wuraren ƙimomin tsattsauran zuwa sharadin tushen derivative, sannan ka gina ayyukan cubic da dama da suka cika duk sharuɗɗan.
n-m-h2-diff-06.material: Kana son gina f(x)=x³+ax²+bx (a da b lambobi cikakku ne) mai mafi girman ƙima ta gida da mafi ƙaranci ta gida, inda ƙimomin x na waɗannan ƙimomi duka tabbatattu ne. (ax² na nufin a sau x a murabba’i.)
n-m-h2-diff-06.thinking.0: Mayar da sharadin jadawali zuwa sharadin tushen derivative
n-m-h2-diff-06.thinking.1: Nemo dalilin da ya sa sharadi ɗaya bai isa ba
n-m-h2-diff-06.thinking.2: Gina misalan da suka cika sharuɗɗan
n-m-h2-diff-06.prereq.0: Mafi girma/mafi ƙaranci na gida da sauyin alamar derivative
n-m-h2-diff-06.prereq.1: Discriminant na ma’aunin quadratic da alamun tushensa
n-m-h2-diff-06.prereq.2: Ayyukan cubic masu coefficient lambobin cikakku
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.prompt: Idan aka bayyana wannan sharadi a matsayin sharadi kan derivative f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b, me zai zama?
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta ƙimar derivative a x inda ƙimar tsattsauran take, da yadda alamarsa take kafin da bayan wurin.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.hint.1: Ƙirga yawan irin waɗannan x da ake buƙata domin samun mafi girman ƙima ta gida da mafi ƙaranci ta gida.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.o.a: Ma’aunin f'(x)=0 yana da tushen ainihi biyu tabbatattu daban-daban.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.o.b: Ma’aunin f'(x)=0 yana da aƙalla tushen ainihi tabbatacce ɗaya.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.r.b: Idan akwai tushen tabbatacce ɗaya kawai, ƙimar tsattsauran ɗaya ce kawai, ko kuma ɗayan tushen ba tabbatacce ba ne.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.o.c: f'(x) koyaushe tabbatacce ne idan x tabbatacce ne.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.r.c: Saboda haka f yana ci gaba da ƙaruwa a ɓangaren x tabbatacce, kuma ba shi da ƙimar tsattsauran.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.o.d: Ma’aunin f'(x)=0 yana da tushen ninki biyu tabbatacce.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.r.d: Idan tushen ninki biyu ne, alamar derivative ba ta canzawa, don haka babu ƙimar tsattsauran.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.explain: x da ke ba da ƙimar tsattsauran tushen f'(x)=0 ne inda alamar f' ke canzawa kafin da bayan sa. Domin samun duka mafi girma ta gida da mafi ƙaranci ta gida, ana buƙatar tushen ainihi biyu daban-daban, kuma duka su zama tabbatattu.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.prompt: Shigar da nau’i-nau’i 3 daban-daban na lambobin cikakku (a, b) ta yadda ga f(x)=x³+ax²+bx, f'(x)=0 zai sami tushen ainihi biyu tabbatattu daban-daban. (Cikakken ƙimar a da b ba ta wuce 20 ba.)
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta jimla da ninkin tushen biyu na 3x²+2ax+b=0 ta amfani da a da b.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.hint.1: Yi tunanin ko alamun jimla da ninki su kaɗai sun isa a tabbatar tushen lambobin ainihi ne.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.hint.2: Zaɓi a mara kyau da farko, sannan ka canza b ka bincika ko tushen suna samuwa kai tsaye.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.fail.c1: a da b dole su zama lambobi cikakku masu cikakken ƙima bai wuce 20 ba.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Tushen biyu na 3x²+2ax+b=0 lambobin ainihi ne daban-daban.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.fail.c2: 3x²+2ax+b=0 ba shi da tushen ainihi biyu daban-daban.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Jimla da ninkin tushen biyu duka tabbatattu ne.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Jimlar (−2a/3) da ninkin (b/3) tushen biyun ba duka tabbatattu ba ne.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.explain: Domin tushen biyu na 3x²+2ax+b=0 su zama lambobin tabbatattu daban-daban, discriminant dole ya zama tabbatacce (a²−3b>0), jimlar tushen −2a/3 dole ta zama tabbatacciya (a<0), ninki kuma b/3 dole ya zama tabbatacce (b>0). Misali, (a, b)=(−3, 1), (−4, 2), (−6, 3).
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.prompt: (a, b)=(−1, 1) yana da a<0 da b>0 amma bai cika sharadin ba. Ka bayyana dalili ta amfani da f'(x) da siffar f.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sake rubuta f'(x)=3x²−2x+1 a cikakken murabba’i, ko ka ƙididdige discriminant.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Duba ko alamar f'(x) tana canzawa yayin da x ke sauyawa.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka yi la’akari da ko f'(x)=0 yana da tushen?
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka danganta wannan da cewa babu ƙimar tsattsauran idan alamar f' ba ta canzawa?
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.model.0: f'(x)=3x²−2x+1, kuma discriminant 4−12<0 ne, saboda haka f'(x)=0 ba shi da tushen ainihi. f'(x) koyaushe tabbatacce ne, don haka f yana ƙaruwa kawai kuma ba shi da ƙimomin tsattsauran.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Ko da a<0 da b>0 ne, discriminant (−2)²−4·3·1 mara kyau ne, saboda haka f'=0 ba shi da tushen ainihi; alamar f' ba ta canzawa, don haka babu ƙimar tsattsauran.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s3.prompt: Zaɓi duk nau’i-nau’in (a, b) da ke sa f(x)=x³+ax²+bx ya sami duka ƙimomin tsattsauransa a x>0.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s3.hint.0: Saka kowane (a, b) cikin 3x²+2ax+b=0, ka fara duba alamar discriminant.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s3.hint.1: Ga waɗanda ke da tushen ainihi kawai, duba alamun jimla da ninkin tushen biyu.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s3.r.a: a<0 da b>0 ne, amma discriminant a²−3b=0, saboda haka f'(x)=0 yana da tushen ninki biyu. Babu ƙimar tsattsauran a tushen ninki biyu.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s3.r.c: Idan a>0 ne, jimlar tushen biyu mara kyau ce, saboda haka ba za a sami tushen tabbatattu biyu ba.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s3.explain: (−5, 2): discriminant 25−6>0, a<0, b>0, saboda haka ya dace. (−2, 1): 4−3>0, kuma 3x²−4x+1=(3x−1)(x−1)=0, don haka x=1/3 da 1, dukansu tabbatattu ne. (−3, 3) yana da tushen ninki biyu; ga (3, 1), tushen biyun marasa kyau ne.

n-m-h2-diff-07.title: Girman akwati da aka yi ta yanke kusurwoyi
n-m-h2-diff-07.topic: Ingantawa: kewayon da aka yarda da derivative
n-m-h2-diff-07.goal: A mafitar da ta nemo wurin da derivative yake 0, nemo layin da ya manta da kewayon da matsalar ta yarda, sannan ka sake nemo mafi girman ƙima cikin wannan kewayon.
n-m-h2-diff-07.material: Daga kowane kusurwa huɗu na takardar murabba’i mai gefen 12 cm, yanke ƙananan murabba’i mai gefen x cm, sannan ka naɗe ta ta zama akwati marar murfi. Takardar tana da kauri, don haka gefen murabba’in da za a iya yankewa bai wuce 1.5 cm ba. Wannan ita ce mafitar Eunseo don nemo lokacin da girman akwati ya fi yawa.
n-m-h2-diff-07.thinking.0: Kwatanta sharuɗɗan matsalar da kewayon da aka yi amfani da shi a mafita
n-m-h2-diff-07.thinking.2: Bayyana lokacin da mafi girman ƙima take a ƙarshen kewayon
n-m-h2-diff-07.prereq.0: Derivative na aikin cubic da ƙaruwa/raguwa
n-m-h2-diff-07.prereq.1: Mafi girma da mafi ƙaranci a rufaffiyar kewayo (ko rabin rufaffiya)
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi na farko da ba daidai ba a mafitar Eunseo.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.hint.0: Yi alama a duk sharuɗɗan da ke cikin bayanin matsalar, ka duba ko kowane layin mafita ya yi amfani da su.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo layin da kewayon x ya fara bayyana, sannan ka kwatanta shi da sharadin matsalar.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.line.0: Tushen murabba’i ne mai gefen 12−2x, tsayinsa kuma x ne, don haka girma V(x)=x(12−2x)².
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.line.3: Domin tushe ya kasance, 12−2x>0, saboda haka 0<x<6, kuma ɗan takara a wannan kewayon x=2 ne kawai.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.line.4: Tun da alamar V'(x) tana sauyawa daga tabbatacciya zuwa marar kyau kusa da x=2, V(2) ita ce mafi girma.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.line.5: Saboda haka mafi girman girma V(2)=128 cm³.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.explain: Layi na 4 ne na farko da ya yi kuskure. Matsalar ta ce ana iya yanke murabba’i ne kawai idan x bai wuce 1.5 ba, amma mafitar ta ɗauki kewayon 0<x<6 bisa sharadin samuwar tushe kawai. Layukan 5 da 6 sun bi kewayon layi na 4, saboda haka sakamakon ya canza. Maganganu da lissafin layukan 1 zuwa 3 daidai ne.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.prompt: A cikin madaidaicin kewayon x, wace ƙimar x ce ke sa V(x) ya fi girma?
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta madaidaicin kewayon x, ka duba alamar V'(x) a cikin wannan kewayon.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.hint.1: Idan V yana ƙaruwa, yi tunanin inda mafi girman ƙima a cikin kewayon za ta kasance.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.r.a: Wuri ne inda derivative ya zama 0, amma yana wajen zangon matsalar, don haka ba za a iya amfani da shi a zahiri ba.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.r.b: Wuri ne cikin zangon, amma ba wurin da mafi girman ƙima take ba.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.r.d: Ya zaɓi ƙimar tsakiyar zangon. Dole ne a bincika ƙaruwa/raguwa domin sanin inda mafi girman ƙima take.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.explain: Ga 0<x≤1.5, V'(x)=12(x−2)(x−6)>0, saboda haka V yana ci gaba da ƙaruwa. Don haka mafi girman ƙimar tana a ƙarshen dama na zangon, x=1.5.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.prompt: Nemo mafi girman girma da mafita daidai, sannan rubuta a jimloli 1 ko 2 dalilin da ya sa mafi girman ƙimar take a wani wuri dabam da wurin V'(x)=0.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.hint.0: Saka x=1.5 cikin tsarin lissafi, ka ƙididdige girman.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.hint.1: Duba ko x da V'(x)=0 yake cikinsa yana cikin zangon da aka yarda.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka sake rubuta zangon da aka yarda a matsayin 0<x≤1.5?
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka duba ko V yana ƙaruwa ko raguwa a cikin zangon?
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.model.0: Ga 0<x≤1.5, V'(x)>0, saboda haka V yana ci gaba da ƙaruwa, kuma mafi girman ƙima tana a ƙarshen dama x=1.5. V(1.5)=1.5×81=121.5 cm³. x=2 yana wajen zangon.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.model.1: Idan x=3/2, girman (3/2)×9²=243/2=121.5 cm³ shi ne mafi girma. A wannan zangon V yana ƙaruwa kullum, saboda haka wurin V'(x)=0 ba ya cikin zangon.

n-m-h2-diff-08.title: A lokacin da acceleration ya zama 0, shin wurin yana sauya alkibla?
n-m-h2-diff-08.topic: Gudun motsi da alkibla: sauyin matsayi da nisan da aka yi.
n-m-h2-diff-08.goal: Bambanta lokutan da alkiblar motsin wuri a layin lambobi take canzawa da lokacin da acceleration yake 0, sannan yanke shawara ta amfani da sauyin alamar velocity.
n-m-h2-diff-08.material: Matsayin wuri P da ke motsi a layin lambobi a lokacin t (0≤t≤4) shi ne x(t)=t³−6t²+9t. Velocity shi ne x'(t), acceleration kuma x''(t). Jimin ya ce, "A t=2 acceleration 0 ne. A lokacin da acceleration ya zama 0, P yana sauya alkibla." (t³ na nufin t a cube.)
n-m-h2-diff-08.thinking.0: Zaɓar alamar velocity da za ta gwada da'awar.
n-m-h2-diff-08.thinking.1: Bambanta lokacin da acceleration yake 0 da lokacin da alkibla ke canzawa.
n-m-h2-diff-08.thinking.2: Bayyana da hujja ta saka ƙimomi.
n-m-h2-diff-08.prereq.0: Alaƙar matsayi, velocity, da acceleration (derivative na matsayi, derivative na velocity).
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.prompt: Domin gwada ko da'awar Jimin daidai ce, me ya kamata ka fara bincika?
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.hint.0: Yi tunanin yadda alamar velocity ta bambanta idan wurin yana zuwa dama ko hagu.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo derivative x(t) domin samun velocity, sannan saka ƙimomi kafin da bayan t=2.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.o.a: Duba ko matsakaicin ƙimar canji a zangon [0, 4] tabbatacciya ce.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.r.a: Matsakaicin ƙimar canji ma yana kwatanta matsayi biyu na ƙarshen kawai, don haka ba ya gaya mana motsin cikin tsakiyar zangon.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.r.b: Sanin ƙimar matsayi ba ya gaya mana ko alkiblar motsi tana canzawa kafin ko bayan wurin.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.o.c: Duba ko alamomin velocity v(t)=x'(t) kafin da bayan t=2 sun bambanta.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.o.d: Sake lissafa ko acceleration x''(2)=0 daidai ne.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.r.d: An riga an bayar da cewa acceleration 0 ne. Abin da ake buƙatar gwadawa shi ne ko wannan yana nufin alkiblar ta sauya.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.explain: Alamar velocity ce ke ƙayyade alkiblar motsin wurin. Domin alkibla ta sauya, alamar velocity dole ta bambanta kafin da bayan; kasancewar acceleration 0 kaɗai ba ta gaya mana haka ba.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi duk lokutan da alkiblar motsin P take canzawa a 0≤t≤4.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.hint.0: Nemo velocity v(t)=x'(t) da kanka, sannan ƙididdige alamarsa a t=0, 2, da 4.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.hint.1: Duba ko alamar tana canzawa kafin da bayan lokutan da velocity ya zama 0.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.r.b: A t=2 acceleration 0 ne, amma velocity −3 ne, saboda haka wurin yana ci gaba da tafiya hagu. Alkibla ba ta canzawa.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.r.d: Wannan ƙarshen lokacin zangon ne, kuma velocity a lokacin 9 ne, tabbatacce. Ba lokacin da alkibla ke sauyawa ba ne.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.explain: x'(t)=3t²−12t+9=3(t−1)(t−3), saboda haka velocity 0 ne a t=1 da 3, kuma alama tana canzawa kafin da bayan waɗannan lokuta (daga tabbatacce zuwa mara kyau zuwa tabbatacce). t=2 lokacin da acceleration x''(t)=6t−12 yake zama 0 ne kawai.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.prompt: Amsa wa Jimin. Bayyana ta amfani da ƙimar velocity dalilin da ya sa P ba ya sauya alkibla duk da cewa acceleration 0 ne a t=2, sannan faɗi lokacin da alkibla ke canzawa.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.hint.0: Ka ƙididdige ƙimar velocity v(2) a t=2 da kanka.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.hint.1: Nemo lokutan da velocity yake 0, sannan kwatanta yadda alamarsa ta bambanta kafin da bayan su.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka ƙididdige velocity da kanka a t=2, ka duba alamarsa?
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bambanta lokutan da alamar velocity ke canzawa da lokutan da acceleration yake 0?
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana ta amfani da ƙimomi dalilin da ya sa da'awar ba daidai ba ce?
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.model.0: Gaskiya ne cewa acceleration 0 ne a t=2, amma velocity v(2)=3·4−12·2+9=−3 mara kyau ne, don haka P yana ci gaba da tafiya hagu. Alkibla tana sauyawa idan alamar velocity ta canza; tun da v(t)=3(t−1)(t−3), tana canzawa a t=1 da t=3.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.model.1: Idan acceleration ya zama 0, lokaci ne kawai da velocity ba ya ƙaruwa ko raguwa. A t=2 velocity −3 ne, don haka alkibla ba ta canzawa; tana canzawa a t=1 da t=3, inda velocity ya zama 0 kuma alamarsa ta canza.

n-m-h2-diff-09.title: Zangon a inda aiki ke ƙaruwa koyaushe.
n-m-h2-diff-09.topic: Derivatives da ƙaruwa: iyakar da alamar daidaito ta haɗa.
n-m-h2-diff-09.goal: Yayin da ake mayar da sharadin aiki ya ƙaru a dukkan lambobin ainihi zuwa sharadin alamar derivative, gwada ƙimomin iyaka (inda derivative yake 0 a wuri guda) dabam, sannan rubuta sakamakon a matsayin sanarwa ga ƙaramin ɗalibi.
n-m-h2-diff-09.material: Wannan ita ce mafitar Soeun, ƙaramin ɗalibi, wanda ya nemo zangon madaidaiciya a da ya sa aiki f(x)=x³+ax²+3x ya ƙaru a dukkan lambobin ainihi. Soeun ta nuna mafitar cikin alfahari. (x³ na nufin x a cube, ax² kuma na nufin a ninka da x a murabba'i.)
n-m-h2-diff-09.thinking.0: Nemo layin da aka yi amfani da sharadi da tsauri fiye da kima.
n-m-h2-diff-09.thinking.1: Gwada ƙimomin iyaka a=±3 ta saka su.
n-m-h2-diff-09.thinking.2: Sake rubutawa yadda ƙaramin ɗalibi zai fahimta.
n-m-h2-diff-09.prereq.0: Alamar derivative da ƙaruwa/raguwa na aiki.
n-m-h2-diff-09.prereq.1: Sharadin (discriminant) da rashin daidaiton quadratic zai cika ga dukkan lambobin ainihi.
n-m-h2-diff-09.prereq.2: Siffar cikakken cube na ma'anar cubic.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin farko da bai dace ba a mafitar Soeun.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.hint.0: Duba ɗaya bayan ɗaya dalilin da ya sa aka samo kowane layi daga layin da ke gabansa.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.hint.1: Yi la'akari ko "yana ƙaruwa" da "derivative tabbatacciya ce" suna nufin abu ɗaya.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.line.1: Domin f ya ƙaru a dukkan lambobin ainihi, dole f'(x)>0 ya cika ga dukkan lambobin ainihi x.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.line.2: Idan D shi ne discriminant na f'(x)=0, ana buƙatar D/4=a²−9<0.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.explain: Layi na 2 ne na farko da bai dace ba. Domin aiki ya ƙaru, f'(x)≥0 ya wadatar; ba lallai sai f'(x)>0 ba. Idan f'(x) 0 ne a wuri guda kawai kuma tabbatacce ne a sauran wurare, aikin har yanzu yana ƙaruwa ta wannan wurin. Layuka 3 da 4 sun biyo layi na 2, saboda haka iyakar ta ɓace daga zangon da aka samu.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.prompt: Kana son duba ko f yana ƙaruwa a dukkan lambobin ainihi idan a=3, wanda yake a iyaka. Wace hanya ce ta fi dacewa?
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.hint.0: Saka a=3 cikin f ka rarraba shi, ko sake rubuta shi da siffar cikakken murabba'i ko cikakken cube.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta alamar f' kafin da bayan wurin da f'(x)=0.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.a: Yanke cewa ba ya ƙaruwa, domin idan a=3 akwai x mai f'(x)=0.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.r.a: Ko da derivative ya zama 0 a wuri guda, aikin yana ƙaruwa idan alamarsa ba ta canza kafin da bayan wurin. Dole ne a duba kafin a yanke hukunci.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.b: Yi la'akari cewa ba a buƙatar wani bincike dabam domin wannan ƙima tana wajen −3<a<3.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.r.b: Ko tana a iyaka ne ainihin tambayar, saboda haka ana buƙatar bincike.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.c: Lissafta alamar f' a x=0 kawai.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.r.c: Alama a wuri guda ba za ta iya tabbatar da ko f yana ƙaruwa a dukkan lambobin ainihi ba.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.d: Saka a=3, sauƙaƙa f(x), sannan duba siffar jadawali.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.explain: Idan a=3, to f(x)=x³+3x²+3x=(x+1)³−1. Jadawalin siffar (x+1)³ yana da gangare 0 a x=−1 amma yana ci gaba da ƙaruwa. f'(x)=3(x+1)²≥0, kuma wuri guda da yake 0 shi ne x=−1.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta sanarwa ga Soeun. Ambaci abu guda mai kyau a aikinta, sannan bayyana ɓangaren da ya kamata a gyara da yadda, ta amfani da misalin a=3 domin samun zangon a daidai.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko nemo abu guda da Soeun ta yi da kyau.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.hint.1: Idan ka rubuta a sanarwar siffar f'(x) idan a=3, zai fi sauƙi Soeun ta fahimta.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana takamaiman abin da aka yi da kyau?
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka nuna layin da ba daidai ba da dalilinsa ta amfani da misalin a=3?
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.model.0: Soeun, ka yi kyau da ka rubuta discriminant! Amma f'(x)≥0 ya wadatar, ba lallai sai f'(x)>0 ba. Idan a=3, f(x)=(x+1)³−1, don haka f'(x)=0 ne a wuri guda x=−1, kuma aikin yana ci gaba da ƙaruwa. Saboda haka −3≤a≤3.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.model.1: Ka rubuta amsar −3<a<3, ko ba haka ba? Duba ko iyakokin a=±3 ma suna aiki. Idan ka saka a=3, f(x)=(x+1)³−1, wanda aiki ne mai ƙaruwa. Ko da f' 0 ne a wuri guda, aikin yana ci gaba da ƙaruwa muddin alamar ba ta canza a gefe guda, don haka ka haɗa alamar daidaito ka rubuta −3≤a≤3.

n-m-h2-diff-10.prereq.2: Ayyukan cubic masu coefficient lambobin cikakku
n-m-h2-diff-10.title: Shin za mu iya nemo ƙimar mafi girman gida idan derivative kaɗai muka sani?
n-m-h2-diff-10.topic: Abin da za mu iya da abin da ba za mu iya koya daga bayanin derivative ba: aikin madaidaiciya.
n-m-h2-diff-10.goal: Duba cewa sanin derivative kaɗai yana gaya maka siffar aiki (inda yake ƙaruwa ko raguwa da inda ƙimomin tsattsauran suke), amma ba matsayinsa a tsaye ba (girman ƙimomin tsattsauran); gano ƙarin bayanin da ake buƙata.
n-m-h2-diff-10.material: An san derivative na aikin cubic f(x) shi ne f'(x)=3x²−12. Muna son nemo ƙimar mafi girman gida ta f, amma ba mu san f(x) kanta ba. (3x² na nufin 3 ninka x a murabba'i.)
n-m-h2-diff-10.thinking.0: Bambanta abin da derivative ke gaya mana da abin da ba ta gaya mana.
n-m-h2-diff-10.thinking.2: Yi amfani da bayanin domin nemo ƙimar mafi girman gida.
n-m-h2-diff-10.prereq.0: Alamar derivative da mafi girma/mafi ƙaranci na gida.
n-m-h2-diff-10.prereq.1: Integrals marasa iyaka na ayyukan polynomial.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk bayanan da idan aka ƙara sanin ɗaya daga cikinsu, za a iya ƙayyade ƙimar mafi girman gida ta f.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.hint.0: Daga f'(x), rubuta siffar f(x). Akwai ɓangaren da ba a ƙayyade ba?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.hint.1: Duba zaɓuɓɓuka ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko suna ƙayyade wannan ɓangaren da ba a sani ba.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.a: Idan ka san ƙimar aiki guda ɗaya, aikin madaidaiciya za ta ƙayyade, saboda haka an ƙayyade dukkan f.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.d: Idan ka san ƙimar aiki guda ɗaya, aikin madaidaiciya za ta ƙayyade, saboda haka an ƙayyade dukkan f.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.b: Ana iya samun wannan ƙima tuni ta saka x=1 cikin f'(x)=3x²−12, saboda haka ba sabon bayani ba ne.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.o.c: Mafi ƙarancin ƙimar f'(x) ita ce −12.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.c: Ana iya samun wannan bayanin tuni daga f'(x)=3x²−12 kaɗai, saboda haka ba sabon bayani ba ne.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.explain: Idan f'(x)=3x²−12, to f(x)=x³−12x+C (C madaidaiciya ce). An ƙayyade ƙimomin x na mafi girma da mafi ƙaranci na gida (x=−2, 2), amma mafi girman ƙimar gida f(−2)=16+C ba za a ƙayyade ba sai an san C. Domin nemo C kana buƙatar ƙimar f (ƙimar aikin). Bayanin derivative daidai yake da bayanin da muke da shi tuni.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.prompt: An ƙara ba ka bayanin cewa mafi ƙarancin ƙimar gida na f ita ce −10. Nemo mafi girman ƙimar gida na f, sannan rubuta yadda ka samo ta.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.hint.0: Yi amfani da alamar derivative domin yanke hukuncin ƙimar x inda ƙaramin gida yake.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.hint.1: Saka wannan x cikin tsarin f(x), sannan kafa lissafi ta amfani da C.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka fara nemo ƙimomin x inda mafi girma da mafi ƙarancin gida suke?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka yi amfani da ƙimar mafi ƙarancin gida domin ƙayyade aikin madaidaiciya?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.model.0: Za mu iya rubuta f(x)=x³−12x+C (C madaidaiciya ce). Mafi ƙarancin gida yana a x=2, kuma f(2)=C−16=−10, saboda haka C=6. Mafi girman gida yana a x=−2, kuma f(−2)=16+C=22.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.model.1: Haɗa f' ba ya ƙayyade aikin madaidaiciya, amma sanin cewa mafi ƙarancin ƙimar gida −10 ce yana ƙayyade ta a matsayin 6. Mafi girman gida yana a x=−2, kuma f(−2)=−8+24+6=22.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.prompt: Ayyukan cubic biyu f da g suna da derivative iri ɗaya, kuma f(0)−g(0)=6. Menene bambancin mafi girman ƙimar gida na f da ta g?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.hint.0: Idan f'=g', rubuta abin da zai faru idan ka nemo derivative na f(x)−g(x).
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.hint.1: Yi tunanin ko wannan bambanci yana sauyawa da x ko madaidaiciya ce.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.r.a: Ka ɗauka cewa derivative iri ɗaya suna nufin mafi girman ƙimomin gida iri ɗaya ne. Idan aikin madaidaiciya sun bambanta, girman ƙimomin tsattsauran ma ya bambanta.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.r.c: Ka ƙara bambancin aikin madaidaiciya sau biyu. A mafi girman gida, bambancin har yanzu 6 ne.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.o.d: Ba za a iya ƙayyade ba.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.r.d: Ana iya ƙayyade, domin an bayar da ƙimar f(0)−g(0).
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.explain: Idan f'=g', to f(x)−g(x) madaidaiciya ce, kuma tunda f(0)−g(0)=6, f(x)−g(x)=6 ga kowane x. Mafi girman gida yana a x guda ga ayyukan biyun, saboda haka bambancin mafi girman ƙimomin gida ma 6 ne.

n-m-h2-diff-11.title: Gina rashin daidaito da yake aiki idan x>0.
n-m-h2-diff-11.topic: Tabbatar da rashin daidaito: takaita zangon da sharadin daidaito.
n-m-h2-diff-11.goal: Nemo mafi ƙarancin ƙima ta amfani da differentiation domin gina rashin daidaito da ya cika sharuɗɗa da kanka, sannan bayyana dalilin da takaita yankin ke sauya sakamakon.
n-m-h2-diff-11.material: a cikakkiyar lamba tabbatacciya ce, k kuma cikakkiyar lamba ce. Muna son zaɓar a da k ta yadda rashin daidaiton x³+k≥3a²x zai yi aiki kullum ga x tabbatacce, kuma daidaito ya samu ga wani x tabbatacce. (3a²x na nufin 3 ninka a a murabba'i ninka x.)
n-m-h2-diff-11.thinking.0: Mayar da rashin daidaito zuwa sharadin mafi ƙarancin ƙimar wani aiki guda.
n-m-h2-diff-11.thinking.1: Ƙirƙirar yanayi inda daidaito yake samu.
n-m-h2-diff-11.thinking.2: Bayyana abin da ke sauyawa idan zangon ya sauya.
n-m-h2-diff-11.prereq.0: Ƙimomin tsattsauran da mafi ƙaranci ta amfani da derivatives.
n-m-h2-diff-11.prereq.2: Rashin daidaito da mafi ƙarancin ƙima.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.prompt: Idan muka ɗauki h(x)=x³−3a²x+k, wane hali na h(x) a x>0 ne wannan sharadi ya zama?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.hint.0: Sake bayyana "rashin daidaiton kullum yana aiki" a matsayin magana kan ƙaramin ƙimar h(x).
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.hint.1: Me "akwai x inda daidaito yake samu" yake nufi game da wannan ƙaramin ƙima?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.r.a: Idan mafi girman ƙima 0 ce, to h(x)≤0, saboda haka rashin daidaiton yana komawa akasin alkibla.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.r.b: To akwai x mai h(x)<0, don haka rashin daidaiton ya gaza.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.o.c: Mafi ƙarancin ƙimar h'(x) ita ce 0.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.r.c: Wannan yana nazarin hali na h', ba na h ba. Rashin daidaiton yana magana ne kan ƙimomin h.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.explain: Domin h(x)≥0 ya yi aiki kullum ga x>0, mafi ƙarancin ƙima dole ta zama aƙalla 0; domin a sami x inda daidaito ya tabbata, mafi ƙarancin ƙima dole ta zama daidai 0.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.prompt: Shigar da nau'i-nau'i guda 3 (a,k) masu cika sharuɗɗan, masu ƙimomin a daban-daban guda uku. (a cikakkiyar lamba ce daga 1 zuwa 10.)
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.hint.0: Nemo x tabbatacce inda h'(x)=0, sannan duba alamar h' a gefensa biyu.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta ƙimar h a wannan x ta amfani da a da k, sannan nemo k da ke sa ta zama 0.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.ok.c1: a lamba cikakkiya ce daga 1 zuwa 10, k ma lamba cikakkiya ce.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole ne a ya zama lamba cikakkiya daga 1 zuwa 10, k ma lamba cikakkiya.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.ok.c2: Mafi ƙarancin ƙimar h a x>0 daidai 0 ce.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.fail.c2: Mafi ƙarancin ƙimar h(x) a x>0 ba 0 ba ce.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.explain: h'(x)=3x²−3a²=3(x−a)(x+a), kuma a x>0, h yana sauyawa daga raguwa zuwa ƙaruwa a x=a, don haka mafi ƙarancin ƙimarsa h(a)=k−2a³ ce. Idan wannan ƙima 0 ce, rashin daidaiton yana aiki kullum, kuma daidaito yana samuwa a x=a. Saboda haka k=2a³.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.prompt: A jimla ɗaya kowanne, bayyana abin da ke faruwa idan k ya yi ƙasa da 2a³ da idan ya fi 2a³.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.hint.0: Kwatanta yadda ƙimar h a x=a ke sauyawa da k, ta amfani da k=2a³ a matsayin ma’auni.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.hint.1: Rashin daidaiton aiki kullum da samun daidaito abubuwa ne daban.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana yanayin ƙaramar k da babbar k daban-daban?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka bambanta “yana aiki kullum” da “daidaito yana tabbata”?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.model.0: Idan k<2a³, h mara kyau ne a x=a, saboda haka rashin daidaiton ya gaza. Idan k>2a³, mafi ƙarancin ƙima ta fi 0, don haka rashin daidaiton yana aiki, amma babu x da daidaito yake tabbata.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.model.1: Idan k<2a³, mafi ƙarancin ƙima ba ta kai 0 ba, don haka akwai x da rashin daidaiton ba ya aiki. Idan k>2a³, yana aiki kullum, amma mafi ƙarancin ƙima ta fi 0, don haka babu x tabbatacce da daidaito yake tabbata.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.prompt: Akwai nau’i-nau’i (a, k) da rashin daidaiton x³+k≥3a²x ɗaya yake aiki ba ga x tabbatacce kawai ba, har ga duk lambobin ainihi?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.hint.0: Yi kiyasin alamar h(x) idan x ƙaramin lamba mara kyau ne, kamar −10 ko −100.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.hint.1: Yi tunanin ko sakamakon da aka tabbatar ga lambobi tabbatattu kaɗai yana aiki kai tsaye ga lambobi marasa kyau.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.a: A’a. Idan x ya yi ƙanƙanta sosai (mara kyau), gefen hagu ya yi ƙasa da 3a²x.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.b: Eh. Da k=2a³ da muka samu a sama, yana aiki ga duk lambobin ainihi.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.r.b: Ka bincika k=2a³ ne kawai ga x>0, ba ka duba x<0 ba. Yana gaza idan x ƙaramin lamba mara kyau ne.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.c: Eh. Idan ka zaɓi k babba sosai, yana aiki ga duk lambobin ainihi.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.r.c: Idan x ya yi ƙanƙanta sosai (mara kyau), x³ yana raguwa da sauri fiye da k, saboda haka zai gaza komai girman k.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.d: A’a. Idan ka saka x=0, rashin daidaiton ya riga ya gaza.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.r.d: Idan x=0, ana buƙatar k≥0; kuma k=2a³>0, don haka yana aiki.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.explain: h(x)=x³−3a²x+k yana nufin −∞ yayin da x ke ƙara zama mara kyau. Don haka ko yaya aka zaɓi k, akwai x da h(x)<0. Da muka taƙaita x zuwa tabbatacce, sai aka samu nau’i-nau’i (a, k) da suka cika sharadin.

n-m-h2-explog-01.title: Duba mafitar da ta ƙididdige tushen murabba’i ta amfani da dokokin exponents.
n-m-h2-explog-01.goal: Nemo layi na farko da ya yi kuskure a mafitar da ke amfani da dokokin exponents, sannan binciki sharuɗɗan da dokar za ta iya bayar da madaidaicin ƙima.
n-m-h2-explog-01.material: Hayun ta nemo ƙimar √((−3)²) ta amfani da dokokin exponents. ((−3)² murabba’in −3 ne, kuma exponent 1/2 yana nufin ɗaukar tushen murabba’i. Mu yarda cewa ana ayyana exponent na rabo ne kawai idan tushe tabbatacce ne.)
n-m-h2-explog-01.thinking.0: Bi mafitar har ƙarshe, ka nemo layi na farko da ya yi kuskure.
n-m-h2-explog-01.thinking.1: Kwatanta sakamakon da ƙimar da aka ƙididdige kai tsaye.
n-m-h2-explog-01.thinking.2: Binciki sharuɗɗan da doka take aiki a ƙarƙashinsu.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi na farko marar daidai a mafitar Hayun.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.hint.0: Fara daga cikin baka, ka ƙididdige ƙimar kai tsaye, sannan ka kwatanta da sakamakon ƙarshe na Hayun.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bi layukan ɗaya bayan ɗaya, ka duba layin da ƙimomin biyu suka fara bambanta.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 2 ne na farko da ya yi kuskure. (a^m)^n=a^(mn) ga exponent na rabo doka ce ta tushe tabbatacce, amma tushen nan −3 mara kyau ne. A zahiri, ((−3)²)^(1/2)=9^(1/2)=3. Layukan 3 da 4 lissafi ne da suka biyo bayan layi na 2.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta madaidaicin ƙima, ka yi amfani da alamar tushe ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ba za a iya amfani da dokar exponents a layin Hayun ba.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko ƙididdige (−3)², sannan ka ɗaga wannan ƙimar zuwa 1/2.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.hint.1: Sake karanta yarjejeniyar game da irin lambar da tushe dole ya zama domin amfani da dokar.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka fara samo (−3)²=9, sannan ka samu ƙimar 3?
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka ce ana iya amfani da dokar exponents ne kawai idan tushe tabbatacce ne?
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Za ka iya bayyana dalilin da ya sa −3 ba zai yiwu ya zama ƙimar tushen murabba’i ba?
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.model.0: √((−3)²)=√9=3. Ana iya amfani da (a^m)^n=a^(mn) ga exponents na rabo ne kawai idan tushe tabbatacce ne. A nan tushe −3 mara kyau ne, don haka bai kamata a yi amfani da dokar ba; yin hakan yana ba da ƙimar kuskure −3.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.model.1: Da farko, (−3)²=9, kuma tushen murabba’i tabbatacce na 9 shi ne 3, saboda haka ƙimar 3 ce. Hayun ta yi amfani da dokar duk da cewa tushen mara kyau ne, shi ya sa alamar ta bambanta.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.model.2: Amsa: 3. Alamar tushen murabba’i tana ba da ƙima 0 ko mafi girma, saboda haka ba zai zama −3 ba. Matsalar ita ce an yi amfani da dokar exponents na rabo ga lamba mai tushe mara kyau.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.prompt: Zaɓi duk (a, m, n) da ɓangarorin biyu na (a^m)^n=a^(mn) suke da ma’ana kuma suke da ƙima iri ɗaya.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ga kowane zaɓi, ƙididdige gefen hagu da na dama daban, sannan fara tabbatar da cewa duka suna da ƙima.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.hint.1: Idan duka suna da ƙima, kwatanta ko sun yi daidai. Yi la’akari daban da exponent cikakkiya da exponent na rabo.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.a: Gefen hagu ((−3)²)^(1/2) shi ne 3, gefen dama (−3)^1 kuma −3 ne. Akwai exponent na rabo, saboda haka dokar ba ta aiki.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.b: Ka manta cewa idan exponents ɗin duka lambobin cikakku ne, dokar tana aiki ko da tushe mara kyau ne. Duka gefen 729 ne.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.c: Ka manta cewa idan tushe tabbatacce ne, dokar tana aiki ko da exponents na rabo ne. Duka gefen 25 ne.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.d: Ba a ayyana gefen hagu (−4)^(1/2) ba. Dole ne ka fara duba ko an ayyana ɓangarorin biyu.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.e: Ka manta cewa exponent mara kyau ma exponent cikakkiya ce, don haka dokar tana aiki. Duka gefen 1/64 ne.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.explain: (−3, 2, 3) ya dace domin 9³=729=(−3)⁶; (5, 1/2, 4) ya dace domin (√5)⁴=25=5²; kuma (−2, 3, −2) ya dace domin (−8)^(−2)=1/64=(−2)^(−6). Ga (−3, 2, 1/2), ƙimomin sun bambanta, 3 da −3; ga (−4, 1/2, 2), ba a ayyana gefen hagu ba. Babban bambanci shi ne ana iya amfani da exponents cikakku idan tushe ba 0 ba ne, exponents na rabo kuma idan tushe tabbatacce ne.

n-m-h2-explog-02.title: Ƙimomin x da logarithm mai x a tushe da adadi yake da ma’ana
n-m-h2-explog-02.goal: Nemo da kanka ƙimomin x da logarithm mai x a tushe da adadi zai yiwu, ka tsara sharuɗɗan ɗaya bayan ɗaya don nemo kewayon x.
n-m-h2-explog-02.material: Log_a N yana da ƙima ne kawai idan tushe a da adadi N sun cika wasu sharuɗɗa. A nan, duba log_{x−1}(5−x), wanda x yake a cikin tushe da adadi. (Tushe x−1 ne, adadi kuma 5−x.)
n-m-h2-explog-02.thinking.0: Ƙirƙiri misalai da dama da suka cika sharuɗɗan.
n-m-h2-explog-02.thinking.1: Tsara dalilin da ya sa ba a yarda da ƙimomin da suka gaza ba.
n-m-h2-explog-02.thinking.2: Haɗa sharuɗɗan da ka samu zuwa kewayo guda.
n-m-h2-explog-02.prereq.1: Sharuɗɗan tushe da adadi na logarithm
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.prompt: Nemo ka shigar da ƙimomin x daban-daban guda uku da log_{x−1}(5−x) yake da ƙima. (Ana iya amfani da decimal.)
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.hint.0: Saka wata ƙimar x, ka rubuta abin da tushe x−1 da adadi 5−x suka zama.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.hint.1: Duba ko tushe da adadi duka sun halatta bisa ma’anar logarithm. Idan ka samu ƙima marar halatta, rubuta wanne ne ya jawo.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.fail.c1: Tushe x−1 ya zama 0 ko ƙasa da 0.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.fail.c2: Tushe x−1 ya zama 1. Tushe ba zai zama 1 ba.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.fail.c3: Adadi 5−x ya zama 0 ko ƙasa da 0.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.explain: Misali, x=3 yana ba da log_2 2, x=4 yana ba da log_3 1, x=1.5 kuma yana ba da log_{0.5} 3.5; a kowanne tushe tabbatacce ne kuma ba 1 ba, adadin kuma tabbatacce ne. Ba a yarda da x=2 domin tushe 1 ne, x=0 domin tushe mara kyau ne, x=5 kuma domin adadi 0 ne.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi dalilin da ya dace da ya sa log_{x−1}(5−x) ba shi da ƙima idan x=2.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.hint.0: Saka x=2 cikin tushe x−1 da adadi 5−x, ka rubuta ƙimarsu.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.hint.1: Jera daban-daban ƙimomin da ba za su iya zama tushe ba da waɗanda ba za su iya zama adadi ba, sannan ka kwatanta da waɗannan ƙimomi.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.o.b: Tushe x−1 ya zama mara kyau.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.r.b: Idan x=2, x−1 ba mara kyau ba ne. Saka ƙimar ka gani.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.r.c: Idan x=2, 5−x shi ne 3. Saka ƙimar ka gani.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.r.d: Idan x=2, 5−x ba mara kyau ba ne. Saka ƙimar ka gani.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.explain: Idan x=2, tushe 1 ne, adadi kuma 3. 1 da aka ɗaga zuwa kowane exponent yana zama 1, ba zai taɓa zama 3 ba; don haka log_1 3 ba shi da ƙima. Wannan shi ya sa tushe bai kamata ya zama 1 ba.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta kewayon x da log_{x−1}(5−x) yake da ma’ana.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta sharuɗɗan biyu na tushe da sharadin guda na adadi daban-daban a matsayin rashin daidaito.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.hint.1: Zana sharuɗɗan uku a kan layin lambobi, nemo inda suke haɗuwa, sannan ka tabbatar babu ƙima da ta ɓace.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka tuna da cire ƙimar da ba a yarda da ita ba yayin bayyana kewayon?
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.model.0: Daga sharuɗɗan tushe x−1>0 da x−1≠1, muna samun x>1 da x≠2. Daga sharadin adadi 5−x>0, x<5. Saboda haka 1<x<5 kuma x≠2.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.model.1: x dole ya fi 1 kuma ya yi ƙasa da 5, amma a cire 2. Domin saka 2 yana sa tushe ya zama 1.

n-m-h2-explog-03.title: Iƙirarin cewa ‘log x²=2 log x’ yana aiki kullum
n-m-h2-explog-03.goal: Binciki kewayon da wata ka’idar logarithm take aiki, nemo misali mai karya iƙirari, sannan ka gyara maganar ko ƙara sharadi.
n-m-h2-explog-03.material: Mina ta ce: “log x²=2 log x ka’idar logarithm ce, don haka tana aiki ga kowane x.” (log logarithm na tushe 10 ne.)
n-m-h2-explog-03.thinking.0: Nemo ƙima da ke zama misali mai karyatawa.
n-m-h2-explog-03.thinking.1: Kwatanta kewayon da ɓangarorin biyu suke da ma’ana a cikinsa.
n-m-h2-explog-03.prereq.0: Ka’idar logarithm log a^n=n log a
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi x da ke nuna cewa iƙirarin Mina ba daidai ba ne.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane x, ƙididdige hagu log x² da dama 2 log x daban-daban, sannan fara duba ko duka suna da ƙima.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.hint.1: Idan duka suna da ƙima, kwatanta ko sun yi daidai. Duba ko wani gefen ba shi da ƙima.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.a: log 100²=4 kuma 2 log 100=4, sun yi daidai, saboda haka ba misalin karyatawa ba ne.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.b: Ka samu yanayin da gefen hagu yake da ƙima, amma ba a ayyana gefen dama ba domin adadinsa mara kyau ne.
