n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.c: Ko da x<1 ne, log 0.01=−2 kuma 2 log 0.1=−2 sun yi daidai. Logarithm mara kyau ya bambanta da wanda ba a ayyana ba.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.d: Duka ɓangarorin sun yi daidai da 0, saboda haka ba misalin karyatawa ba ne.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.explain: Idan x=−10, gefen hagu log (−10)²=log 100=2 yana da ƙima, amma ba a ayyana gefen dama 2 log (−10) ba domin adadinsa mara kyau ne. Saboda haka ba za mu ce maganganun biyu daidai suke ba.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.prompt: Gyara maganar Mina, ko ka rubuta sharadin x da take aiki a ƙarƙashinsa, sannan ka bayyana dalilin gyaran.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kwatanta alamun adadi a hagu da dama idan x tabbatacce ne da idan mara kyau ne.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.hint.1: Duba ƙimar da adadi na hagu x² yake ɗauka ko da x mara kyau ne, sannan nemo tabbataccen lamba da za a yi amfani da ita maimakon x a dama.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka duba ko gefen dama yana da ma’ana idan x mara kyau ne?
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka gwada da wata ƙima cewa maganar da ka gyara tana aiki idan x mara kyau ne?
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.model.0: Dole a gyara shi zuwa log x²=2 log|x| (x≠0). Idan x mara kyau ne, log x ba a ayyana shi, amma x² tabbatacce ne, saboda haka log x² yana da ma’ana.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.model.1: log x²=2 log x yana aiki ne kawai idan x>0. Idan x mara kyau ne, adadin gefen dama mara kyau ne, saboda haka ba shi da ƙima.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.model.2: Idan x ba 0 ba ne, log x²=2 log|x|. Amfani da absolute value yana sa adadi ya kasance tabbatacce kullum.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.prompt: Zaɓi kewayon x da log (x−1)²=2 log (x−1) yake aiki.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.hint.0: Nemo x da gefen hagu yake da ma’ana, da x da gefen dama yake da ma’ana.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.hint.1: Cikin x da ɓangarorin biyu suke da ma’ana, nemo kewayon da maganganun suke ba da ƙima iri ɗaya da gaske.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.r.a: Ya kuma haɗa kewayon da gefen dama yake da ma’ana.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.r.b: Gefen hagu yana da ma’ana idan x≠1, amma gefen dama ba shi da ma’ana idan x<1.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.r.c: Idan x=1, babu ɗaya daga ɓangarorin da yake da ma’ana.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.r.d: Idan x<1, adadi x−1 na gefen dama mara kyau ne, saboda haka ba a ayyana shi.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.explain: Gefen dama 2 log (x−1) yana da ma’ana ne kawai idan x−1>0, wato x>1; a wannan yanayin yana daidai da gefen hagu. Idan x<1, gefen dama ba ya wanzu, don haka ba za mu ce sun yi daidai ba.

n-m-h2-explog-04.title: Wanne ya fi girma, log₂3 ko log₃4?
n-m-h2-explog-04.goal: Gyara hukuncinka game da girman logarithm yayin da ƙarin bayani ke zuwa, sannan ka kwatanta logarithm ɗin biyu ba tare da kalkuleta ba ta amfani da ma’aunin tsakiya.
n-m-h2-explog-04.material: Muna son gano ba tare da kalkuleta ba wanne ya fi girma, log_2 3 ko log_3 4. Ana bayyana bayanin kaɗan-kaɗan. (log_2 3 logarithm ne na 3 mai tushe 2.)
n-m-h2-explog-04.thinking.2: Kwatantawa ta amfani da ma’aunin tsakiya
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.prompt: A kowane mataki, zaɓi hukunci bisa abin da ka sani a yanzu kawai.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.hint.0: Duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya bayyana, yi tunanin ko za ka ci gaba da hukuncinka ko ka canza shi.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.hint.1: Idan tushe da adadin logarithm sun bambanta, yi tunanin ko ya dace a yanke hukunci ta duba ɗaya kawai.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.info: log_2 3 shi ne x da ya cika 2^x=3, kuma log_3 4 shi ne x da ya cika 3^x=4. Tun da 2<3<4, log_2 3 yana tsakanin 1 da 2; tun da 3<4<9, log_3 4 ma yana tsakanin 1 da 2.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Wanne kake ganin ya fi girma?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Sanin cewa dukansu suna tsakanin 1 da 2 bai isa mu san jerinsu ba. Muna buƙatar ma’aunin kwatance na tsakiya mafi takamaimai.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: log_2 3: tushen ya fi ƙanƙanta, saboda haka mai yiwuwa zai buƙaci exponent mafi girma kafin ya kai 3.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka yi tunanin cewa ƙaramin tushe yana buƙatar exponent mafi girma. Wannan ci gaba ne, amma ba a tabbatar ba tukuna.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: log_3 4: adadin 4 ya fi 3 girma, saboda haka mai yiwuwa logarithm ɗin ma ya fi girma.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka duba adadin kawai. Ka manta tushen ma yana canzawa.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ban tabbata ba tukuna: abin da muka sani shi ne dukansu tsakanin 1 da 2 suke.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan hukuncin ya nuna ana buƙatar ma’aunin kwatance mafi takamaimai.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Bari mu auna da ma’aunin tsakiya 3/2. 2^(3/2)=√8≈2.83 ya yi ƙasa da 3, saboda haka log_2 3 ya fi 3/2. 3^(3/2)=√27≈5.20 ya fi 4, saboda haka log_3 4 ya yi ƙasa da 3/2.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yanzu wanne kake ganin ya fi girma?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Tun da log_2 3>3/2>log_3 4, log_2 3 ya fi girma.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka yanke hukuncin da ya saba da sabon bayani. Ka sake duba wanda ya fi 3/2 girma.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ka raba ƙimomin ta sanya 3/2 tsakaninsu.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ƙimomin biyu suna ɓangarori daban-daban na 3/2, don haka ba za su iya zama daidai ba.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Idan aka yi kiyasi haka, log_2 3≈1.585, log_3 4≈1.262, log_4 5≈1.161, kuma log_5 6≈1.113.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yaya log_n(n+1) ke canzawa yayin da n ke ƙaruwa?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Tun da n+1>n, log_n(n+1) koyaushe ya fi 1, kuma ƙimarsa tana raguwa tana kusantar 1.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Yana ƙaruwa: domin adadin yana ƙaruwa.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka duba adadin kawai. Tushen ma yana ƙaruwa.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Yana raguwa, amma ba ya sauka ƙasa da 1.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka lura da yadda ƙimomin ke canzawa da kuma cewa adadin ya fi tushen girma.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Yana raguwa kuma a ƙarshe ya sauka ƙasa da 1.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Idan adadi ya fi tushe girma, logarithm koyaushe ya fi 1.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.reflect: Da farko ba mu iya tantancewa ba domin dukansu tsakanin 1 da 2 suke; amma da muka sanya 3/2 a matsayin ma’aunin tsakiya, an tantance jerinsu. Idan lambobi biyu sun bambanta, nemo lambar kwatance da za a iya sanya tsakaninsu sannan ka kwatanta kowannensu da ita.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.prompt: Nuna ta amfani da 3/2 ba tare da kalkuleta ba cewa log_2 3>log_3 4.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.hint.0: Za ka iya kwatanta girman log_2 3 da 3/2 ta kwatanta powers biyu na 2. Rubuta 2^(3/2) da 3 da exponent iri ɗaya.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.hint.1: Haka kuma kwatanta log_3 4 da 3/2. Yi murabba’i a ɓangarorin biyu sannan ka kwatanta lambobin cikakku.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka nuna dalilin da ya sa log_2 3 ya fi 3/2 ta kwatanta lambobin cikakku?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka nuna kuma dalilin da ya sa log_3 4 ya yi ƙasa da 3/2?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka haɗa sakamakon biyun ka kammala cewa log_2 3>3/2>log_3 4?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.model.0: 2^(3/2)=√8 ya yi ƙasa da 3, saboda haka log_2 3>3/2; 3^(3/2)=√27 ya fi 4, saboda haka log_3 4<3/2. Don haka log_2 3>3/2>log_3 4.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.model.1: Kwatanta ta yin murabba’i. Tun da 3^2=9>8=2^3, log_2 3>3/2; kuma 4^2=16<27=3^3, log_3 4<3/2. Don haka log_2 3 ya fi girma.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.model.2: Kwatanta log_2 3 da 1.5: 2^3=8<9=3^2, saboda haka ya fi 1.5. Ga log_3 4, 3^3=27>16=4^2, don haka ya yi ƙasa da 1.5. Saboda haka na farko ya fi girma.

n-m-h2-explog-06.title: Zana aikin exponential y=aˣ+b domin ya cika sharuɗɗan da aka bayar.
n-m-h2-explog-06.goal: Ƙirƙiri aikin exponential wanda jadawalinsa ya ratsa batu kuma ya haɗu da axis na x; tantance ta matsayin asymptote da inda jadawalin ya yanke axis na x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.material: Bari mu tsara jadawalin y=a^x+b (a lambar cikakkiya daga 2 zuwa 10 ce, b ma lambar cikakkiya). Za mu yi hukunci bisa dabara da sharuɗɗa kawai, ba tare da zana hoto ba.
n-m-h2-explog-06.thinking.0: Ƙirƙirar dabara da za ta cika sharuɗɗan da kanka
n-m-h2-explog-06.thinking.1: Nemo misalin da ya ratsa batun amma ya karya wani sharadi
n-m-h2-explog-06.thinking.2: Tsara alaƙar asymptote da wurin yanke axis na x
n-m-h2-explog-06.prereq.0: Jadawali da asymptote na aikin exponential y=a^x
n-m-h2-explog-06.prereq.2: Ma’anar wurin yanke axis na x
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.prompt: Shigar da nau’i-nau’i biyu daban-daban (a, b) domin jadawalin y=a^x+b ya ratsa (2, 7) kuma ya haɗu da axis na x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta sharadin ratsa (2, 7) a matsayin ma’auni, nemo alaƙar a da b.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.hint.1: Zaɓi a, nemo b, sannan duba ko jadawalin ya haɗu da axis na x. Idan bai haɗu ba, canza a.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.ok.c1: a lambar cikakkiya ce daga 2 zuwa 10.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.fail.c1: Dole ne a ya zama lambar cikakkiya daga 2 zuwa 10.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.fail.c2: Dole ne b ya zama lamba cikakkiya.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.fail.c3: Idan x=2, y ba 7 ba ne.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.ok.c4: Asymptote y=b yana ƙasa da axis na x, don haka jadawalin yana haɗuwa da axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.fail.c4: Jadawalin ba ya haɗuwa da axis na x. Duba matsayin asymptote y=b da jadawalin.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.explain: Daga a²+b=7, b=7−a². Misali, a=3 yana ba da b=−2, a=4 kuma b=−9; idan b<0, asymptote y=b yana ƙasa da axis na x, don haka jadawalin yana haɗuwa da shi. Idan a=2, b=3, jadawalin yana ratsa (2, 7) amma yana sama da y=3 kawai.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.prompt: Jadawalin da a=2, b=3 ya ratsa (2, 7) amma bai cika sharuɗɗan ba. Rubuta dalili.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.hint.0: Duba asymptote na jadawalin da ko jadawalin yana sama ko ƙasa da shi.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.hint.1: Nemo kewayon ƙimomin y=2^x+3, farawa daga kewayon 2^x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: Ka ce ƙimar y kullum ta fi 3?
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: Ka ce saboda haka y ba zai iya zama 0 ba?
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.model.0: 2^x kullum tabbatacce ne, don haka 2^x+3 kullum ya fi 3. Saboda haka y ba zai zama 0 ba kuma jadawalin ba ya haɗuwa da axis na x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.model.1: Asymptote na jadawalin shi ne y=3, jadawalin kuma yana sama da shi kawai. Saboda haka ba ya haɗuwa da axis na x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.model.2: y=2^x+3 kullum yana ɗaukar ƙima mafi girma da 3, don haka ba ya kaiwa axis na x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.prompt: Idan a>1, zaɓi sharadin b da zai sa jadawalin y=a^x+b ya haɗu da axis na x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta kewayon a^x, sannan nemo kewayon y bayan ƙara masa b.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.hint.1: Yi tunanin yadda b ya kamata ya kasance domin 0 ya shiga cikin kewayon.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.a: Idan b=0, y=a^x ne, wanda kullum tabbatacce ne, don haka ba ya haɗuwa da axis na x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.b: Idan b tabbatacce ne, jadawalin yana sama da b, saboda haka ba ya haɗuwa da axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.c: Ya kuma haɗa yanayin b tabbatacce. Duba yanayin da asymptote yake sama da axis na x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.d: Ka san ƙimomin y=a^x+b duk sun fi b, don haka b dole ya zama mara kyau domin 0 ya shiga kewayon.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.explain: Duk ƙimomin a^x lambobin ainihi ne mafi girma da 0, don haka ƙimomin a^x+b duk sun fi b. Domin 0 ya kasance cikin kewayon ana buƙatar b<0. Wannan yana nufin asymptote y=b yana ƙasa da axis na x.

n-m-h2-explog-08.title: Duba mafitar da ta ƙirga lambobin digits ta amfani da logarithm na gama-gari.
n-m-h2-explog-08.goal: Nemo layin kuskure a mafitar da ta yi amfani da logarithm na gama-gari don nemo adadin digits, sannan ka binciki sauyin adadin a ƙimomin iyaka.
n-m-h2-explog-08.material: Seoyeon ta yi amfani da logarithm na gama-gari domin nemo adadin digits na 3^50. (log 3=0.4771, kuma 3^50 shi ne 3 a matakin 50.)
n-m-h2-explog-08.thinking.0: Nemo layi marar daidai a mafita.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi na farko da ya yi kuskure a mafitar Seoyeon.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.hint.0: Gwada da ƙaramin lamba. Digits nawa ne 10^2=100 yake da su?
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta sakamakon gefe da gefe da ɓangaren lamba na logarithm, ka duba ko ƙarshe na 4 na Seoyeon daidai ne.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.line.0: Domin nemo adadin digits na 3^50, ɗauki logarithm na gama-gari na ɓangarorin biyu.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.line.3: Tun da 10^23≤3^50<10^24, ɓangaren lamba 23 shi ne adadin digits.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.explain: Layi na 4 ne na farko marar daidai. 10^23 yana da 1 da sifilai 23, jimillar digits 24. Don haka N mai 10^23≤N<10^24 yana da digits 24; dole a ƙara 1 ga ɓangaren lamba 23 domin samun adadin digits. Layi na 5 ya biyo bayan layi na 4.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta madaidaicin adadin digits na 3^50, sannan ka ce wane hukuncin Seoyeon za a gyara da yadda.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta adadin digits na 10^1, 10^2, 10^3, ka nemo bambanci tsakanin exponent da adadin digits.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.hint.1: Aiwatar da tsarin ga N mai log N=23.855.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka duba cewa 10^2=100 yana da digits 3?
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka ce dole a ƙara 1 ga ɓangaren lamba?
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana adadin digits idan N ya kai 10^23 amma ya yi ƙasa da 10^24?
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.model.0: Tun da log 3^50=23.855, 10^23≤3^50<10^24. 10^23 yana da digits 24, don haka 3^50 yana da digits 24. Dole a ƙara 1 ga ɓangaren lamba 23.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.model.1: 10 a matakin 23 yana da digits 24, saboda haka 3^50 ma yana da digits 24. Seoyeon ta ɗauki ɓangaren lamba kai tsaye a matsayin adadin digits, amma ya kamata ta ƙara 1.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.model.2: Ɓangaren lamba shi ne 23, adadin digits kuma 23+1=24.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.prompt: Cikin lambobin tabbatattu N da aka ba logarithm na gama-gari a ƙasa, zaɓi duk masu digits 8.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta kowane N a matsayin kewayo tsakanin powers na 10. Misali idan log N=7.2, tsakanin waɗanne powers yake?
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.hint.1: Idan logarithm cikakkiyar lamba ce, rubuta ainihin power na 10 da N yake, sannan ƙirga digits.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.r.a: Ka san idan logarithm cikakkiya ce, N=10^7 mai digits 8 ne.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.r.b: N=10^8 yana da digits 9. Idan ɓangaren lamba 8 ne, adadin digits 9 ne.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.r.c: Wannan hukuncin ƙara 1 ga ɓangaren lamba 7 don samun digits 8 ne.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.r.d: 6.99 yana da ɓangaren lamba 6, don haka digits 7 ne. Kusantar 7 ba daidai yake da kaiwa aƙalla 7 ba.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.explain: Idan ɓangaren lamba na log N shi ne n, N yana da digits n+1. Idan log N=7.0, N=10^7 mai digits 8; idan 7.2 ne, 10^7≤N<10^8, don haka digits 8. 6.99 yana ba da digits 7, 8.0 kuma digits 9.

n-m-h2-explog-10.title: Nemo nau’i-nau’i tabbatattu da log(a+b)=log a+log b yake aiki.
n-m-h2-explog-10.goal: Gwada da ƙirƙirar misalai ko gaskiyar cewa “logarithm na jimla ba jimlar logarithms ba ce” tana da keɓantawa, sannan tsara sharadin a matsayin dabara.
n-m-h2-explog-10.material: log(a+b)=log a+log b ma’auni ne wanda yawanci ba ya aiki. Amma cikin lambobin tabbatattu a da b, akwai nau’i-nau’i da yake aiki? (log na gama-gari ne.)
n-m-h2-explog-10.thinking.0: Ƙirƙiri misalan da yake aiki da kanka
n-m-h2-explog-10.thinking.1: Mayar da jimlar logarithms zuwa logarithm na ninki
n-m-h2-explog-10.prereq.0: Ka’idar logarithm log a+log b=log ab
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.prompt: Shigar da nau’i-nau’i daban-daban 3 na lambobi tabbatattu a,b da log(a+b)=log a+log b yake aiki. (Canza jerin a,b har yanzu nau’i-nau’i ɗaya ne. Decimal ya halatta.)
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.hint.0: Haɗa jimlar logarithms a dama zuwa logarithm guda, ka kwatanta da gefen hagu.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta irin adadin da ake buƙata idan logarithms biyu daidai ne, sannan zaɓi a ka nemo b.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.ok.c1: a da b duka tabbatattu ne.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.fail.c1: Dole a da b duka su zama tabbatattu.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.ok.c2: a+b da ab daidai suke, don haka log(a+b)=log a+log b yana aiki.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.fail.c2: a+b da ab sun bambanta, don haka logarithms ɗin biyu ba daidai ba ne.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.explain: Tun da log a+log b=log ab, ma’aunin yana aiki idan log(a+b)=log ab, wato a+b=ab. (2, 2), (3, 1.5), da (5, 1.25) duk sun dace. Mun yi amfani da cewa logarithms biyu daidai ne kawai idan adadinsu daidai ne.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.prompt: Rubuta a matsayin dabara alaƙar a da b da ke aiki a nau’i-nau’in da ka samu, sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa take sa maganganun biyu daidai.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.hint.0: Ga kowane nau’i-nau’i, ƙididdige a+b da ab sannan ka rubuta su gefe da gefe.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.hint.1: Haɗa log a+log b zuwa logarithm guda, ka rubuta adadinsa.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta log a+log b=log ab?
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: Ka ce idan logarithms sun yi daidai, adadinsu ma daidai ne?
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.model.0: Tun da log a+log b=log ab, domin log(a+b)=log ab ana buƙatar a+b=ab. Dalili kuwa idan logarithms biyu daidai ne, adadinsu daidai ne.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.model.1: Jimla da ninkin a da b dole su yi daidai (ab=a+b). Domin jimlar logarithms ta zama logarithm na ninkin adadinsu, idan logarithms sun yi daidai adadinsu ma daidai ne.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.model.2: Sharadin (a−1)(b−1)=1 ya isa. Idan aka buɗe, ab−a−b+1=1, don haka ab=a+b, kuma log a+log b=log ab=log(a+b).
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi magana daidai kan lambobin tabbatattu a,b da log(a+b)=log a+log b yake aiki.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.hint.0: Idan a bai wuce 1 ba, ɗauki b tabbatacce ka kwatanta wanne ya fi girma, ab ko a+b.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.hint.1: Cikin nau’i-nau’in da suka cika a+b=ab, kwatanta girman a da b.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.o.a: Ɗaya daga a,b na iya zama ƙasa da 1.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.a: Idan a≤1 ne, ab≤b<a+b, don haka a+b ba zai yi daidai da ab ba.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.o.b: a da b duka sun fi 1.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.b: Ka san idan a≤1 ko b≤1, ninkin ya fi jimla ƙanƙanta, don haka ba za su daidaita ba.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.o.c: a da b duka sun yi ƙasa da 1.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.c: Idan dukansu ƙasa da 1 ne, ninkin ya yi ƙasa sosai da jimla.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.o.d: Dole ɗaya daga a,b ya zama 2.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.explain: Idan a≤1, ab≤b<a+b, don haka a+b ba zai zama ab ba. Haka ma idan b≤1. Saboda haka a da b duka sun fi 1 a nau’i-nau’in da suka dace. Tun da (a−1)(b−1)=1, idan ɗaya ya kusanci 1, ɗayan yana ƙaruwa.

n-m-h2-limit-01.title: Me muke buƙatar sani domin cewa aiki continuous ne?
n-m-h2-limit-01.topic: Limits da continuity na ayyuka: sharuɗɗan continuity
n-m-h2-limit-01.goal: Tsara bayanin da ya wajaba kuma ya isa domin kammala cewa aiki continuous ne a x=a; tantance ko aiki continuous ne da kanka, sannan ka tsara ma’aunin hukuncin da kalmominka.
n-m-h2-limit-01.material: Muna son gano ko f continuous ne a x=1. Left-hand limit ita ce ƙimar da f(x) ke kusantar idan x<1 yana kusantar 1; right-hand limit kuma idan x>1 yana kusantar 1. Yi tunanin ko za mu iya cewa “continuous ne” idan mun san wani ɓangare na bayanin kawai.
n-m-h2-limit-01.thinking.0: Bambanta bayanin da zai ba da tabbaci da wanda bai isa ba
n-m-h2-limit-01.thinking.1: Binciki alaƙar ƙimar aiki, left-hand limit da right-hand limit
n-m-h2-limit-01.prereq.1: Kwarewa wajen bambanta ƙimar aiki da ƙimar limit
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi bayani guda game da f da ke tabbatar da continuity a x=1 idan wannan bayanin kaɗai aka sani.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko jera abin da dole a bincika domin cewa continuous ne, sannan alama ko kowane zaɓi ya cika duka.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bambanta “ƙimar tana da ma’ana” da “ƙimar ta yi daidai da limit” a matsayin bayanai dabam.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.a: f(1)=3, kuma f(x) yana kusantar 3 idan x ya kusanci 1 daga dama.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.r.a: Ka duba limit daga gefe ɗaya kawai. Ba mu san ƙimar daga wancan gefe ba tukuna.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.b: f(1)=3, left-hand da right-hand limits duka wanzu kuma daidai suke.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.r.b: Ka san limit yana wanzu amma ba za ka iya sanin ko ƙimarsa ta yi daidai da f(1)=3 ba.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.c: f(1)=3, left-hand da right-hand limits duka 3 ne.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.d: Left-hand da right-hand limits duka 3 ne, f(1) kuma an ayyana shi a matsayin wata ƙima.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.r.d: Sanin f(1) an ayyana kawai bai nuna ko wannan ƙima 3 ce ba.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.explain: Domin continuity, f(1) dole a ayyana shi, limit idan x→1 dole ya wanzu, sannan ƙimar limit ta yi daidai da f(1). Zaɓi c ya cika duka ukun. a yana da limit gefe guda kawai, b bai haɗa limit da f(1) ba, d kuma ba a san ƙimar f(1) ba, saboda haka ba za mu iya sanin ko ta yi daidai da limit ba.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi duk ayyukan huɗu masu continuous a x=1.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ga kowane aiki, nemo ƙimar a x=1, left-hand limit da right-hand limit ɗaya bayan ɗaya, ka tsara a tebur.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ga rational expression, sauƙaƙa idan x≠1, sannan nemo ƙima yayin da x ke kusantar 1.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.r.b: Yayin x→1, (x²−1)/(x−1)=x+1 yana kusantar 2, amma f₂(1)=1 ne, saboda haka limit da ƙimar aikin sun bambanta.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.o.c: f₃(x)=(x²−1)/(x−1) (x≠1), f₃(1) ba a ayyana ba.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.r.c: Idan babu ƙimar aiki a x=1, ba za mu kira shi continuous ba ko da limit yana wanzu.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.explain: f₁=x+1 idan x≠1, don haka limit 2 ne, f₁(1)=2 kuma ya dace. Ga f₄, left limit 2 ne, right limit 3·1−1=2, f₄(1)=2, dukansu daidai. Ga f₂ limit 2 da ƙimar aiki 1 sun bambanta, f₃ kuma ba shi da f₃(1).
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.prompt: A s2 an cire ayyukan da ba continuous ba saboda dalilai dabam. Da kalmominka, tsara abin da dole a bincika domin cewa aiki continuous ne a x=a.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.hint.0: Sake rubuta wane sharadi ne ya cire f₂ da f₃.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.hint.1: Idan dalilan cirewa sun bambanta, ƙirga abubuwan da ake buƙatar bincika domin gano su duka.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana duk sharuɗɗan uku ba tare da barin ɗaya ba?
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma’auninka ya ƙunshi dalilan da aka ƙi f₂ da f₃?
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.model.0: f continuous ne a x=a idan f(a) an ayyana, limit yana wanzu domin left-hand da right-hand limits sun yi daidai yayin x→a, kuma limit ɗin ya yi daidai da f(a).
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.model.1: Na farko ƙimar aiki dole ta wanzu. Na biyu limit dole ya wanzu, wato limits daga ɓangarorin biyu daidai suke. Na uku limit ɗin dole ya yi daidai da ƙimar aikin.

n-m-h2-limit-02.title: Duba iƙirarin cewa tushen yana wanzu ta Intermediate Value Theorem
n-m-h2-limit-02.topic: Limits da continuity na ayyuka: Intermediate Value Theorem
n-m-h2-limit-02.goal: Idan kana amfani da Intermediate Value Theorem, kada ka duba alamomi kawai: tabbatar an cika sharuɗɗan theorem, kuma nuna da counterexample cewa iƙirari ƙarya ne.
n-m-h2-limit-02.material: Seojin ta so gano ko ma’aunin 1/x=0 yana da tushen ainihi a kewayon (−1, 2), don haka ta sa f(x)=1/x ta yi haka.
n-m-h2-limit-02.thinking.0: Duba zato kafin amfani da theorem
n-m-h2-limit-02.thinking.1: Nemo layin da sharadin theorem ya ɓace
n-m-h2-limit-02.thinking.2: Zaɓi hanya don cike sharadin da ya ɓace
n-m-h2-limit-02.prereq.0: Continuous functions da bayanin Intermediate Value Theorem
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi na farko marar daidai a mafitar Seojin.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.hint.0: Rarraba kowane layi zuwa “lissafi” ko “hukuncin amfani da theorem.”
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ga layin amfani da theorem, kwatanta sharuɗɗan theorem da abin da aka bincika ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.line.2: Ta Intermediate Value Theorem, akwai c tsakanin −1 da 2 da f(c)=0.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka ma’aunin 1/x=0 yana da tushen ainihi a kewayon (−1, 2).
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ne kuskuren farko. Ana iya amfani da Intermediate Value Theorem ne kawai idan f continuous ne a rufaffiyar kewayo [−1, 2], amma f(x)=1/x ba a ayyana shi a x=0 da ke cikin kewayon ba. Lissafin layukan 1 da 2 daidai ne, layi na 4 kuma ya biyo bayan ƙarshe marar daidai na layi na 3.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.prompt: Nuna cewa ƙarshe na Seojin ba daidai ba ne. Rubuta sharadin da aiki dole ya cika domin amfani da Intermediate Value Theorem, dalilin da ya sa f(x)=1/x bai cika shi ba, da ainihin tushen 1/x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta theorem a sigar “idan ..., to ...” sannan ka ƙirga sharuddan da ke bayan “idan.”
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.hint.1: Duba ko yankin f(x)=1/x ya rasa wani batu tsakanin −1 da 2.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka nuna x=0 yana cikin kewayon?
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.model.0: Ana iya amfani da Intermediate Value Theorem ne idan f continuous ne a [−1, 2]. Amma f(x)=1/x ba a ayyana shi a x=0, don haka ba continuous ba ne. A zahiri, babu x da 1/x=0, saboda haka babu tushen ainihi.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.model.1: Domin amfani da theorem, aiki dole ya zama continuous a kewayon, amma 1/x yana da tazara a x=0, saboda haka ba za a yi amfani da shi ba. Tunda numerator 1 ne, babu x da 1/x=0; ma’aunin ba shi da mafita.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.prompt: Ka bar f(−1)<0<f(2) yadda yake. Zaɓi sharadin da ya kamata a ƙara domin a tabbatar akwai tushen f(x)=0 a (−1, 2).
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.hint.0: Yi tunanin ko jadawali mai tsalle ko tazara a cikin kewayo zai iya ketare 0 ba tare da ratsa shi ba.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.hint.1: Tantance ko kowane zaɓi yana magana ne kan iyakoki ko dukan kewayo.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.o.a: f continuous ne a x=−1 da x=2.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.r.a: Ko f continuous ne a iyakokin biyu kawai, tazara a tsakiyar kewayo na iya sa a rasa tushen.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.o.b: f(−1) da f(2) duka lambobin cikakku ne.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.r.b: Ko ƙimomi lambobin cikakku ne ba shi da alaƙa da samuwar tushe.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.o.c: f continuous ne a kowane batu na rufaffiyar kewayo [−1, 2].
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.o.d: f(x) ba sifili ba ne ga kowane x a cikin (−1, 2).
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.r.d: Wannan yana nufin babu tushe, don haka ya saba wa ƙarshe.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.explain: Intermediate Value Theorem na buƙatar continuity a duk rufaffiyar kewayo. Da wannan sharadi, dole 0 ya kasance tsakanin ƙimomin iyaka masu alamomi kishiyoyi.

n-m-h2-limit-04.title: Limit na composite function: binciken iƙirarin Mina
n-m-h2-limit-04.topic: Limits da continuity na ayyuka: limit na composite function
n-m-h2-limit-04.goal: Ta misali, tabbatar cewa limit na composite function yana canzawa bisa wane gefe ne inner function ke kusantar 0; bayyana ko iƙirarin gaskiya ne ko ƙarya da dalilinsa.
n-m-h2-limit-04.material: A ayyana f da f(t)=1 idan t>0, f(0)=0, f(t)=−1 idan t<0. Yayin t→0, left limit −1 ne, right limit 1, sun bambanta, don haka limit f ba ya wanzu. A ɗauka g yana kusantar 0 yayin x→0. Mina ta ce, “To limit na composite f(g(x)) yayin x→0 ma ba ya wanzu.” (Yi la’akari da x da g(x)≠0 kawai.)
n-m-h2-limit-04.thinking.1: Bayyana yanayin kusantarwa daga gefe ɗaya
n-m-h2-limit-04.thinking.2: Tsara abin da za a duba domin tantance samuwar limit
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk g(x) da limit na f(g(x)) yayin x→0 yake wanzu.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.hint.0: Sauya x da 0.1, −0.1, 0.01, −0.01, ka duba alamar g(x).
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.hint.1: Da zarar an gano alamar g(x), duba ko ƙimar f(g(x)) ta zama ƙima guda.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.r.b: Idan x>0, g>0; idan x<0, g<0, don haka f(g(x)) yana sauyawa tsakanin 1 da −1.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.r.d: Alamar g tana sauyawa da alamar x, saboda haka f(g(x)) yana sauyawa tsakanin 1 da −1.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.explain: g(x)=x² (x≠0) kullum tabbatacce ne, don haka f(g(x))=1 kuma limit 1 ne. g(x)=−x⁴ (x≠0) kullum mara kyau ne, saboda haka f(g(x))=−1 kuma limit −1 ne. x³ da 2x suna sauya alama, don haka limit ba ya wanzu.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.prompt: Maganar Mina kullum gaskiya ce? Tantance gaskiya ko ƙarya, bayyana dalilinta ta alaƙa da yadda g(x) ke kusantar 0.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.hint.0: Sanya g mai limit daga s1 kusa da wanda ba shi da limit, ka kwatanta yadda alamar g(x) ta bambanta.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.hint.1: Yi tunanin ko girman t ne ko wata sifa ta t ke tantance ƙimar f(t).
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka ba da takamaiman g(x) guda?
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka danganta gefen da yake kusantowa 0 da ƙimar f?
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.model.0: Maganar Mina ba kullum gaskiya ba ce. Idan g(x)=x², g(x) yana kusantar 0 daga tabbatacciyar hanya kawai, don haka f(g(x))=1 kullum kuma limit yana wanzu da ƙima 1.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.model.1: A’a. Idan g(x) yana kusantar 0 daga mara kyau kawai, f(g(x))=−1 kullum, saboda haka limit yana wanzu. g(x)=−x⁴ counterexample ne.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.prompt: Domin sanin ko limit na f(g(x)) idan x→0 yana wanzu, me ya kamata a bincika?
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.hint.0: Yayin x yana kusantar 0, rubuta ƙimomin da input g(x) zuwa f yake ɗauka kusa da 0.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.hint.1: Raba ƙimomin zuwa waɗanda ke gefen left limit na f da gefen right limit.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.o.a: Ko left-hand da right-hand limits na f(t) yayin t→0 suna kusantar ƙima guda ɗaya.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.r.a: Duba wannan kaɗai yana kaiwa ga ƙarshe iri ɗaya da Mina. Ba ya duba ta wane gefe inner function ke kusantowa.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.o.b: Ko f(0) da g(0) daidai ne, kuma ko an ayyana su duka.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.r.b: Ba a amfani da ƙimar x=0 wajen nemo limit yayin x→0.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.o.c: Yadda g(x) ke sauyawa da sauri yayin x→0 da girmansa.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.r.c: Sauri ba shi da alaƙa da samuwar limit.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.o.d: Alamar ƙimomin g(x) kusa da 0 da ƙimar f ga wannan alama.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.explain: Ƙimar f(g(x)) tana dogara da gefen da ƙimomin g(x) suke kusa da 0. Idan g(x) yana kusantowa daga gefe ɗaya, ana buƙatar limit na wannan gefen. Idan yana kusantowa daga biyun, kwatanta left da right limits.

n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.prompt: Informasi dibuka saeutik-saeutik. Dina unggal léngkah, pilih pamadegan dumasar kana hal anu geus dipikanyaho.
n-m-h2-limit-05.title: Ƙimar sin(π/x) yayin da x ke kusantar 0
n-m-h2-limit-05.topic: Limits da continuity na ayyuka: samuwar limit
n-m-h2-limit-05.goal: Kada ka yanke hukunci game da limit daga wasu ƙimomi kaɗan a tebur. Sabunta hukunci yayin samun ƙarin ƙimomi, ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa limit ba ya wanzu.
n-m-h2-limit-05.material: Ga f(x)=sin(π/x) (x≠0), muna son nemo ƙimar da f(x) ke kusantar yayin da x ke kusantar 0 sosai. Ƙara ƙimomi a tebur ɗaya bayan ɗaya, ka yanke hukunci. (Yi amfani da sin kπ=0, sin(π/2)=1, sin(3π/2)=−1.)
n-m-h2-limit-05.thinking.0: Yin hasashen farko daga ƙimomin da aka gani
n-m-h2-limit-05.thinking.1: Sabunta hukunci idan sababbin ƙimomi sun bayyana
n-m-h2-limit-05.prereq.1: Ƙimomin sin (sin kπ=0, sin(π/2)=1, da sauransu)
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.hint.0: Duk lokacin da sabon ƙima ya bayyana, kwatanta ko yana kusantar ƙima ɗaya da na baya.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.hint.1: Yi tunanin ko yadda ka zaɓi x yana wakiltar duk hanyoyin kusantar 0.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.info: A x=1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/10, ƙimomin f(x) duka 0 ne. (x na ƙara kusantar 0.)
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Me kake tunani game da limit na f(x) yayin x→0?
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Idan x=1/n, sin(nπ)=0, don haka ƙima 0 ce. Amma wannan na iya zama sakamakon zaɓar x ta hanya ta musamman.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ina tsammani 0 ne: domin ƙimomin suna ci gaba da zama 0.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan shi ne hasashe na farko daga ƙimomin da muka gani zuwa yanzu.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ya yi wuri a yanke ƙarshe kafin ganin ƙarin ƙimomin x.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka lura cewa ka ga wasu ƙimomi ne kawai.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Limit ba ya wanzu: domin ƙimomin duka iri ɗaya ne.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ƙimomi masu daidaita, a maimakon haka, alama ce ta yiwuwar limit yana wanzu.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Yanzu a x=2/5, 2/9, 2/13, 2/101, ƙimomin f(x) duka 1 ne.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Ko x na kusantar 0, f(x) wani lokaci 0 ne wani lokaci 1. Idan limit yana wanzu, f(x) dole ya kusanci ƙima guda yayin x→0.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Har yanzu 0 ne: domin ƙimomin farko 0 ne.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka yi watsi da sabon bayani. Ko x yana kusa da 0, ƙima 1 ma ta bayyana.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 1 ne: domin ƙimar da aka gani yanzu 1 ce.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ka bi ƙima ta ƙarshe kawai. 0 ɗin da aka gani a baya ma ya fito daga x kusa da 0, haka nan.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Yana da wuya a ce ƙima guda ce: domin 0 da 1 duk sun bayyana ga x kusa da 0.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka lura cewa ƙimomin biyu suna bayyana.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.info: A x=2/3, 2/7, 2/11, 2/103, ƙimomin f(x) duka −1 ne.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: A ƙarshe, me za ka ce game da limit na f(x) yayin x→0?
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Ya danganta da yadda aka zaɓi x kusa da 0, f(x) yana ɗaukar 0, 1 da −1, saboda haka ba za a ce yana kusantar ƙima guda ba. Limit ba ya wanzu.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Limit ba ya wanzu: domin 0, 1 da −1 suna ci gaba da bayyana ga x kusa da 0.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Bayyana da farko ba dalili ba ne.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: −1 ne: domin ita ce ƙima ta ƙarshe da aka gani.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka zaɓi ƙimar da aka gani a ƙarshe.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.reflect: Da farko ƙimomin suna zama 0, don haka limit ya yi kama da 0; amma da na duba wasu x masu kusantar 0, hukuncina ya canza. Kada a tantance limit da “wasu x kaɗan”; duba ko f yana kusantar ƙima guda ga duk x da ke kusantar 0.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta abin lura yayin hasashen limit daga wasu ƙimomi kaɗan a tebur, da hujjar cewa wannan aikin ba shi da limit.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.hint.0: Kwatanta x da tebur ya nuna ƙimomin 0, 1 da −1.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta abin da ƙimomin dole su yi idan limit yana wanzu, komai yadda x ke kusantar 0.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka ba da takamaiman ƙimomin x da ke nuna ƙimar ta bambanta bisa hanyar kusantar 0?
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa wasu ƙimomi kaɗan a tebur ba su isa ba?
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.model.0: Idan na zaɓi x mai siffar 1/n kawai, kullum na samu 0; amma idan x ya kusanci 0 ta wasu hanyoyi, na samu 1 ko −1. Ƙimar f tana bambanta bisa x da ke kusantar 0, don haka limit ba ya wanzu. Kada a yanke hukunci daga ƙimomi kaɗan.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.model.1: Yanke hukunci daga ƙimomi kaɗan a tebur na iya yaudara. Bisa zaɓin x kusa da 0, f(x) yana ɗaukar 0, 1 da −1, don haka ba ya kusantar ƙima guda kuma limit ba ya wanzu.

n-m-h2-limit-06.title: Rubuta wa Seoyun bayani kan “jadawali mai tazara”
n-m-h2-limit-06.topic: Limits da continuity na ayyuka: continuity a yankin ayyanawa
n-m-h2-limit-06.goal: Tsara lokacin da tunanin “jadawali mai tazara yana nufin discontinuous” yake daidai ko kuskure, sannan ka sake bayani da kalmomin da ƙanin makarantar sakandare zai fahimta, ka danganta da domain.
n-m-h2-limit-06.material: Ƙaninka Seoyun ta ce, “Jadawalin f(x)=1/x yana da tazara a x=0, don haka aiki discontinuous ne. Aiki continuous shi ne wanda za a iya zana ba tare da ɗaga fensir ba.” Kana son bayyana mata inda wannan ra’ayi ya yi kuskure.
n-m-h2-limit-06.thinking.1: Fahimtar alaƙar tazara a jadawali da domain
n-m-h2-limit-06.thinking.2: Sake rubuta bayani ya dace da mai sauraro
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk ayyukan da suke continuous a kowane batu na domain ɗinsu.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko rubuta domain, sannan ga kowane batu a ciki duba ko ƙimar limit da ƙimar aiki sun yi daidai.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.hint.1: Faɗi ko wurin da jadawali ya yi kama da karye yana cikin domain ko a waje.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.r.d: A x=0 left limit 0 ne, right limit 1 ne, ƙimar aikin kuma 1; saboda haka aiki ba continuous ba ne a x=0, wanda ke cikin domain.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.explain: A kowane x≠0, magana kusa da batu ga 1/x da x/|x| mai sauƙi ce (1/x ko constants 1 da −1), saboda haka continuous ne a kowane batu na domain. |x| continuous ne ga duk lambobin ainihi. k ba continuous ba ne a x=0 da ke cikin domain domin left da right limits sun bambanta.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta wa Seoyun bayani jimloli 3 zuwa 4. Tana makarantar sakandare kuma watakila kalmomin “limit” da “domain” sababbi ne gare ta. Haɗa dalilin da ya sa tazarar 1/x ba daidai take da aiki discontinuous ba.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.hint.0: Fara da rubuta da kalmomin da Seoyun za ta fahimta abin da ke faruwa idan aka saka x=0 cikin 1/x.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta ko “jadawali yana da tazara” da “ƙima tana tsalle a batu mai ƙima” abu ɗaya suke nufi.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka yi amfani da kalmomin da ɗalibin sakandare zai fahimta?
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka nuna daidai dalilin tazarar (yana wajen domain)?
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.model.0: Seoyun, 1/x ba shi da ƙima kwata-kwata idan x=0, don haka jadawali ya yi kama da mai tazara a nan. Continuity yana tambayar ko ƙima tana tsalle kusa da kowane batu da ke da ƙima. Duk inda 1/x yake da ƙima, ba ya tsalle, don haka continuous ne.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.model.1: Ba za a saka 0 cikin 1/x ba, saboda haka babu jadawali a wannan batu. Aiki continuous ne idan ƙimar limit ta yi daidai da ƙimar aiki a kowane batu da aka ayyana; saboda haka 1/x ma continuous ne inda yake da ƙima.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.model.2: Seoyun, ba za a saka 0 cikin 1/x ba. Don haka babu batu na jadawali a x=0. Babu tazara inda aka zana jadawalin, don haka continuous ne.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.model.3: Seoyun, ba za a raba da 0 ba, ko? Saboda haka ba a zana 1/x a 0. Babu tsalle inda aka zana shi, don haka ana kiransa continuous.

n-m-h2-limit-07.title: Gina da kanka continuity na jimlar ayyuka biyu
n-m-h2-limit-07.topic: Limits da continuity na ayyuka: jimlar ayyukan continuous
n-m-h2-limit-07.goal: Duba alkiblar ƙa’idar cewa jimlar ayyuka continuous ita ma continuous ce, gina nau’i-nau’i na ayyuka masu jimlarsu continuous alhali kowannensu discontinuous ne, sannan bayyana dalili.
n-m-h2-limit-07.material: Ka koya idan f da g continuous ne a x=0, f+g ma continuous ne a x=0. Kana son gano ko nau’ikan juye-juye na wannan ƙa’ida duka gaskiya ne.
n-m-h2-limit-07.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin da discontinuities ke soke juna
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.prompt: Ga ayyuka biyu f da g, zaɓi duk maganganun da kullum gaskiya ne.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.hint.0: A kowace magana, raba zato da ƙarshe, ka nuna ko alkiblar iri ɗaya ce da ƙa’idar ko akasin ta.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.hint.1: Za ka iya gwada maganganun akasin alkibla da ayyukan step biyu masu sauƙi.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.o.a: Idan f da g continuous ne a x=0, f+g continuous ne a x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.o.b: Idan f+g continuous ne a x=0, duka f da g continuous ne a x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.r.b: Wannan iƙirarin akasin alkibla ne. Yi tunanin ko f da g za su iya rama discontinuity na juna.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.o.c: Idan f da g discontinuous ne a x=0, f+g discontinuous ne a x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.r.c: Yi tunanin ko discontinuities biyu za su iya ɓacewa idan aka haɗa.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.o.d: Idan f da g continuous ne a x=0, f·g continuous ne a x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.explain: Jimla da product na ayyukan continuous continuous ne, don haka a da d gaskiya ne. Ga b da c akwai lokutan da ba su aiki. A s2 ƙirƙiri misalai da kanka ka tabbatar.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.prompt: Da constants p da q, gina f(x)=1 idan x≥0, f(x)=p idan x<0; g(x)=1 idan x≥0, g(x)=q idan x<0. Shigar da nau’i-nau’i biyu daban (p,q) inda f da g duka discontinuous a x=0 amma f+g continuous. 0
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta left limit, right limit da ƙimar aikin f+g a x=0 ta p da q.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.hint.1: Nemo alaƙar p da q da za ta daidaita ƙimomin uku, zaɓi nau’i-nau’i da p≠1 da q≠1.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.var.p: Ƙimar p ta f idan x<0
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.var.q: Ƙimar q ta g idan x<0
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Left limit na f+g ya bambanta da ƙimar aikin.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.explain: A x=0, right limit da ƙimar aikin f+g su ne 1+1=2, left limit kuma p+q ne. Don haka f+g continuous ne idan p+q=2. Idan p=1 ko q=1, ɗaya daga ayyukan ya riga ya zama continuous, don haka a cire waɗannan.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.prompt: A jimloli 1 ko 2 bayyana dalilin da ya sa f+g continuous ne duk da cewa f da g kowannensu discontinuous ne.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Rubuta bambancin left limit da ƙimar aikin f a x=0, da irin wannan bambanci ga g.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Duba abin da ke faruwa idan aka haɗa bambance-bambancen biyu.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta girman saɓanin kowane aiki a matsayin magana?
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka nuna saɓanin ya zama 0 idan an haɗa su?
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.model.0: A x=0, f yana tsalle ƙasa da p−1, g kuma q−1; idan aka haɗa su suna soke juna. Left limit na f+g shi ne 2, right limit da ƙimar aikin ma 2 ne, don haka continuous ne.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.model.1: Haɗa left limits yana ba p+q=2, don haka left limit, right limit da ƙimar f+g duka 2 ne. Saɓanin ayyukan biyu sun haɗu sun ɓace.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.prompt: Ta amfani da tsarin s2 ɗaya (1 idan x≥0, p ko q idan x<0), kana son gina misalin da product f·g continuous a x=0 amma f da g duka discontinuous. Wane sharadi ya dace?
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko nemo right limit da ƙimar aikin f·g a x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.hint.1: Bayyana left limit ta p,q, sannan kafa ma’auni da ta yi daidai da ƙimar da ta gabata.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.r.a: Ka ɗauko sharadin jimla. Ga product, left limit pq ne.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.r.c: Ba ka duba cewa right limit da ƙimar aikin product 1·1=1 ne.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.r.d: p=q kaɗai ba ya tabbatar pq=1. Misali idan p=q=2, pq=4.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.explain: A x=0 right limit da ƙimar f·g su ne 1·1=1, left limit kuma pq. Saboda haka continuous ne idan pq=1. Idan p≠1, q=1/p≠1, don haka ayyukan biyun discontinuous ne (misali p=2,q=1/2).

n-m-h2-limit-08.thinking.0: Manggihan garis munggaran anu salah dina solusi
n-m-h2-limit-08.title: Duba mafitar limit mai |x−1|
n-m-h2-limit-08.topic: Limits da continuity na ayyuka: limits na maganganu masu absolute value
n-m-h2-limit-08.goal: Fahimci cewa dole a binciki alamomi kafin a soke a magana mai absolute value, sannan ka gyara mafita ta nemo left da right limits daban.
n-m-h2-limit-08.material: Hyunwoo ya nemo lim_{x→1}(x²−1)/|x−1| kamar haka. (|x−1| shi ne absolute value na x−1.)
n-m-h2-limit-08.thinking.1: Gyara mafita ta left da right limits
n-m-h2-limit-08.thinking.2: Duba alamar magana cikin absolute value
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi na farko marar daidai a mafitar Hyunwoo.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta |x−1| ba tare da alamar absolute value ba idan x<1 da idan x>1.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta sakamakon da maganar da Hyunwoo ya soke.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s1.line.1: Soke x−1 a numerator da denominator yana ba x+1.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s1.line.2: Don haka idan x→1, x+1 yana kusantar 2.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s1.explain: Layi na 2 ne kuskuren farko. Denominator |x−1| ne, ba x−1 ba; idan x<1, |x−1|=−(x−1). Don haka ba za a soke x−1 a denominator da x−1 a numerator kai tsaye ba. Layukan 3 da 4 sun biyo bayan wannan magana marar daidai.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.prompt: Gyara mafitar Hyunwoo ta nemo left limit da right limit daban.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.hint.0: Idan x<1, soke ka sauƙaƙa magana, sannan nemo ƙimarta yayin x→1. Yi irin haka ga x>1.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta ƙimomin biyu, duba ko sharadin samuwar limit ya cika.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka sake rubuta |x−1| daban idan x<1 da x>1?
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka kammala cewa limit ba ya wanzu domin limits biyun sun bambanta?
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.model.0: Idan x>1, |x−1|=x−1, sokewa tana ba x+1, right limit 2. Idan x<1, |x−1|=−(x−1), maganar ta zama −(x+1), left limit −2. Limits sun bambanta, don haka limit ba ya wanzu.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.model.1: Right limit x+1→2 idan x>1, left limit −(x+1)→−2 idan x<1. Ƙimomin sun bambanta, saboda haka limit ba ya wanzu.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.prompt: Zaɓi ɗaya cikin waɗannan da limit yake wanzu yayin x→1.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.hint.0: Ga kowane zaɓi, fara duba ko magana cikin absolute value tana sauya alama kusa da x=1.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.hint.1: Yi tunanin idan alama ba ta canza ba, ko za a iya cire absolute value kawai.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.r.a: Wannan magana ce daga misalin da aka warware. Left da right limits sun bambanta.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.r.c: Kusa da x=1, x+1 tabbatacce ne, don haka |x²−1|=|x−1|(x+1), left limit −2 ne, right limit 2, sun bambanta.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.r.d: Numerator yana kusantar 2, denominator kuma 0; idan x>1 yana ƙaruwa ba iyaka, idan x<1 yana raguwa ba iyaka. Limit ba ya wanzu.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.explain: Kusa da x=1, x+1>0, don haka |x+1|=x+1, (x²−1)/|x+1|=x−1, limit 0 ne. Abu mafi muhimmanci shi ne ko magana cikin absolute value tana sauya alama kusa da 1.

n-m-h2-limit-09.title: Rashin daidaito da limits: binciken iƙirarin Ayun
n-m-h2-limit-09.topic: Limits da continuity na ayyuka: alaƙar tsari na limits
n-m-h2-limit-09.goal: Yi amfani da counterexample don bincika abin da ke faruwa da rashin daidaito mai tsauri idan aka ɗauki limits, sannan bayyana ko iƙirarin gaskiya ne, ƙarya ne, da ƙarshe madaidaiciya.
n-m-h2-limit-09.material: Ayun ta yi iƙirari: “Idan f(x)<g(x) ga kowane x(≠0) kusa da x=0, kuma limits lim f(x) da lim g(x) duka suna wanzu, to limits ɗin ma lim f(x)<lim g(x). Rashin daidaiton yana nan yadda yake.”
n-m-h2-limit-09.thinking.1: Bayyana dalilin da rashin daidaito ke laushi
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi nau’i-nau’in (f,g) da ke zama counterexample don nuna iƙirarin Ayun ƙarya ne. (x→0)
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s1.hint.0: Raba iƙirarin zuwa “zato → ƙarshe,” tuna counterexample yana cika zato amma yana karya ƙarshe.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s1.hint.1: Ga kowane zaɓi, bincika ko f(x)<g(x) gaskiya ne idan x≠0, sannan kwatanta girman limits biyu.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s1.r.a: x²<0 ba ya aiki ga kowane x, don haka bai cika zato ba.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s1.r.b: Ya cika zato kuma limits sun cika −1<1, daidai da iƙirarin Ayun; saboda haka ba counterexample ba ne.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s1.r.d: x<x+1 yana aiki, limits kuma 0<1, daidai da iƙirarin Ayun; saboda haka ba counterexample ba ne.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s1.explain: f(x)=0 da g(x)=x² suna da f(x)<g(x) ga x≠0, amma limits ɗinsu duka 0 ne. Ya cika zato ya karya ƙarshe, don haka counterexample ne.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta abin da ke faruwa da rashin daidaito f(x)<g(x) a limit yayin x→0. Jimla ɗaya kuma bayyana dalili ta counterexample.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s2.hint.0: Ta amfani da counterexample na s1, rubuta abin da ke faruwa ga g(x)−f(x) yayin x→0.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s2.hint.1: Yi tunanin alaƙar tsari na limits idan wannan bambanci ya zama ƙanƙanta marar iyaka.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka faɗi da jimla yadda rashin daidaiton ke canzawa?
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta f da g na counterexample ɗinka takamaimai?
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s2.model.0: A limit, < yana laushi ya zama ≤. Idan f(x)=0,g(x)=x², to f<g ga kowane x≠0 amma limits biyun 0 ne. Dalili kuwa bambancin g−f yana kusantar 0.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s2.model.1: Ɗaukar limit na iya sa su zama daidai. Misali 0 kullum ya yi ƙasa da x², amma limits ɗinsu duka 0 ne.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s3.prompt: Idan f(x)<g(x) ga duk x(≠0) kusa da 0 kuma limits biyun wanzu, zaɓi ƙarshe da kullum gaskiya ne.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s3.hint.0: Duba tsarin limits a counterexample na s1 da misalin f=x,g=x+1.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s3.hint.1: Riƙe alaƙar da gaskiya ce a misalan biyu.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s3.r.b: A counterexample na s2 limits sun yi daidai.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s3.r.c: Ko da f<g ne, limit na f ba zai iya fi na g ba.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s3.r.d: A counterexample (0,x²), limits biyun sun yi daidai.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s3.explain: Idan f(x)<g(x), a limit ≤ kaɗai aka tabbatar. Akwai misalin da daidaito yake, don haka < ba gaskiya ba ne, > kuma kullum ƙarya ce.

n-m-h2-limit-10.title: Duba mafitar nemo a da g(x)=f(x)f(x−a) continuous
n-m-h2-limit-10.topic: Limits da continuity na ayyuka: continuity na product
n-m-h2-limit-10.goal: Nemo ka gyara mafitar da ta rasa yanayi na musamman inda wuraren discontinuity biyu suka zo wuri guda, sannan binciki dalilin da aikin yake continuous idan sun zo wuri guda.
n-m-h2-limit-10.material: Ga f(x)=x+2 idan x<0, f(x)=x−2 idan x≥0. Ana neman duk ƙimomin constant a da g(x)=f(x)f(x−a) continuous ga kowane x ainihi. Duba mafitar Eunwoo.
n-m-h2-limit-10.thinking.0: Kwatanta x da tebur ya nuna ƙimomin 0, 1 da −1.
n-m-h2-limit-10.thinking.1: Rubuta yadda ƙimomin dole su kasance idan limit yana wanzu, komai hanyar da x ke bi zuwa 0.
n-m-h2-limit-10.thinking.2: Ka bayar da takamaiman x da ke nuna ƙimar ta bambanta bisa hanyar kusantar 0?
n-m-h2-limit-10.prereq.0: Ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ƙimomi kaɗan a tebur ba su isa ba?
n-m-h2-limit-10.prereq.1: Idan na zaɓi x mai siffar 1/n kawai, kullum na samu 0; amma yayin x yana kusantar 0 ta wasu hanyoyi, na samu 1 ko −1. f yana ɗaukar ƙimomi dabam bisa x da ke kusantar 0, saboda haka limit ba ya wanzu. Kada a yanke hukunci daga ƙimomi kaɗan.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.prompt: Yanke hukunci daga wasu ƙimomi kaɗan na tebur na iya yaudarar ka. Bisa zaɓin x kusa da 0, f(x) yana ɗaukar 0,1,−1; ba ya kusantar ƙima guda, don haka limit ba ya wanzu.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.hint.1: Limits da continuity na ayyuka: continuity a domain
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.line.0: Tsara lokacin da ra’ayin “jadawali mai tazara yana nufin discontinuous” yake daidai da inda yake kuskure, sannan ka sake bayani da kalmomi da ƙanin makarantar sakandare zai fahimta, ka danganta da domain. [0]
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.line.1: Ƙaninka Seoyun ta ce, “Jadawalin f(x)=1/x yana da tazara a x=0, saboda haka aiki discontinuous ne. Aiki continuous shi ne wanda za a iya zana ba tare da ɗaga fensir ba.” Kana son bayyana mata kuskuren. [0, 2, 2]
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.line.3: Fahimtar alaƙar tazara a jadawali da domain [2, 2]
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.explain: Sake fasalta bayani bisa mai sauraro [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2, 3, 4]
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi duk ayyukan continuous a kowane batu na domain ɗinsu. [0]
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Fara da domain, sannan ga kowane batu da ke cikinsa duba ko ƙimar limit ta yi daidai da ƙimar aiki. [0]
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Faɗi ko wurin da jadawali ya yi kama da karye yana cikin domain ko a waje.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.model.0: A x=0 left limit 0 ne, right limit 1 ne, ƙimar aiki kuma 1 ce; saboda haka aiki ba continuous ba ne a x=0 da ke cikin domain. [0, 0, 2, 2, 2, 2, 4, 4, 4]
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.model.1: A kowane x≠0, magana kusa da batu ga 1/x da x/|x| mai sauƙi ce (1/x ko constants 1 da −1), saboda haka suna continuous a kowane batu na domain. |x| continuous ne ga kowane lambar ainihi. k ba continuous ba ne a x=0 da ke cikin domain domin left da right limits sun bambanta. [0, 2, 2, 4, 4, 4]
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta wa Seoyun bayani jimloli 3 zuwa 4. Tana makarantar sakandare kuma kalmomin “limit” da “domain” na iya zama sababbi gare ta. Haɗa dalilin da tazara ta 1/x ba daidai take da discontinuity ba. [0, 0]
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.hint.0: Fara da bayyana da kalmomi masu sauƙi abin da ke faruwa idan aka saka x=0 cikin 1/x.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta ko “jadawali yana da tazara” da “ƙima tana tsalle a wani batu mai ƙima” abu ɗaya suke nufi.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.o.a: Ka yi amfani da kalmomin da ɗalibin sakandare zai fahimta?
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.r.a: Ka nuna ainihin dalilin tazarar (batu a wajen domain)?
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.o.b: Seoyun, 1/x ba shi da ƙima kwata-kwata a x=0, don haka jadawali yana da tazara a wurin. Continuity yana tambayar ko ƙimar tana tsalle kusa da kowane batu da yake da ƙima. Duk inda 1/x yake da ƙima, ba ya tsalle, don haka aiki continuous ne.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.r.b: Ba za a saka 0 cikin 1/x ba, saboda haka babu jadawali a wannan batu. Aiki continuous ne idan ƙimar limit ta yi daidai da ƙimar aiki a kowane batu da aka ayyana; saboda haka 1/x, wanda ba ya karyewa inda yake da ƙima, continuous ne. [2, 2]
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.o.c: Seoyun, ba za a saka 0 cikin 1/x ba. Don haka babu batu na jadawali a x=0 kwata-kwata. Babu tazara inda aka zana shi, saboda haka aiki continuous ne.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.r.c: Seoyun, ba za a raba da 0 ba, ko? Don haka ba a zana 1/x a 0. Babu tsalle inda aka zana shi, saboda haka ana kiransa continuous. [0, 2]
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.o.d: Gina continuity na jimlar ayyuka biyu da kanka
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.r.d: Limits da continuity na ayyuka: jimlar ayyukan continuous [2, 3]
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.explain: Binciki alkiblar ka’idar cewa jimlar ayyuka continuous ita ma continuous ce; gina ayyuka biyu masu jimlarsu continuous amma kowannensu discontinuous, sannan bayyana dalili. [0, 0, 2, 2, 2, 4, 4, 4]

n-m-h2-limit-11.title: Ka koya idan f da g continuous ne a x=0, f+g ma continuous ne a x=0. Kana son gano ko juye-juye iri-iri na wannan ka’ida duka gaskiya ne.
n-m-h2-limit-11.goal: Gina misali da ya cika sharuddan
n-m-h2-limit-11.material: Bayyana yadda discontinuities ke soke juna [0, 6, 6, 8, 8]
n-m-h2-limit-11.thinking.2: Ga ayyuka biyu f da g, zaɓi duk bayanan da kullum gaskiya ne.
n-m-h2-limit-11.prereq.0: Ga kowace magana, raba zato da ƙarshe, ka nuna ko alkiblar iri ɗaya ce da ƙa’idar ko akasin haka.
n-m-h2-limit-11.prereq.1: Za a iya gwada maganganun da aka juya da ayyukan step biyu masu sauƙi.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.prompt: Idan f da g continuous ne a x=0, f+g continuous ne a x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.hint.0: Idan f+g continuous ne a x=0, f da g duka continuous ne a x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.hint.1: Wannan iƙirari akasin alkibla ne. Yi tunanin ko f da g za su iya rama discontinuity na juna. [0]
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.r.a: Idan f da g discontinuous ne a x=0, f+g discontinuous ne a x=0. [18, 8]
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.r.c: Yi tunanin ko discontinuities biyu za su iya ɓacewa idan aka haɗa. [0, 0]
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.r.d: Idan f da g continuous ne a x=0, f·g continuous ne a x=0. [1]
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.explain: Jimla da ninkin ayyukan continuous duka continuous ne, don haka a da d gaskiya. Ga b da c akwai yanayin da ba su aiki. A s2 gina misalan da kanka ka tabbatar. [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 18, 8]
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.prompt: Da constants p,q, sa f(x)=1 idan x≥0, f(x)=p idan x<0; g(x)=1 idan x≥0, g(x)=q idan x<0. Shigar da nau’i-nau’i biyu daban (p,q) da f,g duka discontinuous a x=0 amma f+g continuous.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta left limit, right limit da ƙimar aikin f+g a x=0 ta p,q.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.hint.1: Nemo alaƙar p da q da ke sa ƙimomin uku daidai, zaɓi nau’i-nau’i da p≠1 da q≠1.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ƙimar p ta f idan x<0
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ƙimar q ta g idan x<0
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.o.a: Left limit na f+g ya bambanta da ƙimar aikin.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.r.a: A x=0, right limit da ƙimar f+g su ne 1+1=2, left limit kuma p+q. Saboda haka f+g continuous idan p+q=2. Idan p=1 ko q=1, ɗaya daga cikin ayyukan ya zama continuous, don haka a cire.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.o.b: A jimloli 1 ko 2, bayyana dalilin da ya sa f+g continuous ne ko da f da g duka discontinuous ne.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.r.b: Rubuta bambancin left limit da ƙimar f a x=0, sannan irin wannan na g.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.o.c: Duba abin da ke faruwa idan aka haɗa bambance-bambancen biyu.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.o.d: Ka rubuta saɓanin kowane aiki a matsayin magana?
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.r.d: Ka nuna saɓanin ya zama 0 idan an haɗa?
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.explain: A x=0, f yana tsalle ƙasa da p−1, g kuma q−1, amma idan aka haɗa suna soke juna; left limit na f+g ya zama 2, right limit da ƙimar aikin ma 2 ne, don haka continuous ne. [0, 0]

n-m-h2-trig-06.title: Gina alwatika mai gefuna lambobin integer kuma mai kusurwa ɗaya 60°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.goal: Yi amfani da cos60°=1/2 a dokar kosin domin kafa dangantaka tsakanin gefunan alwatika mai kusurwar 60°, sannan ka gina alwatika marasa kama waɗanda tsawon dukkan gefunansu lambobi integer ne.
n-m-h2-trig-06.material: A cikin alwatika ABC, a=BC, b=CA, c=AB kuma ∠C=60°. Kana son gina alwatika mai tsawon gefuna ukun lambobin natural.
n-m-h2-trig-06.thinking.1: Gina misalin da ya cika sharuddan da kanka.
n-m-h2-trig-06.thinking.2: Cire misalai marasa amfani da waɗanda suke kama.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi dangantakar da ta dace tsakanin a, b, c idan ∠C=60°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko rubuta dokar kosin yadda take, sannan ka saka ƙimar cos60°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.hint.1: Saka a=b=c=1 (alwatika mai daidaitattun gefuna) cikin kowanne lissafi domin gwada wanne ne daidai.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.r.a: A cikin −2ab cosC na dokar kosin, ka ɗauki cos60° a matsayin 1. Ka sake duba ƙimar cos60°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.r.b: An rubuta alamar akasin haka. Ka yi tunanin kusurwar da ke bayar da wannan alamar.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.r.c: Ka saka cos60°=1/2 a cikin −2ab cosC sannan ka ƙididdige.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.r.d: Ka rubuta dangantakar alwatika mai kusurwar dama. Ka duba ko ∠C kusurwar dama ce.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.explain: Dokar kosin ita ce c²=a²+b²−2ab cosC kuma cos60°=1/2, saboda haka c²=a²+b²−ab. Idan alamar +ab ce, to ∠C=120°; idan c²=a²+b² ne, to ∠C=90°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.prompt: Gina alwatika 2 marasa kama masu ∠C=60° kuma dukkan gefuna lambobin natural ne (ba su wuce 40 ba), sannan ka shigar da a, b, c. (Kada ka haɗa alwatika mai daidaitattun gefuna; a da b kada su sami wani mai raba su da ya wuce 1; kuma a ɗauki alwatikan da suka bambanta kawai ta musayar a da b a matsayin alwatika ɗaya.)
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi ƙimar a guda ɗaya, sannan ka canza b zuwa 1, 2, 3, ... kana ƙididdige a²+b²−ab.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.hint.1: Ka duba ko sakamakon cikakken murabba’in wani lambar natural ne.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Lambobin ukun lambobin natural ne, kuma ba su wuce 40 ba.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Lambobin ukun dole su zama lambobin natural daga 1 zuwa 40.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.fail.c2: c² ba ya daidaita da a²+b²−ab, saboda haka ∠C ba 60° ba ce.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Ba alwatika mai daidaitattun gefuna ba ne.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Idan a=b, alwatikan yana da daidaitattun gefuna. Ba a haɗa irin wannan alwatika.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.ok.c4: Mai raba a da b guda ɗaya tilo shi ne 1.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.fail.c4: a da b suna da mai raba da ya fi 1, saboda haka wannan alwatika faɗaɗa ce ta wani ƙarami mai kama da shi.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.prompt: Rubuta cikin jimla ɗaya ko biyu yadda ka gano wannan alwatika.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Kafaffen ƙimar a guda ɗaya, sai ka yi tunanin irin ƙimar da ka lissafta yayin canza b.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ka faɗi wace lamba wannan ƙimar dole ta zama domin ta zama c².
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka yi ƙididdiga kana canza a da b?
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka duba ko ƙimar da ka ƙididdige cikakken murabba’i ce?
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Na sanya a=3, sannan na ƙididdige a²+b²−ab ina canza b. Lokacin da b=8, sakamakon ya zama 49, cikakken murabba’i. Saboda haka c=7.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Na saka a da b bi da bi cikin dangantakar c²=a²+b²−ab, ina neman yanayin da sakamakon cikakken murabba’i ne.

n-m-h2-trig-08.title: Tsarwar hasumiya da ake gani daga wurare biyu.
n-m-h2-trig-08.goal: Fahimci cewa sanin kusurwa da nisa ba ya nufin akwai ƙima guda ɗaya kawai: ƙididdige tsarin wuri biyu masu yiwuwa, sannan ka sake rubuta matsalar da sharadin da zai zaɓi guda ɗaya.
n-m-h2-trig-08.material: Akwai hasumiya a fili. Tushen hasumiyar P da wurare A da B suna kan layi guda, kuma AB=20 m. Kusurwar ɗaga ido zuwa saman hasumiyar ita ce 30° daga A, 45° kuma daga B. Ka yi watsi da tsayin ido. Seoyun ta ce, “Mun san kusurwoyin biyu da nisan, saboda haka tsayin hasumiyar yana da ƙima guda tabbatacciya,” Hajun kuma ya ce, “Ana iya kallon lamarin ta wata hanya.”
n-m-h2-trig-08.thinking.0: Yanke hukunci kan yawan amsoshin da bayanin da aka bayar zai tantance.
n-m-h2-trig-08.thinking.1: Raba zuwa yanayi sannan ka ƙididdige.
n-m-h2-trig-08.prereq.1: Dangantakar tsawo da nisa a alwatika mai kusurwar dama.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi hukuncin daidai game da wanda maganarsa take daidai.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.hint.0: Zana duk tsarin wuraren da za su yiwu idan A, B, da P suna kan layi guda.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.hint.1: A kowane tsari, duba ko za ka iya bayyana nisan daga P zuwa A da daga P zuwa B ta amfani da tsawo h.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.o.a: Seoyun: Akwai kusurwoyin ɗaga ido biyu da nisa guda, saboda haka tsayin tabbas yana da ƙima guda.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.r.a: Ko da akwai bayanai da yawa, dole ne ka bincika daban ko siffar tana da ƙima guda tabbatacciya.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.o.b: Hajun: Ba mu san nisa zuwa tushen hasumiyar ba, saboda haka ba za a iya tantance tsayin ko ta yaya ba.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.r.b: Wannan ya wuce gona da iri yana cewa ba za a tantance shi ba. Ƙididdige ko kusurwoyin za su iya rage shi zuwa nisa guda.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.o.c: Hajun: Tsayin ya bambanta gwargwadon ko wuraren biyu suna gefe ɗaya ko gefuna mabambanta na tushen hasumiyar.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.r.c: Ka nuna cewa bayanin da aka bayar ba ya kayyade tsarin wuraren ta hanya guda.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.o.d: Seoyun: Kusurwoyin ɗaga ido sun bambanta, saboda haka tabbas A da B suna gefuna mabambanta na tushen hasumiyar.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.r.d: Ka yanke matsayinsu daga bambancin kusurwoyi. Ka yi tunanin ko ko da suna gefe ɗaya, wurin da ya fi kusa ba zai ga saman da kusurwa mafi girma ba.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.explain: Idan suna gefe ɗaya, kusurwar ɗaga ido daga wurin B da ya fi kusa (45°) ta fi girma; idan suna gefuna mabambanta ma, kusurwoyin na iya zama 30° da 45°. Saboda haka tsari biyu suna yiwuwa, kuma tsayinsu ma ya bambanta (za a ƙididdige a mataki na gaba), don haka dole ne matsalar ta fayyace tsari ɗaya. Wannan ba ya nufin ba za a iya ƙididdigewa ba. Da zarar an fayyace tsarin, ana tantance tsayin.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.prompt: A ce tsayin h ne. Nemo ① tsayin h1 idan A da B suna gefe ɗaya na tushen P, da ② tsayin h2 idan P yana tsakanin A da B (gefe-gafe mabambanta), sannan ka shigar da kowanne zuwa wuraren goma biyu. (a cikin m)
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta tsayin a matsayin h sannan ka bayyana PA da PB ta amfani da h ta hanyar alwatika masu kusurwar dama.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.hint.1: Yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa bambancin nisan biyun 20 ne idan suna gefe ɗaya, jimillarsu kuma 20 ce idan suna gefuna mabambanta.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.var.h1: Tsayi h1 idan suna gefe ɗaya.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.var.h2: Tsayi h2 idan suna gefuna mabambanta.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Idan suna gefe ɗaya, yana cika √3·h−h=20.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Idan suna gefe ɗaya, PA−PB=20. Kafa lissafin da PA=√3·h kuma PB=h.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.ok.c3: Idan suna gefuna mabambanta, yana cika √3·h+h=20.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Idan suna gefuna mabambanta, PA+PB=20. Kafa lissafin da PA=√3·h kuma PB=h.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.explain: Idan kusurwa daga A ita ce 30°, PA=h÷tan30°=√3·h; idan kusurwa daga B ita ce 45°, PB=h. Idan suna gefe ɗaya, PA−PB=20, don haka h=20÷(√3−1)=10(√3+1)≈27.32. Idan suna gefuna mabambanta, PA+PB=20, don haka h=20÷(√3+1)=10(√3−1)≈7.32.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.prompt: Sake rubuta wannan matsala ta hanyar ƙara jimla guda ɗaya kawai domin a tantance tsayin ta hanya guda.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.hint.0: Sake tuna yawan tsarin wuraren da zai yiwu.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta jimla guda da za ta zaɓi ɗaya daga cikinsu.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka karanta ƙarin jimlar domin ka tabbatar cewa tana kayyade tsarin ta hanya guda?
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana alaƙar matsayin A, B, da P?
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.model.0: Ƙara jimla guda da ke cewa A da B suna gefe ɗaya na tushen hasumiyar P.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.model.1: Tushen hasumiyar P yana tsakanin A da B.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.model.2: Tushen hasumiyar P yana kan sashen AB.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.model.3: An gaya mana cewa nisan daga A zuwa tushen hasumiyar P shi ne 20√3 m.

n-m-h2-integ-06.title: Nemo duk layukan da ke kewaye da yanki iri ɗaya tare da parabola
n-m-h2-integ-06.topic: Yanki tsakanin parabola da layi: alama da gano wanda ke sama
n-m-h2-integ-06.goal: Fahimci cewa ana samun yanki ta cire maganar ƙasa daga ta sama, kuma ana sarrafa gangarowa mara kyau haka nan; nemo duk layukan da suka cika sharadin.
n-m-h2-integ-06.material: Akwai parabola y=x² da layin y=mx ta asali (m≠0, m lamba cikakkiya ce). Jadawalai biyun suna haɗuwa a x=0 da x=m. Bari S(m) ya zama yankin da suka kewaye.
n-m-h2-integ-06.thinking.0: Amfani da jadawali don duba wanne yake sama da kewayo
n-m-h2-integ-06.thinking.1: Duba alkiblar definite integral (ƙaramin iyaka, babbar iyaka) da alama
n-m-h2-integ-06.thinking.2: Duba yanayi ta amfani da daidaito
n-m-h2-integ-06.prereq.1: Yanki tsakanin lanƙwasu biyu (magana ta sama − magana ta ƙasa)
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi definite integral da ya dace don S(−2) idan m=−2.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.hint.0: Idan m=−2, zana jadawalai biyu, fara yi wa haɗin x na wuraren haɗuwa alama, ka gano wanne jadawali yake sama tsakaninsu.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.hint.1: Ka tuna abin da ke faruwa ga definite integral idan ƙaramar iyaka ta fi babbar iyaka ko idan integrand mara kyau ne.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.o.a: ∫₀^{−2}(−2x−x²)dx: haɗa daga 0 zuwa −2, ka cire magana ta ƙasa daga ta sama.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.r.a: Ƙaramar iyaka (0) ta fi babbar iyaka (−2), don haka alamar ƙima tana juye. Yanki ba zai zama mara kyau ba.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.o.b: ∫_{−2}^{0}(−2x−x²)dx: haɗa daga −2 zuwa 0, ka cire magana ta ƙasa daga ta sama.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.r.b: Wannan ita ce madaidaiciyar sigar, daga gefen hagu zuwa dama, an rubuta magana ta sama − ta ƙasa.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.o.c: ∫_{−2}^{0}(x²+2x)dx: haɗa daga −2 zuwa 0, ka cire maganar layi daga ta parabola.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.r.c: A wannan kewayo layin yana sama da parabola. Idan ka cire maganar sama daga ta ƙasa, ƙima mara kyau za ta samu.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.o.d: ∫₀²(−2x−x²)dx: haɗa daga 0 zuwa 2, ka cire maganar parabola daga ta layi.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.r.d: Idan m=−2, jadawalai suna haɗuwa a x=0 da x=−2. Kewayon ba a gefen dama na axis na x yake ba.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.explain: Idan m=−2, jadawalai suna haɗuwa a x=−2 da x=0; ga −2<x<0 layin y=−2x yana sama da parabola y=x². Saboda haka S(−2)=∫_{−2}^{0}(−2x−x²)dx=4/3.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.prompt: Shigar da lambobin cikakku biyu daban m da S(m)=9/2. (−30≤m≤30, m≠0)
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.hint.0: Idan m tabbatacce ne, fara nemo S(m) a matsayin magana ta m.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.hint.1: Idan m mara kyau ne, zana jadawali ka kwatanta ko maganar iri ɗaya ce.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Lambar cikakkiya marar sifili cikin kewayon.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.fail.c1: m dole ya zama lambar cikakkiya marar sifili daga −30 zuwa 30.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.fail.c2: S(m) ba 9/2 ba ne. Da farko nemo S(m) a matsayin magana ta m idan m>0.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.explain: Idan m>0, S(m)=∫₀ᵐ(mx−x²)dx=m³/6. Idan m<0, ta amfani da daidaito game da y-axis da −m=|m|, S(m)=|m|³/6. Don haka |m|³=27, wato m=3 ko m=−3.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.prompt: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa ɗalibin da ya nemo ƙima ɗaya da m>0 zai yi tunanin akwai wani layi guda da ke da yanki iri ɗaya.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.hint.0: Zana jadawalai na m=3 da m=−3 a plane ɗaya, ka duba alaƙarsu.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.hint.1: Ka tuna axis ɗin daidaito na parabola y=x².
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka ce abin da ke faruwa ga yanki idan an juya jadawali game da y-axis?
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka ce yankin tabbatacce ne ko da alamar gangarowa ta bambanta?
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.model.0: Idan ka nuna siffar da y=x² da y=3x suka kewaye game da y-axis, kana samun siffar da y=x² da y=−3x suka kewaye. Siffa da girma iri ɗaya ne, saboda haka yanki iri ɗaya ne, m=−3 ma amsa ce.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.model.1: Ko gangarowa mara kyau ce, yankin tabbatacce ne. Yankin ya dogara da absolute value na m, kamar |m|³/6, don haka m=3 da m=−3 suna ba da yanki ɗaya.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.model.2: Parabola tana daidaito game da y-axis; canza alamar gangarowar layi kawai yana juya siffar hagu-dama, ba ya sauya girma. Don haka gangarowa mara kyau −3 ma tana yiwuwa.

n-m-h2-trig-01.title: Duba mafita da ta gano nisan da aka matsar da jadawalin zane.
n-m-h2-trig-01.goal: A cikin mafitar da ke gano nisan da aka matsar da jadawalin zane na y=a sin(bx−c) daga jadawalin y=a sin bx, nemo layin da ba daidai ba kuma gyara shi, sannan ka tabbatar da ƙimar da aka gyara kai tsaye.
n-m-h2-trig-01.material: Jiyun ta warware yadda jadawalin y=2sin(3x−π/2) ya zama matsawar jadawalin y=2sin3x, kamar yadda ke ƙasa. (π shi ne pi, kusurwoyi kuma suna cikin radians. 2sin3x yana nufin 2 ninkawa da sine na 3x.)
n-m-h2-trig-01.thinking.0: Bi mafitar layi bayan layi domin nemo layin da ba daidai ba.
n-m-h2-trig-01.thinking.1: Fitar da ma’aunin x daga cikin baka domin karanta matsawar.
n-m-h2-trig-01.thinking.2: Buɗe furucin da aka fitar da ma’auni domin dubawa.
n-m-h2-trig-01.prereq.0: Zangon lokaci da mafi girma da mafi ƙanƙanta na y=a sin bx.
n-m-h2-trig-01.prereq.1: Matsar da jadawali a wajen x yana nufin maye gurbin x da x−m.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin farko da ba daidai ba a mafitar Jiyun.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.hint.0: Duba layi bayan layi ko kowanne layi ya biyo daga layin da ya gabata.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.hint.1: Sake buɗe furucin da aka fitar da ma’auni ta dokar rarrabawa, sannan ka kwatanta shi da furucin kafin fitar da ma’aunin.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.line.1: Matsakaicin ƙima ita ce 2, mafi ƙaranci kuma −2.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.line.2: Za a iya fitar da 3 a matsayin abu ɗaya daga 3x−π/2, a samu 3(x−π/2).
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka, wannan jadawali jadawalin y=2sin3x ne da aka matsar da π/2 zuwa dama a kan x.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ba daidai ba ne. Faɗaɗa 3(x−π/2) yana ba da 3x−3π/2, wanda ya bambanta da 3x−π/2. Tun da 3x−π/2=3(x−π/6), matsawar ita ce π/6. Layi na 4 ƙarshe ne da aka samo daga kuskuren layi na 3, alhali layi na 1 da na 2 daidai ne.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.prompt: Gyara layin da ba daidai ba, sannan ka rubuta alkibla da adadin matsawar daidai, tare da hanyar da ka yi amfani da ita don tabbatar da ƙimar.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.hint.0: Farawa daga 3x−π/2, yi tunanin wace lamba za a saka a gaban baka domin a samu x−(matsawa).
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.hint.1: Faɗaɗa furucin da ka rubuta tare da matsawar da ka samu, ka tabbatar ya koma 3x−π/2.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: idan ka fitar da 3 daga 3x−π/2 ta hanyar ... , za ka samu ...
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka faɗaɗa furucin da ka gyara da kanka?
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Za ka iya bayyana dalilin da ya sa dole ne a fitar da 3?
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka kuma bayyana alkiblar matsawar (zuwa dama)?
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.model.0: A cikin 3x−π/2, da farko a fitar da 3 a samu 3(x−π/6). Saboda haka an matsar da y=2sin3x zuwa dama da π/6. Tabbaci: faɗaɗa 3(x−π/6) yana ba da 3x−π/2, daidai da furucin asali.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.model.1: Dole ne a fitar da ma’aunin x, wato 3, domin a samu sigar x−(matsawa). Tun da π/2÷3=π/6, matsawar tana da nisan π/6 zuwa alkiblar x mai kyau. Idan aka saka x=π/6, 3x−π/2=0, don haka sin0=0; wannan ya yi daidai da cewa y=2sin3x yana da ƙimar 0 a x=0.

n-m-h2-trig-02.title: Mene ne mafi gajeren tazara da sin²x ke maimaituwa a cikinta?
n-m-h2-trig-02.goal: Bincika iƙirarin nan: “lokacin zagayowar sin x shi ne 2π, saboda haka sin²x ma yana da lokacin zagayowar 2π.” Ka gwada daidaiton maimaituwar, sannan ka bayyana ƙaramin lokacin zagayowar mai kyau tare da dalilai.
n-m-h2-trig-02.material: Seoyeon ta ce, “lokacin zagayowar sin x shi ne 2π, saboda haka na y=sin²x ma shi ne 2π,” Minho kuma ya ce, “wannan ba ita ce tazara mafi gajarta ba.” A nan, lokaci yana nufin ƙaramin p mai kyau wanda ya sa f(x+p)=f(x) ya tabbata ga duk x. (sin²x murabba’in sin x ne.)
n-m-h2-trig-02.thinking.0: Bambance tazarar maimaituwa da mafi ƙaramar tazara
n-m-h2-trig-02.thinking.1: Duba f(x+p)=f(x) ta amfani da furuci
n-m-h2-trig-02.thinking.2: Kimanta iƙirari ta hanyar ba da dalilai
n-m-h2-trig-02.prereq.0: Ayyukan lokaci-lokaci da ma’anar lokacin zagayowa
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk maganganun da suka dace game da f(x)=sin²x.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.hint.0: A kowace magana, saka takamaiman ƙimomi kamar 0 ko π/2 a madadin x, sannan ka kwatanta ko ɓangarorin biyu sun yi daidai.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.hint.1: Da farko ka rubuta alaƙar sin(x+π) da sin x, sannan ka duba abin da zai faru idan aka ɗauki murabba’i.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.o.a: Lokacin zagayowar sin x shi ne 2π, saboda haka mafi gajeren tazarar maimaituwar sin²x dole ne ita ma ta zama 2π.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.r.a: Wannan yana ɗaukar lokacin zagayowar aikin asali a matsayin mafi gajeren lokacin sabon aikin. Ka duba cewa ɗaukar murabba’i yana kawar da alamar mara kyau.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.o.b: Ga duk x, sin²(x+π)=sin²x, saboda haka jadawalin yana maimaita siffa ɗaya bayan an matsar da π.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.r.b: Wannan hukunci ne da aka yanke bayan an rubuta alaƙar sin(x+π) da sin x, aka duba sakamakon ɗaukar murabba’i.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.o.c: Ga duk x, sin²(x+π/2)=sin²x, saboda haka jadawalin yana maimaita siffa ɗaya bayan an matsar da π/2.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.r.c: Ba ka gwada ta hanyar saka takamaiman ƙimar x ba. Misali, ƙididdige ɓangarorin biyu a x=0.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.o.d: Ga duk x, sin²(x+2π)=sin²x, saboda haka jadawalin yana maimaita siffa ɗaya bayan an matsar da 2π.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.r.d: Ba ka manta cewa 2π ma tazara ce ta maimaituwa ba. Amma dole ne a bincika dabam ko ita ce mafi gajarta.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.explain: sin(x+π)=−sin x, don haka sin²(x+π)=sin²x. Saboda haka π ma tazara ce ta maimaituwa, haka nan 2π, wato ninki biyu na π. Amma a x=0, sin²0=0, yayin da sin²(π/2)=1, don haka π/2 ba tazara ce ta maimaituwa ba. 2π tazara ce ta maimaituwa amma ba ita ce mafi gajarta ba.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta mafi ƙaramin lokacin zagayowar mai kyau na y=sin²x, kuma ka bayyana bisa dalilai abin da ya ɓace a maganar Seoyeon. (Dalilai: aƙalla ɗaya daga sake rubuta furucin ko ƙimomin jadawali.)
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.hint.0: Ƙididdige ƙimar sin²x a x=0 da x=π/2, sannan ka nemo tazarar da ƙimomin za su yi daidai a cikinta.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ka tuna ko za ka iya sake rubuta sin²x a matsayin furuci mai ɗauke da cos2x.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: mafi ƙaramin lokacin zagayowar mai kyau na y=sin²x shi ne ... saboda ...
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka sake rubuta furucin a matsayin sin²x=(1−cos2x)/2 ko ka saka ƙimomin x kai tsaye?
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka faɗi cewa 2π tazara ce ta maimaituwa amma ba ita ce mafi gajarta ba?
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.model.0: sin²x=(1−cos2x)/2 ne, kuma lokacin zagayowar cos2x shi ne π, saboda haka lokacin zagayowar sin²x shi ne π. 2π na Seoyeon ma yana ba da ƙimomi iri ɗaya bayan an matsa wannan nisan, amma ba ita ce mafi gajeriyar tazara ba.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.model.1: sin(x+π)=−sin x ne, don haka ɗaukar murabba’i yana ba da sin²(x+π)=sin²x. Saboda haka ƙaramin lokaci bai wuce π ba; tazarar tsakanin x=π/2 da 3π/2, inda sin²x=1, ita ce π, don haka π ita ce mafi ƙanƙanta. 2π tazara ce ta maimaituwa, amma ba ita ce mafi ƙanƙanta ba.

n-m-h2-trig-03.title: Idan tan(α+β)=1, mene ne α+β?
n-m-h2-trig-03.goal: Bi yadda hukuncin cewa ƙimar tan guda ɗaya tana iya tantance kusurwa ke sauyawa idan aka samu bayani game da iyakar kusurwar, sannan ka bayyana dalilin.
n-m-h2-trig-03.material: Ga kusurwoyi α da β, tanα=1/2 kuma tanβ=1/3. Ana bayyana bayani kaɗan-kaɗan; saboda haka ka yanke hukunci ne kawai bisa abin da aka sani zuwa wannan mataki. (tan(α+β) shi ne (tanα+tanβ)÷(1−tanα·tanβ).)
n-m-h2-trig-03.thinking.0: Sake duba hukunci bisa sabon bayani
n-m-h2-trig-03.thinking.1: Nemo tan(α+β) ta amfani da ka’idar haɗawa
n-m-h2-trig-03.thinking.2: Amfani da ƙimomin trigonometrik tare da iyakar kusurwar
n-m-h2-trig-03.prereq.1: Alaƙar kusurwoyin da ke da ƙimar tan iri ɗaya (lokaci π)
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayani kaɗan-kaɗan. A kowane mataki, zaɓi hukunci bisa bayanin da aka samu zuwa wannan lokacin kawai.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.hint.0: Duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya bayyana, da farko ka rubuta iyakar da α+β zai iya kasancewa a cikinta.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ƙirga kusurwoyi nawa masu ƙimar tan=1 suke cikin wannan iyaka.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Mai ƙidaya shi ne 1/2+1/3=5/6, mai ƙididdigewa kuma 1−1/6=5/6, saboda haka tan(α+β)=1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan yana ɗaukar jimillar tan a matsayin tan na jimilla. Ka sake duba yadda aka rubuta mai ƙididdigewa a ka’idar haɗawa.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Duba sifar ka’idar haɗawa don ganin inda ake amfani da ninkin.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka saka ƙimomin kai tsaye a cikin ka’idar, ka ƙididdige mai ƙidaya 5/6 da mai ƙididdigewa 1−1/6=5/6.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Dukansu α da β ƙananan kusurwoyi ne (sun fi 0° kuma sun gaza 90°).
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Jimillar ƙananan kusurwoyi biyu ta fi 0° kuma ta gaza 180°. A cikin wannan tazara, 45° ce kaɗai kusurwa mai ƙimar tan=1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ka yi tunanin cewa α+β na iya wuce 180°. Ka nemo iyakar jimillar ƙananan kusurwoyi biyu.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Gaskiya ne cewa kusurwoyi da dama suna da ƙimar tan iri ɗaya, amma ba ka yi amfani da iyakar da aka bayar ba.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Sharadin ya sauya. Tanα=1/2 da tanβ=1/3 ba su canza ba, amma α kusurwa ce a yankin kwata na uku (ta fi 180° kuma ta gaza 270°), β kuma ƙaramin kusurwa ne.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.after: α+β ya fi 180° kuma ya gaza 360°. A cikin wannan tazara, 225° ce kaɗai kusurwa mai tan=1. Ko da ƙimar tan iri ɗaya ce, amsar tana sauyawa idan bayanin iyakar kusurwar ya sauya.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka duba tan=1 kawai, ka sake amfani da kusurwar da ka samu a baya.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ba za a iya tantancewa ba.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kana ganin cewa saboda iyakar ta sauya, ba za a iya tantancewa ba. Ƙirga kusurwoyin da ke cikin sabon iyaka masu tan=1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka nemo kusurwar da tan=1 a sabon iyakar 180°<α+β<360°.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.reflect: Ƙimar tan(α+β)=1 ba ta sauya ba, amma bisa bayanin iyakar kusurwar ta zama 45° a wani yanayi, 225° kuma a wani. Ƙimar aikin trigonometrik kaɗai ba ta tantance kusurwar; ana kuma buƙatar iyakarta.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.prompt: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa sanin tan(α+β)=1 bai tantance α+β shi kaɗai ba, da kuma rawar bayanin iyakar kusurwar.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.hint.0: Nemo ka rubuta wata kusurwa banda 45° mai ƙimar tan=1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta yawan kusurwoyin da za a iya zaɓa ba tare da bayanin iyaka ba da waɗanda za a iya zaɓa tare da shi.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: kusurwoyin da suke da ƙimar tan iri ɗaya su ne ... Idan akwai iyaka, ...
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka ba da misalin kusurwoyi masu ƙimar tan iri ɗaya (45° da 225°)?
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana yadda iyakar ke rage yawan zaɓuɓɓuka zuwa ɗaya?
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.model.0: Kusurwoyin da tan ɗinsu 1 ba 45° kaɗai ba ne; suna maimaituwa duk bayan 180°, kamar 225°. Saboda haka ba a tantance kusurwar ɗaya tak. Idan aka san iyaka, kamar ƙaramin kusurwa ko yankin kwata na uku, ɗan takara ɗaya ne kawai zai kasance a cikinta.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.model.1: Tan yana ba da ƙima iri ɗaya duk tazarar 180°. Saboda haka daga ƙimar 1 kaɗai ba za ka iya sanin ko kusurwar 45° ce ko 225° ba. Dole ne ka san yankin da kusurwar take domin zaɓar ɗaya.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka yi amfani da cewa jimillar tana tsakanin 0° da 180°, kuma kusurwa ɗaya tak a cikinta ce take da ƙimar tan=1.

n-m-h2-trig-04.thinking.2: Gina misalai da dama da suka cika sharuddan
n-m-h2-trig-04.title: Nemo tsawon gefuna uku da za su samar da alwatika mai kusurwa maras kaifi
n-m-h2-trig-04.goal: Ta amfani da ka’idar kosayini, rubuta sharadin da zai sa kusurwar da ke gaban gefen mafi tsawo ta zama maras kaifi, kana kuma bincika sharadin samuwar alwatika, sannan ka gina alwatiku daban-daban masu kusurwa maras kaifi.
