n-m-h2-trig-04.material: Kana son gina alwatika mai kusurwa maras kaifi wanda tsawon gefunansa uku lambobin halitta ne. Bari c ya zama gefen mafi tsawo, a da b kuma sauran gefunan; yi amfani da ka’idar kosayini ka bincika alamar cosC=(a²+b²−c²)÷(2ab), wato kosayinin kusurwar C da ke gaban c.
n-m-h2-trig-04.thinking.0: Amfani da alamar daga ka’idar kosayini domin tantance nau’in kusurwa
n-m-h2-trig-04.prereq.1: Sharadin da tsawon gefuna uku ke cika domin a samar da alwatika
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.prompt: Minsu ya ce, “Idan a=3, b=4, c=9, to c²=81 ya fi a²+b²=25, saboda haka cosC<0 kuma akwai alwatika mai kusurwa maras kaifi mai gefuna 3, 4, 9.” Yaya za ka tantance wannan magana?
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin ko za ka iya gina alwatika daga sanduna masu tsawon 3, 4, da 9.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.hint.1: A zahiri ka ƙididdige cosC, sannan ka kwatanta shi da iyakar ƙimomin kosayini.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.o.a: Daidai ne. 9²>3²+4², don haka kusurwar da ke gaban gefen mafi tsawo maras kaifi ce.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.r.a: Ka duba alamar ƙimar kosayini kawai, ba ka bincika ko za a iya samar da alwatika da gaske ba.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.o.b: Ba daidai ba ne. 3+4<9, don haka ba za a iya samar da alwatika da waɗannan gefuna ba.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.r.b: Kafin nemo ƙimar kosayini, ka fara duba ko gefuna ukun za su iya samar da alwatika.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.o.c: Ba daidai ba ne. Idan 9²>3²+4², kusurwar da ke gaban gefen mafi tsawo kusurwar dama ce.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.r.c: Ka gauraya yanayin kusurwar dama da na kusurwa maras kaifi. Ga 3, 4, 5, ka kwatanta 5² da 3²+4².
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.o.d: Daidai ne. 3, 4, da 9 tsawonsu sun bambanta, saboda haka alwatika ne mai kusurwa maras kaifi.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.r.d: Bambancin tsawonsu ba shi da alaƙa da ko alwatika zai samu.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.explain: cosC=(9+16−81)÷24 ya zama −56÷24<−1, saboda haka ba zai iya zama ƙimar kosayini ba. Dalili kuwa shi ne 3+4<9, don haka gefunan ukun ba su samar da alwatika ba. Domin samun kusurwa maras kaifi, murabba’in gefen mafi tsawo dole ne ya fi jimillar murabba’in sauran gefuna biyu, kuma a lokaci guda dole gefen mafi tsawo ya gaza jimillar sauran biyun.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.prompt: Nemo alwatiku 3 daban-daban masu kusurwa maras kaifi, waɗanda tsawon gefunansu lambobin halitta ne da ba su wuce 20 ba, sannan ka shigar da tsawon gefuna ukun. (Alwatiku da suka bambanta ta hanyar jujjuya jerin gefuna kawai ana ɗaukar su iri ɗaya.)
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko ka zaɓi gefen mafi tsawo c, sannan ka zaɓi a da b a yankin da a+b ya fi c.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ga lambobin ukun da ka zaɓa, ƙididdige c² da a²+b² ka kwatanta su; sannan ka kwatanta a+b da c.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Lambobin ukun lambobin halitta ne daga 1 zuwa 20.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Lambobin ukun dole ne su zama lambobin halitta daga 1 zuwa 20.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Gefen mafi tsawo ya gaza jimillar sauran gefuna biyu, saboda haka an samar da alwatika.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Gefen mafi tsawo ya kai ko ya fi jimillar sauran gefuna biyu, saboda haka ba a samar da alwatika ba.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Murabba’in gefen mafi tsawo ya fi jimillar murabba’in sauran gefuna biyu, saboda haka alwatika ne mai kusurwa maras kaifi.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Murabba’in gefen mafi tsawo bai fi jimillar murabba’in sauran gefuna biyu ba, saboda haka ba alwatika ne mai kusurwa maras kaifi ba.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.explain: (3, 4, 6) yana da 6²=36>3²+4²=25 kuma 3+4>6. (4, 5, 8) yana da 64>41 kuma 9>8; (5, 6, 10) kuma yana da 100>61 da 11>10. (3, 4, 9) ya cika sharadin murabba’i amma 3+4<9, saboda haka ba alwatika ba ne.

n-m-h2-trig-05.title: Wane bayani kake buƙata domin nemo radius na da’irar da aka zaga a kusa da alwatika?
n-m-h2-trig-05.goal: Bambance ko an tantance alwatika guda ɗaya tak da ko an tantance ƙimar da ake nema guda ɗaya tak; zaɓi bayanin da ke tantance radius na da’irar da aka zaga a kusa, sannan ka bayyana dalili.
n-m-h2-trig-05.material: A cikin alwatika ABC, a=BC, b=CA, c=AB, kuma A, B, C su ne kusurwoyin kololuwar. Kana son sanin radius R na da’irar da aka zaga a kusa da alwatika. An bayar da kowane bayani a matsayin takamaiman lambobi, kuma ana ɗauka cewa irin wannan alwatika yana samuwa da gaske.
n-m-h2-trig-05.thinking.2: Ganin cewa ƙimar na iya zama iri ɗaya ko da alwatiku biyu ne
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk yanayin da wannan bayani kaɗai ke tantance ƙimar R guda ɗaya tak.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.hint.0: A cikin ka’idar sinayini a/sinA=b/sinB=c/sinC=2R, rubuta furucin da za ka samu idan akwai aƙalla nau’i ɗaya na gefe da kusurwar da ke fuskantarsa.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ga kowane bayani, bincika ko akwai nau’i ɗaya na gefe da kusurwar da ke fuskantarsa; idan babu, duba ko za a iya samar da shi ta ka’idar kosayini.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.o.a: Girman kusurwoyi uku A, B, C
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.r.a: Ka tuna cewa kusurwoyi uku kaɗai suna ba da alwatiku masu kamanceceniya marasa iyaka, masu girma dabam-dabam.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.o.b: Tsawon gefe guda a da girman kusurwar da ke fuskantarsa A
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.r.b: Wannan hukunci yana ɗauka cewa nau’i ɗaya daga ka’idar sinayini (gefe da kusurwar da ke fuskantarsa) ya isa a nemo R.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.o.c: Tsawon gefuna biyu a, b da girman kusurwar A
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.r.c: Ko da bayanin zai iya samar da alwatiku biyu, ka bincika dabam ko R yana da ƙima guda ɗaya tak. Duba ko bayanin ya ƙunshi gefe da kusurwar da ke fuskantarsa.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.o.d: Tsawon gefe guda a da girman kusurwar da ke makwabtaka da shi B
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.r.d: Ka yi tunanin cewa sauran kusurwa C na iya sauyawa da yardar kaina, don haka R ma yana sauyawa.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.o.e: Tsawon gefuna biyu a, b da girman kusurwar da ke tsakaninsu C
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.r.e: Ka yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa nemo gefe na uku ta ka’idar kosayini yana samar da nau’i ɗaya na gefe da kusurwar da ke fuskantarsa.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.explain: Ga b, ana samun R kai tsaye daga a/sinA=2R. Haka lamarin yake ga c, domin a da A nau’i ne na gefe da kusurwar da ke fuskantarsa. Ko da ana iya samar da alwatiku biyu, a/sinA yana da ƙima ɗaya, saboda haka R ma ƙima guda ɗaya ne. Ga e, nemo c da ka’idar kosayini, sannan ka yi amfani da c/sinC=2R. Ga a, kusurwoyi uku kaɗai suna ba da alwatiku masu kamanceceniya da yawa masu girma dabam-dabam, saboda haka ba a tantance R ba; ga d kuma R yana sauyawa idan C ta sauya.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓin “a, b da kusurwar A” bayanai ne da za su iya ba da alwatiku biyu, duk da haka an tantance R guda ɗaya tak. Bayyana dalili.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta ka’idar sinayini, sannan ka ƙirga haruffan da ke cikin nemo R.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.hint.1: A ɗauka akwai alwatiku biyu, ka kwatanta ko a da A iri ɗaya ne ko sun bambanta.
n-m-h2-trig-05.thinking.0: Zaɓar bayanin da ake buƙata domin ƙimar da ake nema
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta furucin da ake amfani da shi wajen warware a/sinA=2R domin nemo R?
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana cewa ba a amfani da b wajen nemo R?
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka ce a da A iri ɗaya ne ko da an samu alwatika biyu?
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.model.0: Daga dokar sinis a/sinA=2R, R=a/(2sinA). Wannan yana amfani da a da A kawai, ba ya amfani da b; saboda haka ko da an samu alwatika biyu, a da A iri ɗaya ne, don haka R ma iri ɗaya ne.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.model.1: Idan kana da gefen a da kusurwar da ke fuskantarsa A, dokar sinis tana ba da 2R=a/sinA nan take. Ko da gefen na uku ko sauran kusurwoyi sun bambanta tsakanin alwatika biyun, wannan ƙimar ba ta bambanta; saboda haka ana tantance R ta hanya guda tak.

n-m-h2-trig-07.title: Taimaka wa Harin da warware sin75°.
n-m-h2-trig-07.goal: Nemo layin farko da ba daidai ba a mafitar aboki da ya yi amfani da dokar ƙarin kuskure, zaɓi alamar da ke nuna cewa sakamakon ba zai yiwu ba, sannan ka rubuta saƙon da zai taimaka masa ya gyara da kansa.
n-m-h2-trig-07.material: Harin ya yi ƙoƙarin nemo sin75° ta rubuta 75°=45°+30° kuma ya warware kamar yadda aka nuna a ƙasa. (√2 na nufin tushen murabba’i na 2.) Harin abokinka ne.
n-m-h2-trig-07.thinking.0: Nemo layin farko da ba daidai ba a mafitar.
n-m-h2-trig-07.thinking.1: Gano kuskuren daga iyakar ƙimar sakamakon.
n-m-h2-trig-07.thinking.2: Rubuta saƙon da za ka aika wa abokinka.
n-m-h2-trig-07.prereq.0: Dokokin ƙarin kusurwa na sinis da kosin.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin farko da ba daidai ba a mafitar Harin.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s1.hint.0: Karanta kowanne layi bi da bi, ka duba ko da gaske ya biyo daga layin da ya gabata.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s1.hint.1: Gwada tsarin kowanne layi ɗaya bayan ɗaya ta saka kusurwoyi masu sauƙi, kamar A=B=30°.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s1.line.0: Tunda 75°=45°+30°, muna amfani da dokar ƙarin kusurwa.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s1.line.1: Dokar ƙarin kusurwa ita ce sin(A+B)=sinA+sinB.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka sin75° ya kai kusan 1.207.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s1.explain: Layi na 2 ne ba daidai ba. Dokar ƙarin sinis ita ce sin(A+B)=sinA cosB+cosA sinB. Layi na 3 da 4 ƙididdiga ne da suka biyo daga dokar da ba daidai ba, amma ƙimomin sin45° da sin30° kansu daidai ne.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.prompt: Ko da ba ka san dokar ƙarin kusurwa daidai ba, wace alama ce za ta nuna nan take cewa sakamakon Harin ba daidai ba ne?
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko tuna iyakar ƙimomin da sin zai iya samu.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ƙididdige ƙimar Harin a matsayin lambar goma, sannan ka kwatanta ta da wannan iyaka.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.o.a: 75° kusurwa ce mai kaifi, saboda haka sin75° dole ya zama ƙasa da sin30°=1/2.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.r.a: Wannan yana ɗauka cewa sin yana raguwa ne kawai a kusurwoyi masu kaifi. Kwatanta ƙimomin sin na 30° da 75°.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.o.b: Ƙimar sin ba za ta iya wuce 1 ba, amma sakamakon (√2+1)/2 ya fi 1 girma.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.r.b: Ka kwatanta sakamakon ƙididdigar da iyakar ƙimar sin, daga −1 zuwa 1 har da iyakokin.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.o.c: √2/2+1/2 lambar irrational ce, saboda haka ba za ta iya zama ƙimar sin75° ba.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.r.c: Wannan yana ɗauka cewa ƙima ba za ta iya zama ta sin ba saboda ita irrational ce. sin45°=√2/2 ma irrational ce.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.o.d: Ba za a iya tara sin na 45° da sin na 30° ba.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.r.d: Wannan yana ɗauka cewa tara su haramun ne. Babu dalilin da ya sa ba za a iya tarawa ba; dole ne ka yanke hukunci bisa sakamakon.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.explain: (√2+1)/2 ya kai kusan 1.207, wanda ya fi 1. Ƙimar sin tana tsakanin −1 da 1 har da iyakokin, don haka lissafin dole ya yi kuskure a wani wuri. Ko ba tare da sanin dokar ba, za ka iya gano kuskuren daga iyakar ƙimomi kawai. Dokar daidai ita ce sin75°=sin45°cos30°+cos45°sin30°.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta saƙon da za ka aika wa Harin. Haɗa ① wane ɓangare na mafitar ne matsala, da ② hanya guda da Harin zai iya gwadawa da kansa, amma ③ kada ka rubuta ƙimar sin75° ta ƙarshe.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko gano abu ɗaya da Harin ya yi daidai, ka kuma yaba masa a kai.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s3.hint.1: Sannan ka rubuta mataki guda da Harin zai iya gwadawa kai tsaye (duba iyakar ƙimomi, saka kusurwa mai sauƙi, da sauransu).
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka yaba da abin da Harin ya yi daidai (raba shi zuwa 45° da 30°)?
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Aikin da ya kamata Harin ya gwada a bayyane yake?
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka guji bayyana masa ƙimar ƙarshe?
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s3.model.0: Raba shi zuwa 45°+30° shawara ce mai kyau. Amma dokar ƙarin kusurwa a layi na 2 ce matsalar. Ka samu kusan 1.2, amma ƙimar sin ba za ta wuce 1 ba, don haka ka duba. Me zai hana ka gwada ko dokar daidai ce ta saka ƙimomi kamar A=B=30°?
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s3.model.1: Ka yi daidai da raba 75° zuwa 45° da 30°. Amma dabarar da ta ce sin(A+B) daidai yake da sinA+sinB tana da ban mamaki. Sakamakon bai kamata ya fi 1 ba, don haka ka sake duba dokar ƙarin kusurwar sinis a littafinka.

n-m-h2-trig-09.thinking.0: Nemo layin farko da ba daidai ba a mafitar.
n-m-h2-trig-09.title: Duba mafita da ta nemo mafi girman ƙima a wani tazara da aka bayar.
n-m-h2-trig-09.goal: Nemo cewa mafitar da ta yi amfani da haɗa ayyukan trigonometrik domin nemo mafi girma ba ta yi amfani da iyakar x ba, sannan ka duba ƙarshen tazarar domin nemo mafi girman ƙimar daidai.
n-m-h2-trig-09.material: Hyunwoo ya nemo mafi girman y=3sinx+4cosx a kan 0≤x≤π/6 kamar yadda aka nuna a ƙasa. (Kusurwoyi suna cikin radians. α ita ce kusurwa mai kaifi wadda cosα=3/5 da sinα=4/5, kuma α ya kai kusan 0.93.)
n-m-h2-trig-09.thinking.1: Duba ko wannan mafi girman ƙimar tana faruwa a cikin tazarar.
n-m-h2-trig-09.prereq.1: Halin ƙaruwa da raguwa na aikin sinis.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin farko da ba daidai ba a mafitar Hyunwoo.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s1.hint.0: Duba a cikin jimlar sharadin da ya sa aka samu mafi girman ƙimar a layi na 2.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s1.hint.1: Domin mafi girman ƙimar ta zama 5, ana buƙatar x da sin(x+α)=1. Ka yi tunanin ko wannan x yana cikin tazarar matsalar.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s1.line.1: Idan x kowace lambar real ce, mafi girman sin(x+α) ita ce 1, saboda haka mafi girman y ita ce 5.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s1.line.2: Saboda haka mafi girman ƙima a 0≤x≤π/6 ita ma 5 ce.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s1.line.3: Wannan saboda sin(x+α)=1 na iya faruwa a cikin tazarar ma.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ne ba daidai ba. Ƙimar 5 a layi na 2 ita ce mafi girma idan x kowace lambar real ce. Domin sin(x+α)=1, ana buƙatar x=π/2−α (kusan 0.64), wanda ya fi π/6 (kusan 0.52), saboda haka yana wajen tazarar. Layi na 4 ne dalilin da bai dace ba na layi na 3.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s2.prompt: Nemo mafi girman y a 0≤x≤π/6, sannan ka rubuta dalilin da ya sa 5 na Hyunwoo ba zai faru a wannan tazarar ba.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s2.hint.0: Nemo x ɗin da sin(x+α)=1, sannan ka kwatanta shi da tazarar matsalar.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s2.hint.1: Duba yadda x+α ke canzawa a duk tazarar (ko yana ƙaruwa ko raguwa), sannan ka yanke shawarar inda mafi girman ƙimar take.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: x ɗin da sin(x+α)=1 shi ne ... saboda haka mafi girman ƙimar ita ce ...
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka bincika ko ƙimar x da ke ba da matsakaicin ƙima tana cikin tazarar?
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka ƙididdige ƙimar a ƙarshen tazarar kai tsaye?
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana yadda x+α ke sauyawa a cikin tazarar?
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s2.model.0: X ɗin da ke sa sin(x+α)=1 shi ne π/2−α (kimanin 0.64), wanda ya fi π/6 (kimanin 0.52), saboda haka yana wajen tazarar. A cikin tazarar, y yana ƙaruwa, don haka matsakaicin ƙima yana a x=π/6, kuma ita ce 3·1/2+4·√3/2=3/2+2√3 (kimanin 4.96).
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s2.model.1: x+α yana motsawa daga α (kimanin 0.93) zuwa π/6+α (kimanin 1.45), kuma yana nan bai wuce π/2 ba, saboda haka yana ƙaruwa koyaushe. Don haka matsakaicin ƙima yana a ƙarshen tazarar x=π/6, inda y=(3+4√3)/2≈4.96. Domin a samu 5, x zai kasance a wajen tazarar, saboda haka 5 ba zai yiwu ba.

n-m-h2-integ-02.prereq.0: Integrals marasa iyaka na ayyukan polynomial.
n-m-h2-integ-02.title: Duba mafitar Jimin don derivative da aka bayar a matsayin product
n-m-h2-integ-02.topic: Indefinite integrals: haɗa product da constant na haɗawa
n-m-h2-integ-02.goal: Nemo layi marar daidai a mafitar da ta samo asalin aiki daga derivative product, sannan ka gyara ta ta hanyar tabbatar cewa derivative na sakamakon ya mayar da kai ga asali.
n-m-h2-integ-02.material: Wannan ita ce mafitar Jimin don nemo f(1) idan f'(x)=(x+1)(x+2) da f(0)=2. (Ana karanta f' “f prime”, C kuma constant na haɗawa ne.)
n-m-h2-integ-02.thinking.0: Duba ko kowane layi yana daidai da layin da ya gabata
n-m-h2-integ-02.thinking.1: Gwada doka a kan magana mai sauƙi
n-m-h2-integ-02.prereq.1: Nemo constant na haɗawa daga sharadin farko
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi na farko marar daidai a mafitar Jimin.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s1.hint.0: Gwada ko maganganun kafin da bayan kowane canji daidai suke ta amfani da hanya ɗaya ga misali mai sauƙi.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s1.hint.1: Duba ko yin derivative ga sakamakon kowane layi ya mayar da integrand na layin da ya gabata.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s1.explain: Layi na 2 ne na farko da ya yi kuskure. Indefinite integral na product ba daidai yake da ninkin indefinite integrals dabam-dabam ba. Misali ∫x·x dx=x³/3, amma ∫x dx × ∫x dx=x⁴/4. Idan product ne, sai an fara buɗe shi. Tun da (x+1)(x+2)=x²+3x+2, f(x)=x³/3+3x²/2+2x+C; f(0)=2 yana ba da C=2, kuma f(1)=1/3+3/2+2+2=35/6.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.prompt: Bayan ka kammala mafita, wace hanya ce mafi kai tsaye don gano irin wannan kuskure da kanka?
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.hint.0: Yi tunanin ko kowane bincike zai iya gano mafita marar daidai, ka zaɓi wanda koyaushe yake daidai ko da mafitar ba daidai ba ce.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ka tuna alaƙar indefinite integral da differentiation.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.o.a: Saka f(0)=2 cikin f(x) ɗin da ka samo, ka tabbatar ka samu 2.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.r.a: Tun da an samo constant C daga wannan sharadi, kullum zai yi daidai. Wannan binciken ba ya gano kuskuren haɗa product.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.o.b: Yi derivative ga f(x) ɗin da ka samo, ka duba cewa f'(x)=(x+1)(x+2).
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.r.b: Wannan binciken yana amfani da cewa derivative na sakamakon integral dole ne ya mayar da magana ta asali.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.o.c: Duba cewa an haɗa constant C da sakamakon, ba a manta da shi ba.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.r.c: An haɗa C. Matsalar mafitar ba constant ba ce, hanyar haɗawa ce.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.o.d: Sake ƙididdige f(1) da kalkuleta ka tabbatar ƙimar iri ɗaya ce.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.r.d: Sake ƙididdige magana ɗaya yana ba da ƙima ɗaya; ba ya tabbatar da magana daidai ce.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.explain: Idan ka yi derivative ga f(x)=(x²/2+x)(x²/2+2x)+C, ba za ka samu (x+1)(x+2) ba saboda dokar derivative na product. Duba ko derivative ya mayar da kai ga derivative na asali ita ce hanya mafi kai tsaye ta tabbatar indefinite integral.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s3.prompt: Nemo f(1) da madaidaiciyar mafita, sannan ka nuna da magana mai sauƙi cewa layi na biyu na Jimin ba ya aiki.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s3.hint.0: Idan haɗa product kai tsaye yana da wahala, yi tunanin yadda za ka canza shi domin haɗa kowane term dabam.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s3.hint.1: Gwada hanyar Jimin ga product mai sauƙi kamar x×x, ka kwatanta da madaidaicin integral.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Da farko, idan ka ..., to f(1)=... . Misali, ...
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: A magana mai sauƙi (misali x×x), ka nuna da dabaru cewa lissafin biyun suna ba da sakamako dabam?
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Bayan ka samu amsa, ka duba ko derivative ya mayar da kai ga derivative?
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s3.model.0: Buɗe (x+1)(x+2) zuwa x²+3x+2, sannan haɗa don samun f(x)=x³/3+3x²/2+2x+C. Tun da f(0)=2, C=2, saboda haka f(1)=35/6. Misali ∫x·x dx=x³/3, amma ∫x dx×∫x dx=x⁴/4; don haka integral na product ba ninkin integrals ba ne.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s3.model.1: f(1)=35/6. Dole ne a fara buɗe product sannan a haɗa kowace term. Kada a ninka integrals dabam domin ga x da x, gefe ɗaya x³/3 ne, ɗayan x⁴/4, ba su daidaita ba.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s3.model.2: Buɗewa da haɗa x²+3x+2 yana ba da x³/3+(3/2)x²+2x+C. Tun da C=2, f(1)=35/6. Maye gurbin integral na product da ninkin integrals yana sauya degree, don haka ba daidai ba ne (misali x·x).

n-m-h2-integ-05.title: Za mu iya nemo matsayi daga acceleration kaɗai?
n-m-h2-integ-05.topic: Indefinite integrals da constants na haɗawa: daga acceleration zuwa matsayi
n-m-h2-integ-05.goal: Yi hukunci cewa kowane haɗawa daga acceleration zuwa velocity da daga velocity zuwa matsayi yana kawo constant ɗaya, don haka ana buƙatar bayanai biyu domin ƙayyade matsayi; ƙirƙiri motsi daban-daban da matsayi iri ɗaya suke bayarwa.
n-m-h2-integ-05.material: Acceleration na batu P da ke motsi a layin lambobi a lokacin t (sakan) shi ne a(t)=6t−4. Muna son sanin matsayinsa a t=3. (Haɗa acceleration yana ba da velocity, haɗa velocity kuma yana ba da matsayi.)
n-m-h2-integ-05.thinking.0: Bambanta bayanin da ake buƙata da wanda aka riga aka sani
n-m-h2-integ-05.prereq.0: Indefinite integrals da constants na haɗawa
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.prompt: Domin kayyade matsayin P a t=3, wane ƙarin bayani cikin waɗannan muke buƙata?
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta sau nawa za a haɗa daga acceleration zuwa matsayi, da constant da ke bayyana kowane lokaci.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ƙirga adadin constants da bayanin kowane zaɓi zai iya kayyade. Bayanai da aka riga aka sani daga acceleration a(t) ba sabon bayani ba ne.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.o.a: Velocity a t=0 da acceleration a t=3
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.r.a: An kayyade constant na velocity, amma na matsayi ya rage. An riga an san acceleration a t=3 daga a(t).
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.o.b: Matsayi a t=0 da acceleration a t=3
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.r.b: An kayyade constant na matsayi, amma na velocity ya rage. An riga an san acceleration a t=3 daga a(t).
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.o.c: Acceleration a t=1 da acceleration a t=3
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.r.c: Ana iya lissafa ƙimomin biyu daga a(t), saboda haka ba sabon bayani ba ne.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.o.d: Velocity a t=0 da matsayi a t=0
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.r.d: Wannan shi ne bayanin da ke kayyade constants biyu na haɗawa da sau biyu ya samar.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.explain: Haɗa a(t) yana ba da v(t)=3t²−4t+C₁, sake haɗawa kuma ya ba da x(t)=t³−2t²+C₁t+C₂. Sai an kayyade constants C₁ (velocity na farko) da C₂ (matsayi na farko) duka kafin matsayi ya tabbata.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s2.prompt: A sa v₀ velocity ne a t=0, x₀ kuma matsayi. Shigar da nau’i-nau’i uku daban-daban na integers (v₀,x₀) da matsayi a t=3 yake 10. (−20≤v₀≤20, −20≤x₀≤20)
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s2.hint.0: Haɗa sau biyu don nemo x(t), saka t=3, ka rubuta magana ta v₀ da x₀.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s2.hint.1: Duba ko zaɓin v₀ guda ɗaya da ya cika maganar zai kayyade x₀.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s2.fail.c1: v₀ da x₀ dole su zama lambobi cikakku daga −20 zuwa 20.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Matsayi a t=3 ba 10 ba ne. Saka t=3 cikin x(t)=t³−2t²+v₀t+x₀.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s2.explain: x(3)=27−18+3v₀+x₀=9+3v₀+x₀, saboda haka x(3)=10 idan 3v₀+x₀=1. Akwai nau’i-nau’i marar iyaka (v₀,x₀) da suka cika wannan. Wato ko da matsayi a t=3 iri ɗaya ne, akwai motsi da dama masu velocity da matsayi na farko daban.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.prompt: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa sanin matsayi guda ɗaya bai ba mu damar sanin velocity da matsayi na farko duka ba, da dalilin da ya sa ake buƙatar bayanai biyu domin kayyade motsin.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.hint.0: Ƙirga sau nawa ka haɗa domin samun matsayi.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.hint.1: Duba ko nau’i-nau’in da ka ƙirƙira duk sun isa matsayi iri ɗaya, sannan ka faɗi bambancinsu.

n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka ce sharadi guda ɗaya ba ya kayyade (v₀,x₀) da hanya ɗaya?

Matsayi a t=3 yana ba da ma’auni guda ɗaya kawai, kamar 3v₀+x₀=1, don haka ba a kayyade v₀ da x₀ ta hanya guda ba, nau’i-nau’i da dama suna yiwuwa. Dole a san velocity da matsayi na farko duka.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.model.1: Ba mu san constants 2 na haɗawa ba, amma matsayi a t=3 yana ba da ma’auni guda ɗaya kawai. Saboda haka akwai haɗaɗɗun velocity da matsayi na farko marar iyaka. Idan constants 2 ne, ana buƙatar bayanai 2.

n-m-h2-integ-01.title: Shin ƙimar definite integral da yankin da ke ƙarƙashin jadawali abu ɗaya ne?
n-m-h2-integ-01.topic: Definite integral da yanki: yanki mai alama
n-m-h2-integ-01.goal: Fahimci cewa definite integral “yanki mai alama” ne, inda ɓangaren ƙasa da axis na x ake ƙirga mara kyau. Ƙirƙiri misalin da definite integral yake 0 amma yankin ba 0 ba, sannan ka bayyana dalili da yadda ake nemo yankin.
n-m-h2-integ-01.material: Akwai jadawalin f(x)=x²−2x, axis na x, da kewayon 0≤x≤3. Hajun ya ce, “∫₀³ f(x)dx=0, don haka yankin tsakanin jadawali da axis na x ma 0 ne,” Seoa kuma ta ce, “Ban tsammanin yankin 0 ba ne.” (∫₀³ definite integral ne daga 0 zuwa 3.)
n-m-h2-integ-01.thinking.1: Raba jadawali zuwa sama da ƙasa da axis na x
n-m-h2-integ-01.thinking.2: Bambanta ƙimar definite integral da yanki
n-m-h2-integ-01.prereq.0: Ƙididdige definite integral na ayyukan polynomial
n-m-h2-integ-01.prereq.1: Matsayin jadawalin aiki dangane da axis na x
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi hukuncin da ya dace game da yankin tsakanin jadawali da axis na x a wannan kewayo.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.hint.0: Zana jadawalin f(x)=x²−2x, ka yi alama inda yake sama da axis na x da inda yake ƙasa a kewayon.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo haɗin x na wuraren da jadawalin ya haɗu da axis na x; raba kewayon a wuraren, ƙididdige definite integral na kowane ɓangare dabam sannan ka kwatanta alamomin.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.o.a: Yankin 0 ne: domin ƙimar definite integral ita ce yankin tsakanin jadawali da axis na x.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.r.a: Ka ɗauki ƙimar definite integral da yanki a matsayin abu ɗaya. A definite integral, ana ƙirga ɓangaren ƙasa da axis na x mara kyau.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.o.b: Yankin 0 ne: domin jadawalin ya haɗu da axis na x a batu cikin kewayon.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.r.b: Wurin da jadawali ya haɗu da axis na x batu ne kawai, ba ya sa yankin ya zama 0. Siffofin bangarorin biyu suna da yanki.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.o.c: Yankin ba 0 ba ne: domin ɓangaren sama da ƙasa suna da alamomi dabam-dabam suna soke juna.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.r.c: Ka yi tunanin yadda ƙimomi tabbatattu da marasa kyau za su soke juna cikin definite integral.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.o.d: Ba za a iya sani ba: domin ƙimar definite integral kaɗai ba ta faɗin siffar jadawali.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.r.d: A nan an ba da f(x), saboda haka za mu iya duba siffar jadawalin kai tsaye.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.explain: f(x)=x²−2x=x(x−2) yana ƙasa da axis na x ga 0≤x≤2, don haka ∫₀²f=−4/3; yana sama ga 2≤x≤3, don haka ∫₂³f=4/3. Jimlarsu 0 ce, amma yankin 4/3+4/3=8/3 ne. Definite integral “yanki mai alama” ne, inda ɓangaren ƙasa da axis ake ƙirga mara kyau.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.prompt: Ga f(x)=x(x−a), shigar da nau’i-nau’i biyu daban-daban na lambobin cikakku tabbatattu (a,b) da definite integral ∫₀ᵇ f(x)dx=0. (1≤a≤20, 1≤b≤20)
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.hint.0: Buɗe ∫₀ᵇ x(x−a)dx, ka rubuta magana ta a da b.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.hint.1: Nemo alaƙar a da b da za ta sa maganar ta zama 0.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.ok.c1: a da b lambobi cikakku tabbatattu ne cikin kewayon.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.fail.c1: a da b dole su zama lambobi cikakku daga 1 zuwa 20.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Ƙimar ∫₀ᵇ x(x−a)dx ba 0 ba ce. Buɗe ka ƙididdige b³/3−ab²/2.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.explain: ∫₀ᵇx(x−a)dx=b³/3−ab²/2=b²(2b−3a)/6, saboda haka yana 0 idan 2b=3a. Sai b=1.5a ya fi a, don haka kewayon [0,b] ya ƙunshi ɓangaren ƙasa da axis (0<x<a) da na sama (a<x<b). Saboda haka definite integral 0 ne amma yankin ba 0 ba ne.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.prompt: Zaɓi ɗaya daga nau’i-nau’in da ka ƙirƙira, ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa definite integral yake 0 amma yankin ba haka ba, da yadda ake nemo yankin a wannan kewayo.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ta amfani da nau’i-nau’i ɗaya da ka ƙirƙira, ƙididdige definite integral na ɓangaren ƙasa da na sama da axis na x daban, ka duba alamominsu.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ka tuna yanki ba ya zama mara kyau, kamar tsawo; yi tunanin yadda ya kamata a ɗauki ɓangaren ƙasa.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: definite integral ... domin ɓangaren ...; yankin kuma ...
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana yadda ake ƙirga ɓangaren ƙasa da axis na x cikin definite integral?
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka ce domin yanki ba zai zama mara kyau ba, sai an raba kewayon inda alama take canzawa?
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.model.0: Definite integral na ɓangaren ƙasa da axis mara kyau ne, na sama kuma tabbatacce ne; idan aka haɗa suna soke juna su ba da 0. Ga yanki, ɓangaren ƙasa ma tabbatacce ne, don haka raba kewayon a wurin da jadawali ya haɗu da axis, nemo kowane ƙima, sannan ka haɗa absolute values ɗinsu.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.model.1: Definite integral yanki mai alama ne, don haka ƙimar sama da ta ƙasa (mara kyau) suna haɗuwa su zama 0. Ainihin yanki yana ƙirga duka a matsayin tabbatattu; nemo su dabam ta raba [0,a] da [a,b], sannan ka haɗa.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.model.2: Idan ka raba kewayon biyu a wurin da jadawali ya haɗu da axis, definite integral ɗaya tabbatacce ne ɗaya kuma mara kyau. Ko da jimlarsu 0 ce, yankin |ɓangaren mara kyau|+|ɓangaren tabbatacce| ne, wanda ya fi 0.

n-m-h2-integ-04.prereq.2: Ƙididdige definite integral na ayyukan polynomial
n-m-h2-integ-04.title: Nemo sharadin mafi ƙarancin ƙima ta gida na aikin da definite integral ya ayyana
n-m-h2-integ-04.topic: Differentiation da ƙimomin tsattsauran ayyukan definite integral
n-m-h2-integ-04.goal: Yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa ƙaruwa/raguwa da ƙimomin tsattsauran F(x)=∫₀ˣf(t)dt suna dogara da alamar f(x), ƙirƙiri misalan da mafi ƙarancin ƙima ta gida tabbatacciya ce, sannan nemo sharadinta.
n-m-h2-integ-04.material: f(t)=(t−a)(t−b) (a da b lambobi cikakku ne, 0<a<b), kuma F(x)=∫₀ˣf(t)dt. (∫₀ˣ definite integral ne daga 0 zuwa x.)
n-m-h2-integ-04.thinking.0: Karanta ƙaruwa da raguwa daga F'(x)=f(x)
n-m-h2-integ-04.thinking.1: Bambanta wurin ƙimar tsattsauran da girmanta
n-m-h2-integ-04.thinking.2: Nemo sharadi daga misalai da dama
n-m-h2-integ-04.prereq.0: Differentiation na aikin da definite integral ya ayyana
n-m-h2-integ-04.prereq.1: Ƙaruwa, raguwa da ƙimomin tsattsauran ayyukan cubic
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.prompt: Idan x>0, a wane x ne F(x) zai iya samun ƙimar tsattsauran?
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ka tuna aikin da ake samu idan aka yi derivative ga aikin definite integral ya ayyana.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.hint.1: Idan ka binciki alamar F' a kowane kewayon x, za ka iya sanin inda F ke ƙaruwa ko raguwa.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.o.a: x da f(x) ke da ƙimar tsattsauran: F yana da ƙimar tsattsauran a wurin da f yake da ita.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.r.a: Ƙaruwa da raguwa na F sun dogara da alamar f, ba ƙimar f ba. Wuraren ƙimar tsattsauran f ba su da alaƙa da na F.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.o.b: x inda f(x)=0 kuma alamar f(x) ke canzawa a gefensa.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.r.b: Ka yi amfani da cewa F'(x)=f(x), saboda haka ƙimomin tsattsauran suna faruwa inda alamar F' ta canza.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.o.c: x inda F(x)=0: ƙimar tsattsauran tana faruwa inda jadawali ya yanke axis na x.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.r.c: Wuraren F=0 da wuraren ƙimomin tsattsauran batutuwa dabam-dabam ne.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.o.d: x=0: ƙimar F tana fara sauyawa a wurin da haɗawar ta fara.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.r.d: F(0)=0 ƙima ce kawai; x=0 ba wurin da ƙaruwa da raguwa suke sauyawa ba.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.explain: Tun da F'(x)=f(x)=(x−a)(x−b), F yana ƙaruwa idan x<a, yana raguwa idan a<x<b, yana ƙaruwa idan x>b. Saboda haka F yana da mafi girman ƙima ta gida a x=a da mafi ƙaranci a x=b.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.prompt: Cikin nau’i-nau’i (a,b) na lambobin cikakku inda 0<a<b≤20, shigar da nau’i-nau’i daban-daban 3 da mafi ƙarancin ƙimar gida na F yake tabbatacce.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko nemo x inda F yake da mafi ƙarancin ƙima ta gida, sannan bayyana ƙimar F a wannan x ta a da b.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.hint.1: Buɗe ka ƙididdige ∫₀ᵇ(t−a)(t−b)dt, sannan nemo sharadin da zai sa alamar ta zama tabbatacciya.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.ok.c1: a da b lambobi cikakku ne, 0<a<b≤20.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole a da b su zama lambobi cikakku da 0<a<b≤20.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Mafi ƙarancin ƙimar gida tabbatacciya ce.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Mafi ƙarancin ƙimar gida ba tabbatacciya ba ce. Bayyana ƙimar F a x inda mafi ƙarancin yake ta amfani da a da b.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.explain: Mafi ƙarancin yana x=b, kuma F(b)=∫₀ᵇ(t²−(a+b)t+ab)dt=b³/3−(a+b)b²/2+ab²=b²(3a−b)/6. Tun da b²>0, ƙimar mafi ƙaranci tabbatacciya ce idan 3a−b>0, wato b<3a.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta alaƙar b da a a nau’i-nau’in da ka samu, sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ake buƙatarta ta ƙididdige mafi ƙarancin ƙima.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko tantance ko mafi ƙarancin yana a ko b, sannan buɗe ka ƙididdige definite integral har zuwa wannan x.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.hint.1: A maganar da ka ƙididdige, ware factors da kullum tabbatattu daga waɗanda alamarsu za ta iya canzawa.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.placeholder: Misali b ya fi ... na a ƙasa. Mafi ƙarancin ƙima ..., saboda haka ...
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka fara gano x da mafi ƙarancin yake sannan ka ƙididdige ƙimarsa?
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka faɗi factor ɗin da ke tantance alamar mafi ƙarancin ƙima?
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.model.0: b dole ya yi ƙasa da 3a. Mafi ƙaranci yana x=b, F(b)=b²(3a−b)/6; tunda b² tabbatacce ne kullum, 3a−b dole ya zama tabbatacce. Don haka b<3a.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.model.1: Idan b<3a, mafi ƙarancin ƙima tabbatacciya ce. Ƙididdige F(b)=∫₀ᵇ(t−a)(t−b)dt=b²(3a−b)/6, alamar kuma 3a−b ce ke tantancewa.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.model.2: Ya isa 3a>b. Nemo F(b)=b^2(3a-b)/6 a x=b, inda mafi ƙarancin yake, sannan sharadin tabbatacciya shi ne 3a-b>0.

n-m-h2-integ-03.title: Idan ya dawo inda ya fara, shin bai motsa ba?
n-m-h2-integ-03.topic: Velocity da nisa: canjin matsayi da nisan tafiya
n-m-h2-integ-03.goal: Ta hanyar sabunta hukunci duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya bayyana, fahimci definite integral na velocity shi ne canjin matsayi kuma ya bambanta da nisan tafiya; bayyana yadda ake nemo nisan.
n-m-h2-integ-03.material: Ana bayyana bayani kan batu P da ke motsi a layin lambobi kaɗan-kaɗan. Canjin matsayi integral ne na velocity, nisan tafiya kuma jimillar tsawon duk hanyoyin da aka bi.
n-m-h2-integ-03.thinking.0: Sabunta hukunci duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya bayyana
n-m-h2-integ-03.thinking.1: Bambanta canjin matsayi da nisan tafiya
n-m-h2-integ-03.thinking.2: Raba kewayon inda alamar velocity take canzawa
n-m-h2-integ-03.prereq.0: Alaƙar velocity da matsayi (canjin matsayi=definite integral na velocity)
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi hukunci bisa bayanin da aka bayyana kawai.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.hint.0: Duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya bayyana, yi tunanin ko “canjin matsayi” da “tsawon da aka bi” abu ɗaya suke nufi.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.hint.1: Yi tunanin yadda motsin batu ya bambanta inda alamar velocity take canzawa.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Mun nemo canjin matsayi na P daga t=0 zuwa t=6, ya zama 0. Wato a t=6 P yana wurin da ya fara.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Daga wannan bayani kaɗai, za mu iya cewa nisan da P ya yi 0 ne?
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Canjin matsayi ƙima ce mai alkibla (tana da alama), don haka tana iya zama 0 ko da batu ya tafi ya dawo.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Za mu iya cewa haka: matsayi iri ɗaya ne, don haka nisan tafiya ma 0 ne.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka ɗauki canjin matsayi da nisan tafiya a matsayin abu ɗaya. Ko da ya tafi ya dawo, canjin matsayi 0 ne.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ba za mu iya cewa haka ba: idan ya tafi ya dawo, nisan ba 0 ba ne ko da canji 0 ne.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka yi tunanin yadda canjin 0 ba ya nufin “bai motsa ba” kawai.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Za mu iya cewa idan definite integral 0 ne, velocity dole kullum 0 ne.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ko da definite integral 0 ne, akwai yiwuwar wasu tazara velocity tabbatacce ne, wasu kuma mara kyau.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: A wane lokaci P ke sauya alkiblar motsi?
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Yayin da velocity mara kyau ne yana motsi wata alkibla, idan tabbatacce ne yana motsi akasin haka. Alkibla tana canzawa a t=4 inda alama take sauyawa.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: t=2: jadawalin v(t) yana mafi ƙasa a nan, don haka alkiblar tana sauyawa.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wurin da v(t) ya fi ƙanƙanta shi ne inda sauri ya fi yawa, ba wurin sauya alkibla ba.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: t=4: v(t)=0 kuma alama tana canzawa a gefensa.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ka tabbatar v(t)=t(t−4) mara kyau ne ga 0<t<4 kuma tabbatacce ga t>4.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ba ya sauya alkibla: lokacin da velocity 0 yake ba lallai ne ya sauya alkibla ba.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Idan velocity 0 ne kuma alama tana canzawa, alkibla tana canzawa.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Mun samo canjin matsayi a kowace tazara: −32/3 daga 0 zuwa 4, da +32/3 daga 4 zuwa 6.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Wane nisa ne P ya yi daga t=0 zuwa 6 a zahiri?
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Ana samun nisan ta raba kewayon inda alamar velocity take canzawa sannan a haɗa magnitudes (absolute values) na canjin kowane ɓangare. Wato ∫₀⁶|v(t)|dt=64/3.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Idan aka haɗa, motsin alkibla kishiya suna soke juna. Wannan canjin matsayi ne.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Tazarar dawowa ma tana cikin tsawon da aka bi.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka haɗa duk tsawon da aka bi ba tare da la’akari da alkibla ba.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.reflect: Da farko kamar nisan zai zama 0 domin P ya koma inda ya fara, amma duba alamar velocity ya nuna akwai tafiya da dawowa. Canjin matsayi yana da alama kuma yana soke juna, nisan tafiya kuma ba ya soke juna.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s2.prompt: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa nisan tafiya ba 0 ba ne ko da P yana wurin farawa a t=6, sannan yadda ake nemo nisan.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s2.hint.0: Haɗa cewa P yana wurin farawa a t=6 da alamun velocity kafin da bayan t=4, ka bayyana motsinsa da kalmomi.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta ko canjin matsayi ko nisan tafiya ne ke soke juna.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s2.placeholder: Misali, saboda P ..., nisan shi ne ...
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana bambancin canjin matsayi da nisan tafiya?
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka ce a raba kewayon inda alamar velocity take canzawa?
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s2.model.0: P ya motsa alkibla ɗaya har t=4, sannan ya dawo ta akasin alkibla zuwa wurin farawa. Canje-canjen sun soke su zama 0, amma hanyar da ya bi tana nan. Raba kewayon inda alamar velocity ke canzawa, sannan ka haɗa absolute values na canjin kowane ɓangare.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s2.model.1: Yayin da velocity mara kyau ne yana tafiya gaba, bayan ya zama tabbatacce alkibla ta canza ya dawo. Canjin matsayi 0 ne saboda alamomi, amma nisa ana samunsa ta lissafa bangarorin biyu dabam sannan a haɗa su a matsayin tabbatattun ƙimomi.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s2.model.2: Motsin tafiya da dawowa suna da alamomi kishiyoyi, saboda haka suna soke juna cikin definite integral. Nisa integral na |v(t)| ne, don haka raba inda alama ta canza sannan a haɗa.

n-m-h2-integ-10.thinking.0: Sabunta hukunci duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya bayyana
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi hukunci bisa bayanin da aka bayyana kawai.
n-m-h2-integ-10.title: Shin yankin da aka kiyasta da rectangles ya fi ko ya yi ƙasa da ainihin?
n-m-h2-integ-10.topic: Ma’anar definite integral: kiyasta yanki da rectangles
n-m-h2-integ-10.goal: Ta sabunta hukunci yayin da bayani ke bayyana, fahimci ko ƙimar da aka kiyasta da rectangles ta fi ko ta yi ƙasa da ainihin yankin yana dogara da aikin yana ƙaruwa ko raguwa.
n-m-h2-integ-10.material: Muna kiyasta rectangles yankin A (0≤x≤1) da y=x², axis na x da x=1 suka kewaye. Raba kewayon zuwa sassa n daidai, gina rectangle a kowane sashe. Idan tsayi ƙimar gefen hagu ne, shi ne “left sum”; idan na gefen dama ne, “right sum” ne.
n-m-h2-integ-10.thinking.1: Haɗa inda aka auna tsayi da aikin yana ƙaruwa ko raguwa
n-m-h2-integ-10.thinking.2: Bincika ko kiyasi yana kewaye ainihin ƙima daga sama da ƙasa
n-m-h2-integ-10.prereq.0: Ma’anar definite integral a matsayin yanki
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane sashe, zana ka kwatanta ko saman rectangle yana sama ko ƙasa da lanƙwasa.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.hint.1: A wurin auna tsayi (hagu ko dama), kwatanta ko tsayin lanƙwasa shi ne mafi ƙasa ko mafi sama cikin sashen.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Me za mu iya cewa game da ainihin yankin A?
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Lanƙwasar tana ƙaruwa zuwa dama, don haka left sum ya yi ƙasa da ainihin, right sum kuma ya fi ainihi. Ainihin A yana tsakaninsu.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.0.o.a: A yana tsakanin 0.125 da 0.625: left sum ya yi ƙasa, right sum ya wuce.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka yi amfani da cewa lanƙwasa tana hawa zuwa dama; a kowane sashe tsayin hagu mafi ƙanƙanta ne, dama kuma mafi girma.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.0.o.b: A=0.375: domin matsakaicin ƙimomin biyu kullum ainihin yankin ne.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Babu tabbacin matsakaici ya zama ainihin yanki. Ya danganta da siffar lanƙwasa.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.0.o.c: A ya fi 0.625: domin rectangles suna cika ƙasa da lanƙwasa kawai.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Rectangles na right sum suna fita sama da lanƙwasa. Left sum ne ke cika ƙasa da lanƙwasa kawai.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Da muka ƙara n=4, left sum ya zama 0.21875, right sum 0.46875.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: Idan aka ƙara n, me ke faruwa tsakanin sums biyu da ainihin A?
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Yayin da n ke ƙaruwa, faɗi yana raguwa, bambancin sums biyu ma yana raguwa. Ana iya ganin definite integral a matsayin ƙimar da sums ɗin biyu suka matse tsakaninsu.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Sums biyun suna kusantar A, A kuma yana tsakaninsu.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka tabbatar sums biyun suna matsewa suna kewaye A daga sama da ƙasa.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Left sum yana raguwa, right sum yana ƙaruwa suna nisa da A.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Daga n=2 zuwa 4, left sum ya ƙaru, right sum ya ragu.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.1.o.c: A wani lokaci sums biyun za su ketare, A kuma ya fita tsakaninsu.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Muddin lanƙwasa tana ƙaruwa, left sum kullum ƙarami ne, right sum kuma babba; saboda haka A yana tsakaninsu.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.2.info: A wannan karon mun kiyasta y=1−x² (0≤x≤1) haka nan da n=2; left sum 0.875, right sum 0.375, ainihin yankin kuma kusan 0.667 ne.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.2.ask: Me ya sa left sum ya fi ainihin yankin girma ga wannan lanƙwasa?
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Ko kiyasi zai fi ko ya yi ƙasa, bisa wurin auna tsayi, ya dogara da lanƙwasa tana ƙaruwa ko raguwa. Ga mai raguwa, alkiblar tana juye.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Kuskuren lissafi ne: left sum kullum ya fi ainihin ƙasa.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kullum ƙarami ne yana aiki ne kawai idan lanƙwasa tana tashi.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Lanƙwasa tana sauka, saboda haka gefen hagu shi ne mafi tsawo, rectangles suna wuce lanƙwasa.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka yi tunanin yadda left sum yake zama babba ko ƙarami bisa aikin yana ƙaruwa ko raguwa.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Lanƙwasa tana da wani ɓangare ƙasa da axis na x, don haka alama tana juye.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: A 0≤x≤1, 1−x² aƙalla 0 ne, saboda haka ba ya gangarawa ƙasa da axis.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.reflect: Da farko kamar ƙa’idar left sum ƙarami, right sum babba tana aiki kullum; amma da lanƙwasa ta sauka, ta juye. Ko kiyasi ya fi ko ya yi ƙasa da ainihi yana dogara da aikin yana ƙaruwa ko raguwa.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta sharadin da lanƙwasa (aiki) dole ta cika domin left sum kullum ya yi ƙasa ko daidai da ainihin yankin, ka ba da misali idan sharadin bai cika ba.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s2.hint.0: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa left sum yake ƙasa ta inda aka auna tsayi da tsayin lanƙwasa.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s2.hint.1: Duba ko dalilin yana aiki idan lanƙwasa tana sauka.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka haɗa wurin auna tsayi da aikin yana ƙaruwa ko raguwa?
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: A misalin da sharadi bai cika ba, ka bayyana ta wace hanya kiyasi ya gaza?

n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi hukunci bisa bayanin da aka bayyana kawai.
n-m-h2-seq-02.title: Layi na 2 ne kuskuren farko. Denominator |x−1| ne, ba x−1 ba; idan x<1, |x−1|=−(x−1). Ba za a soke x−1 na denominator da na numerator kai tsaye ba. Layukan 3 da 4 sun biyo bayan wannan magana marar daidai.
n-m-h2-seq-02.topic: Gyara mafitar Hyunwoo ta nemo left da right limits daban.
n-m-h2-seq-02.goal: Idan x<1, soke ka sauƙaƙa maganar sannan nemo ƙimarta yayin x→1. Yi haka idan x>1.
n-m-h2-seq-02.material: Kwatanta ƙimomin biyu ka duba ko sharadin samuwar limit ya cika. [2, 2, 3, 4, 6]
n-m-h2-seq-02.thinking.0: Ka sake rubuta |x−1| daban idan x<1 da x>1?
n-m-h2-seq-02.thinking.1: Ka kammala babu limit domin limits biyun sun bambanta?
n-m-h2-seq-02.thinking.2: Idan x>1, |x−1|=x−1, sokewa tana ba x+1, right limit 2. Idan x<1, |x−1|=−(x−1), maganar ta zama −(x+1), left limit −2. Limits sun bambanta, don haka limit ba ya wanzu.
n-m-h2-seq-02.prereq.0: Right limit x+1→2 ga x>1, left limit −(x+1)→−2 ga x<1. Ƙimomin sun bambanta, don haka limit ba ya wanzu.
n-m-h2-seq-02.prereq.1: Zaɓi ɗaya daga waɗannan da limit yake wanzu yayin x→1.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane zaɓi, fara duba ko magana cikin absolute value tana sauya alama kusa da x=1.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.hint.1: Idan alama ba ta canza ba, yi tunanin ko za a cire absolute value kawai. [1]
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Wannan magana ce daga misalin da aka yi. Left da right limits sun bambanta. [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3]
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kusa da x=1, x+1 tabbatacce ne; don haka |x²−1|=|x−1|(x+1), left limit −2 ne, right limit 2, sun bambanta.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Numerator yana kusantar 2, denominator kuma 0; idan x>1 yana ƙaruwa ba iyaka, idan x<1 yana raguwa ba iyaka. Limit ba ya wanzu.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kusa da x=1, x+1>0, don haka |x+1|=x+1, (x²−1)/|x+1|=x−1, limit 0 ne. Abu mafi muhimmanci shi ne ko magana cikin absolute value tana sauya alama kusa da 1.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Rashin daidaito da limits: binciken iƙirarin Ayun
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Limits da continuity na ayyuka: alaƙar tsari na limits
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Yi amfani da counterexample don gano abin da ke faruwa ga rashin daidaito mai tsauri idan aka ɗauki limits, sannan bayyana ko iƙirarin gaskiya ne, ƙarya ne, da ƙarshe madaidaiciya.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ayun ta ce, “Idan f(x)<g(x) ga kowane x(≠0) kusa da x=0 kuma limits lim f(x), lim g(x) suna wanzu, to limits ɗin ma lim f(x)<lim g(x). Rashin daidaiton yana nan yadda yake.”
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Bayyana yadda rashin daidaiton ke raunana [1, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5]
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Zaɓi nau’i-nau’i (f,g) da ke counterexample ga iƙirarin Ayun. (x→0) [1, 2]
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Raba iƙirari zuwa “zato → ƙarshe,” ka tuna counterexample yana cika zato amma yana karya ƙarshe. [1, 2]
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ga kowane zaɓi, duba ko f(x)<g(x) yana aiki ga x≠0, sannan kwatanta limits.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: x²<0 ba ya aiki ga kowane x, don haka bai cika zato ba. [1]
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ya cika zato kuma limits suna −1<1, kamar iƙirarin Ayun; saboda haka ba counterexample ba ne.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: x<x+1 yana aiki, limits kuma 0<1, kamar iƙirarin; saboda haka ba counterexample ba ne. [2]
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.2.info: f(x)=0,g(x)=x² suna da f(x)<g(x) ga x≠0 amma limits biyun 0 ne. Ya cika zato ya karya ƙarshe, saboda haka counterexample ne. [12, 15, 2, 2, 2, 20, 23, 3, 3, 4, 4, 6, 9]
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Rubuta abin da ke faruwa da f(x)<g(x) a limit yayin x→0. Jimla ɗaya kuma bayyana dalili da counterexample.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Ta amfani da counterexample na s1, rubuta abin da ke faruwa ga g(x)−f(x) yayin x→0.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Idan bambancin ya zama ƙanƙanta sosai, yi tunanin yadda tsarin limits biyu zai kasance.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka bayyana a jimla yadda rashin daidaiton ke canzawa? [1]
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ka rubuta f da g na counterexample takamaimai?
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: A limit, < yana laushi ya koma ≤. Idan f(x)=0,g(x)=x², to f<g ga kowane x≠0, amma limits biyun 0 ne. Saboda bambancin g−f yana kusantar 0.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ɗaukar limit na iya sa ƙimomin su yi daidai. Misali 0 kullum ya yi ƙasa da x², amma limits biyun 0 ne.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Idan f(x)<g(x) ga kowane x(≠0) kusa da x=0 kuma limits duka suna wanzu, zaɓi ƙarshe da kullum gaskiya ne.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.reflect: Duba alaƙar limits a counterexample na s1 da misalin f=x,g=x+1.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.prompt: Riƙe alaƙar da take gaskiya a misalan biyun.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.hint.0: A counterexample na s2 limits sun yi daidai.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ko da f<g ne, limit na f ba zai fi na g ba.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.placeholder: A counterexample (0,x²), limits biyu sun yi daidai.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Idan f(x)<g(x), ≤ kaɗai aka tabbatar a limit. Akwai misalin da daidaito yake, don haka < ba kullum gaskiya ba ne, > kuma ƙarya ne.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Duba mafitar nemo a da g(x)=f(x)f(x−a) continuous
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.model.0: Limits da continuity na ayyuka: continuity na product [1, 1, 1, 2, 5]
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.model.1: Nemo ka gyara mafitar da ta rasa yanayi na musamman inda wuraren discontinuity biyu suka zo wuri guda, sannan binciki dalilin da ya sa aikin continuous idan sun zo wuri guda. [1, 1, 1]

n-m-h2-integ-07.title: Idan derivative na constant 0 ne, shin k ma 0 ne?
n-m-h2-integ-07.topic: Ƙimar definite integral constant ce: ma’aunin aiki mai definite integral
n-m-h2-integ-07.goal: Fahimci definite integral ∫₀¹f(t)dt constant ne da bai danganta da x ba, amma ƙimarsa ba 0 ba ce kuma dole a ƙididdige ta bisa ma’anar. Rubuta bayani mai mai tausayi wa ƙaramin ɗalibi da ya yi irin kuskuren.
n-m-h2-integ-07.material: Wannan ita ce mafitar Haeun don nemo f(x) da f(x)=x²+2∫₀¹f(t)dt. (∫₀¹ definite integral ne daga 0 zuwa 1.)
n-m-h2-integ-07.thinking.2: Bayyana kuskure cikin mutunta mafitar ɗayan
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi na farko marar daidai a mafitar Haeun.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.hint.0: Duba ko kowane layi yana biyo bayan na baya da dalili isasshe.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.hint.1: Sake duba yadda aka ayyana k, ka yi tunanin abin da zai faru idan aka saka f(x) na ƙarshe cikin ma’anar.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.line.0: ∫₀¹f(t)dt ƙima ce da ba ta ƙunshi x, don haka a sa ta k, f(x)=x²+2k.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.line.1: Yin derivative a ɓangarorin biyu dangane da x yana ba da f'(x)=2x, don haka k ya ɓace idan aka yi derivative.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.line.2: k constant ne, derivative na constant kuma 0 ne, saboda haka k=0.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ne na farko da ya yi kuskure. Gaskiya ne derivative na constant 0 ne, amma wannan ba ya nufin ƙimar constant 0 ce. Dole a nemo k daga ma’anar k=∫₀¹f(t)dt. Saka f(t)=t²+2k yana ba da k=∫₀¹(t²+2k)dt=1/3+2k, saboda haka k=−1/3 da f(x)=x²−2/3.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.prompt: Wace hanya ce mafi kai tsaye don tabbatar amsar Haeun f(x)=x² ba daidai ba ce?
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.hint.0: Saka f(x)=x² a ɓangarorin biyu na ma’aunin asali f(x)=x²+2∫₀¹f(t)dt.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.hint.1: Duba ko kowane bincike “kullum yana daidai ko da amsa ba daidai ba ce.”
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.o.a: Yi derivative na f(x)=x² dangane da x, ka duba cewa f'(x)=2x.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.r.a: Mafitar Haeun ta riga ta cika wannan sharadin. Wannan bincike ba ya nuna kuskure.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.o.b: Duba kawai f(0)=0, ka kwatanta da k=0 da aka samu daga f(0)=0+2k a ma’aunin asali.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.r.b: Idan f(0)=0, yana kama da ya dace da k=0, don haka saɓani ba ya bayyana. Sai an binciki k ta ƙimar definite integral kafin a gano kuskure.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.o.c: Saka f(x)=x² cikin ∫₀¹f(t)dt, ƙididdige ƙimar, ka kwatanta da k=0.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.r.c: Wannan bincike yana ƙididdige definite integral kai tsaye, ya duba ko ya dace da ma’anar k.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.o.d: Duba ko amfani da wani harafi maimakon k yana ba da mafita iri ɗaya.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.r.d: Canza sunan harafin ba ya sauya tunanin mafita.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.explain: Idan f(x)=x² ne, ∫₀¹t²dt=1/3, saboda haka k ya kamata ya zama 1/3, amma Haeun ta ce k=0. Ba su dace ba, don haka f(x)=x² ba ya cika sharadin asali.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta ɗan saƙo ga Haeun. Haɗa abu ɗaya da ta yi daidai, dalilin layin kuskure, da jigon madaidaiciyar mafita da sakamakonta.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.hint.0: Nemo abu ɗaya da ya dace a mafitar Haeun, ka yi hasashen tunanin da ya jawo layin kuskuren.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta maganar da ake buƙata domin gyara layin kuskure (maganar da ke bayyana k a matsayin definite integral).
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.placeholder: Misali, Haeun, ... ya yi kyau. Amma ...
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka fara bayyana takamaiman abin da ta yi daidai?
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana bambancin “derivative na constant 0 ne” da “ƙimar constant 0 ce”?
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.model.0: Haeun, kyakkyawan tunani ne sanya definite integral a matsayin k! Amma “derivative na constant 0 ne” yana nufin sakamakon differentiation 0 ne, ba ƙimar k 0 ba. Dole a nemo k daga k=∫₀¹(t²+2k)dt=1/3+2k, don haka k=−1/3, f(x)=x²−2/3.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.model.1: Yana da kyau ka fara da sa ƙimar da ba ta danganta da x ta zama k. Amma k constant ne, don haka derivative nasa 0 ne; wannan daban yake da k yana da ƙima 0. Idan aka ƙididdige definite integral kai tsaye, k=1/3+2k yana ba da k=−1/3, don haka f(x)=x²−2/3.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.model.2: Haeun, kyakkyawan aiki. Idan kika saka f(x)=x² da kika samu a ƙarshe cikin ∫₀¹f(t)dt, kina samun 1/3, wanda bai dace da k=0 ba. Dole ne a ƙididdige definite integral domin nemo k; k=−1/3, f(x)=x²−2/3.

n-m-h2-integ-08.title: Idan muka yanke a tsakiyar kewayo, shin yanki ma rabin-rabi yake?
n-m-h2-integ-08.goal: Tabbatar da bayyana ta lissafin definite integral da misalin da ka ƙirƙira cewa yanke tsakiyar kewayo ba ya raba yanki biyu daidai, kuma wurin yankan yana karkata zuwa gefen da aikin ya fi girma.
n-m-h2-integ-08.material: Akwai siffar da layin y=2x, axis na x, da layukan x=1 da x=7 suka kewaye. Sua ta ce, “Idan aka zana layin tsaye a x=4, tsakiyar kewayon 1≤x≤7, yankin ya rabu daidai,” Dohyeon kuma ya ce, “Bari mu bincika da definite integral.”
n-m-h2-integ-08.thinking.0: Gwada iƙirari na fahimta da lambobi
n-m-h2-integ-08.thinking.2: Haɗa siffar jadawali da rarrabuwar yanki
n-m-h2-integ-08.prereq.1: Nemo ƙimomi da suka cika ma’auni tsakanin lambobin cikakku
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.prompt: Yaya layin tsaye x=4 ya raba yankin?
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.hint.0: Kwatanta tsayin ɓangaren hagu da na dama, inda x=4 yake iyaka.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.hint.1: Ƙididdige ka kwatanta definite integrals na ɓangarorin biyu, ∫₁⁴2x dx da ∫₄⁷2x dx.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.o.a: An raba daidai: domin kewayon hagu da dama faɗinsu ɗaya ne.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.r.a: Ko da faɗinsu ɗaya ne, idan tsayi ya bambanta, yankuna sun bambanta. A ɓangaren dama layin ya fi sama.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.o.b: An raba daidai: domin layi ne, tsayi yana daidaita a kowane kewayo.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.r.b: Tsayin y=2x yana canzawa da x. Tsayi yana daidaita ne ga y=constant kawai.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.o.c: Ba a raba daidai ba: domin ɓangaren dama ya fi ƙasa, don haka yankin hagu ya fi girma.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.r.c: Layin yana ƙaruwa zuwa dama, don haka yankin dama ya fi girma.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.o.d: Ba a raba daidai ba: domin tsayi yana ƙaruwa zuwa dama, don haka ɓangaren dama ya fi girma.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.r.d: Ka yi amfani da cewa yanki ya fi taruwa a gefen da tsayi ya fi yawa.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.explain: ∫₁⁴2x dx=16−1=15, ∫₄⁷2x dx=49−16=33. Hagu 15 ne, dama kuma 33; ba a raba daidai ba, dama ta fi girma.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.prompt: Shigar da nau’i-nau’i biyu daban-daban na integers (a,b,k) ta yadda layin tsaye x=k zai raba daidai yankin tsakanin y=2x, axis na x, da layukan x=a da x=b. (1≤a<k<b≤50)
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta definite integrals na ɓangaren hagu da dama na x=k ta a,b,k.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.hint.1: Sauƙaƙa ma’aunin da ke cewa ƙimomin biyu daidai ne, sannan gwada haɗaɗɗun integers.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole su zama lambobi cikakku masu 1≤a<k<b≤50.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Yankunan hagu da dama na x=k daidai suke.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Yankin hagu da dama ba daidai ba ne. Bayyana ∫ₐᵏ2x dx da ∫ₖᵇ2x dx ta a,b,k.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.explain: ∫ₐᵏ2x dx=k²−a², ∫ₖᵇ2x dx=b²−k², don haka k²−a²=b²−k², wato 2k²=a²+b². Misali (1, 7, 5) yana ba da 25−1=24=49−25.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.prompt: A nau’i-nau’in da ka samu, k ya fi ko ya yi ƙasa da matsakaicin (average) a da b? Bayyana ta haɗa da siffar y=2x.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.hint.0: Ga kowane nau’i-nau’i, nemo matsakaicin (a+b)/2 ka kwatanta da k.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.hint.1: Ka tuna wane gefe ne ke da yanki mafi girma idan aka yanke a tsakiyar.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.placeholder: Misali k ya fi ... tsakiyar. Dalili kuwa ...
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka kwatanta yankunan hagu da dama a tsakiyar?
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana da dalili wane bangare wurin raba yanki ya karkata?
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.model.0: k ya fi matsakaici girma. Layin yana ƙaruwa zuwa dama, don haka idan an yanke a tsakiyar, yankin dama ya fi yawa. Domin raba yankin daidai, dole a matsar da layin yankan zuwa dama da tsakiyar.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.model.1: A (1,7,5), matsakaici 4 ne amma k=5, don haka k ya fi girma. Yanki ya fi taruwa gefen da tsayi ya fi yawa, saboda haka layin raba daidai yana karkata zuwa dama.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.model.2: k da ke raba yankin daidai yana hannun dama da tsakiyar a da b. Tun da y=2x ya fi sama a dama, yankin dama ya fi girma idan an yanke tsakiyar.

n-m-h2-integ-09.title: Za mu iya nemo yanki cikin sauƙi ko da siffar tana da rikitarwa?
n-m-h2-integ-09.topic: Yanki tsakanin lanƙwasu biyu: bambancin tsayi
n-m-h2-integ-09.goal: Fahimci yankin tsakanin lanƙwasu biyu, ɗaya daga cikinsu ɗagawa ce ta ɗayan, yana dogara ne kawai da bambancin tsayi da faɗin kewayo; gina misalai masu cika sharadi da sabuwar matsala ta irin wannan.
n-m-h2-integ-09.material: Akwai lanƙwasar y=x³−3x da y=x³−3x+4, wadda ita ce ta farko da aka ɗaga 4. Muna son nemo yankin tsakaninsu a 0≤x≤3. (A wannan kewayon, lanƙwasa ta farko tana da wani ɓangare ƙasa da axis na x.)
n-m-h2-integ-09.thinking.0: Rage lissafi ta duba tsarin maganganu (bambanci)
n-m-h2-integ-09.thinking.1: Kada a jingina ga alaƙa da axis na x
n-m-h2-integ-09.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri matsala da ke cika sharuddan da kanka
n-m-h2-integ-09.prereq.0: Yanki tsakanin lanƙwasu biyu=∫(magana ta sama−magana ta ƙasa)
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi hukunci daidai game da yankin tsakanin lanƙwasu biyu.

n-m-h2-seq-01.title: Haɗa left limits yana ba p+q=2, saboda haka left limit, right limit da ƙimar f+g duka 2 ne. Saɓanin ayyukan biyu yana ɓacewa idan aka haɗa.
n-m-h2-seq-01.topic: Ta amfani da tsarin s2 (1 idan x≥0, p ko q idan x<0), kana son gina misali da f·g continuous a x=0 amma f da g duka discontinuous. Wane sharadi ya dace?
n-m-h2-seq-01.goal: Da farko nemo right limit da ƙimar f·g a x=0.
n-m-h2-seq-01.material: Rubuta left limit ta p,q, sannan kafa ma’auni da ta yi daidai da ƙimar nan. [2, 3, 6]
n-m-h2-seq-01.thinking.1: Ka yi amfani da sharadin jimla. Ga product, left limit pq ne.
n-m-h2-seq-01.prereq.1: Ba ka duba cewa right limit da ƙimar aikin product 1·1=1 ne.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.hint.0: p=q kaɗai ba ya tabbatar pq=1. Misali p=q=2 yana ba pq=4.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.hint.1: A x=0, right limit da ƙimar f·g su ne 1·1=1, left limit kuma pq ne. Saboda haka continuous idan pq=1. Idan p≠1, q=1/p≠1, don haka duka ayyukan discontinuous ne (misali p=2,q=1/2). [3, 6]
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.line.1: Limits da continuity na ayyuka: limits na maganganu masu absolute value [0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 3]
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.line.2: Fahimci cewa dole a binciki alamomi kafin sokewa a maganar absolute value, sannan ka gyara mafita ta nemo left da right limits dabam. [0, 1, 1, 2, 2]
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.line.3: Hyunwoo ya nemo lim_{x→1}(x²−1)/|x−1| kamar haka. (|x−1| absolute value ne na x−1.) [0, 2]
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.explain: Gyara mafita da left da right limits [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 3, 6]
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s2.prompt: Binciki alamar magana cikin absolute value [1, 1]
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi layi na farko marar daidai a mafitar Hyunwoo.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s2.placeholder: Rubuta |x−1| ba tare da alamar absolute value ba idan x<1 da idan x>1.

n-m-h2-seq-03.s.s2.model.0: 2ⁿ>n² yana aiki daga n=5. A fara da n=5, inda 32>25, kuma rashin daidaiton matakin k²−2k−1≥0 yana aiki idan k≥3; saboda haka ana iya amfani da matakin idan k≥5.

n-m-h2-seq-04.title: Shin a₄ 6 ne, ko zai iya zama −6 ma?
n-m-h2-seq-04.topic: Alamar kalmar matsakaicin lissafi a jere na ninkawa
n-m-h2-seq-04.goal: Daga zaɓuɓɓuka biyu da dangantakar matsakaicin lissafi a₄²=a₂a₆ ta bayar, yanke ko tsarin jere na ninkawa yana ƙayyade alamar, sannan bayyana dalilin ta hanyar kwatanta da yanayin kalmomi uku a jere.
n-m-h2-seq-04.material: A jerin ninkawa na lambobin gaske {aₙ}, a₂=3 kuma a₆=12. Minjun ya ce, “a₄²=a₂×a₆=36, saboda haka a₄=6 ko −6,” Seoyeon kuma ta ce, “a₄ 6 ne kawai.” (Ana karanta aₙ da “a sub n”; rabo na gama-gari shi ne rabon kalmomi biyu maƙwabta.)
n-m-h2-seq-04.thinking.0: Tace zaɓuɓɓukan da dangantakar murabba’i ta bayar bisa tsarin jerin
n-m-h2-seq-04.thinking.1: Bayyana kalmomin ta amfani da kalmar farko da rabo na gama-gari domin duba alamar
n-m-h2-seq-04.thinking.2: Kwatanta yanayi biyu masu sharudda mabambanta
n-m-h2-seq-04.prereq.0: Kalmar gama-gari ta jerin ninkawa aₙ=arⁿ⁻¹
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi hukuncin da ya dace daga maganganun mutanen biyu, tare da dalilinsa.
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s1.hint.0: Bayyana a₄ da a₆ ta amfani da a₂ da rabo na gama-gari r.
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s1.hint.1: A cikin bayanan da ka rubuta, kwatanta ko ana ninka r sau marar-makamancin lamba ko sau makamancin lamba.
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s1.o.a: a₄ = 6 ko −6: domin duka lambobin da a₄²=36 suke cikawa matsakaitan lissafi ne
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s1.r.a: Ka amince da ƙimomin biyu ta duban dangantakar murabba’i kawai. Ba ka duba ko za su yiwu a jerin gaske ba.
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s1.o.b: Ba za a iya tantancewa ba: domin ba tare da sanin rabo na gama-gari r ba, ba za a iya sanin a₄ ba
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s1.r.b: Ko da ba a tantance r ba, duba ko an tantance r².
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s1.o.c: a₄ = 6 kawai: domin jerin ninkawa ba zai iya samun kalma mara kyau ba
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s1.r.c: Idan rabon gama-gari mara kyau ne, kalmomi marasa kyau suna bayyana. A nan, dalilin da ya sa alamar ta tabbata yana wani wuri dabam.
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s1.o.d: a₄ = 6 kawai: domin a₄=a₂×r² kuma r²≥0, saboda haka a₄ yana da alama ɗaya da a₂
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s1.r.d: Wannan ita ce hanyar bayyana kalmar ta amfani da a₂ da rabo na gama-gari domin duba alama.
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s1.explain: a₄=a₂×r² kuma r² ya kai ko ya fi 0, saboda haka a₄ yana da alama ɗaya da a₂=3. Haka kuma daga a₆=a₂×r⁴ muna samun r⁴=4, don haka r²=2 kuma a₄=6. Dukansu r=±√2 suna yiwuwa, amma a₄ ƙima ɗaya ce. Idan aka duba a₄²=36 kawai, −6 ma zai bayyana, amma ba zai yiwu a jerin gaske ba.
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s2.prompt: Idan 3, x, 12 su ne kalmomi uku a jere na jerin ninkawa, x=6 da x=−6 duk suna yiwuwa. Amma idan a₂=3 kuma a₆=12, a₄ zai iya zama 6 kawai. Bayyana dalilin da ya sa yanayin biyu suka bambanta.
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s2.hint.0: A kowane yanayi, ƙirga sau nawa ake ninka kalmar da ta gabata da rabo na gama-gari domin samun kalmar tsakiya.
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta alamar wannan ninkawa idan rabo na gama-gari mara kyau ne.
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: ga kalmomi uku a jere ..., amma a₄ ...
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta x=3r da a₄=3r² bi da bi?
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana abin da ke faruwa a yanayi biyun idan r mara kyau ne?
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s2.model.0: Ga kalmomi uku a jere, x=3r, don haka r na iya zama 2 ko −2 kuma x na iya zama 6 ko −6. Amma ninkawa da r sau biyu, kamar a₄=a₂r², yana cire alamar rabo; saboda haka a₄ koyaushe yana da alama ɗaya da 3.
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s2.model.1: Idan kalmar tsakiya x=3r ce, x mara kyau ne idan r mara kyau ne. a₄ yana zama a₂ ninkar r², saboda haka yana da kyau ko r yana da kyau ko mara kyau. Don haka a₄ 6 ne kawai.

n-m-h2-seq-07.material:
Wani dakin gwaje-gwaje yana noman ƙwayoyin cuta. Da farko akwai 5, kuma a kowace awa adadinsu yana ninkuwa sau biyu sannan a cire 3. Ga adadin aₙ a awa n (inda a₁=5 a awa ta farko), aₙ₊₁ = 2aₙ − 3. A ƙasa akwai bayanin warwarewa na wani babban ɗalibi.
Bayani: Daga x = 2x − 3, x = 3. Don haka aₙ₊₁ − 3 = 2(aₙ − 3). Bari bₙ = aₙ − 3. To b₁ = 2 kuma bₙ = 2ⁿ. Saboda haka aₙ = 2ⁿ + 3.

n-m-h2-seq-10.title: Jimillar bambance-bambancen tana kaiwa zuwa n ko zuwa n−1?
n-m-h2-seq-10.topic: Babban kalmar jerin bambance-bambance da iyakar jimillarsu.
n-m-h2-seq-10.goal: Gwada zaɓuɓɓuka biyu na babban kalmar da aka samo daga maimaitawar lissafi da ƙananan ƙimomin n, ka tantance wacce ta dace, sannan ka yi bayani da misalan kalmomi dalilin da ya sa jimillar bambance-bambance ta tsaya a n−1.
n-m-h2-seq-10.material:
Ɗalibai biyu sun samo babban kalmar jerin {aₙ} inda a₁=2 da aₙ₊₁ = aₙ + (3n − 1).
Harin: aₙ = 2 + Σ(k=1 zuwa n−1)(3k−1) = (3n²−5n+6)/2
Doyun: aₙ = 2 + Σ(k=1 zuwa n)(3k−1) = (3n²+n+4)/2

n-m-h2-seq-10.thinking.1: Ƙirga yawan kalmomin da ke cikin jimillar.
